{"id": "prep:EARLY-01", "printed_page": 365, "pdf_page": 375, "section": null, "terms": ["Bau", "Bildung", "Ausbildung"], "quote": "In der Ausbildung der Nationen, welchen
sie angehören, sind gewiss bedeutende, auch in ihnen selbst un-
                    verkennbare Unterschiede gewesen, allein der Mangel alphabetischer
Schrift und mithin eigentlicher Literatur stellt doch alle, ohne
Ausnahme, auf einer niedrigeren Stufe gleich.", "meaning": "The opening assigns different levels of development to nations and languages and treats alphabetic writing/literature as a common ranking criterion. This is Humboldt's evaluative claim, not a neutral typological fact.", "implication": "Use development/cultivation according to bearer, retaining the explicit lower-stage judgment; do not flatten Bildung into structural formation everywhere.", "verification": "OCR-only", "issue": "Opening material retained provisionally under D001; reported cancellation of first seven paragraphs remains manuscript-unverified.", "source_path": "sources/raw/gs-v-1906.pdf", "source_sha256": "4b9227f0d1ec7065a8c80df11031581399bef1962d085a4e267ba466ac58e17f", "reader": "early", "record_path": "sources/terminology/readings/early-evidence.json", "record_sha256": "3b816dc1a8c26dcdf3276d3610004bc806e50fc349285b1dc6ee17672c01495d", "claim_status": "provisional interpretation of cited source; not modern validation", "locator": "printed 365; PDF 375", "statement": "The opening assigns different levels of development to nations and languages and treats alphabetic writing/literature as a common ranking criterion. This is Humboldt's evaluative claim, not a neutral typological fact.", "quote_status": "OCR-only"}

{"id": "prep:EARLY-02", "printed_page": 367, "pdf_page": 377, "section": "7", "terms": ["Sprachkunde", "Sprache", "Art", "Gattung"], "quote": "Die Sprachen eines Erdstrichs lassen sich hauptsächlich auf 7.
zwei, in dem Zweck und der Behandlung verschiedene Weisen
darstellen, einmal an sich, als unter der allgemeinen Menschen-
             sprache, wie Arten unter einer Gattung, begriffene Idiome, dann
in Beziehung auf den Ort und das Volk, welchen sie angehören,
in ihrem geographischen und geschichtlichen Zusammenhange.", "meaning": "Two presentations differ in purpose: languages considered under human language generally, and languages in geographic/historical relations.", "implication": "Render Sprachkunde as study of language/languages; keep species/genus analogy locally visible without making it an established natural taxonomy.", "verification": "OCR-only", "issue": "", "source_path": "sources/raw/gs-v-1906.pdf", "source_sha256": "4b9227f0d1ec7065a8c80df11031581399bef1962d085a4e267ba466ac58e17f", "reader": "early", "record_path": "sources/terminology/readings/early-evidence.json", "record_sha256": "3b816dc1a8c26dcdf3276d3610004bc806e50fc349285b1dc6ee17672c01495d", "claim_status": "provisional interpretation of cited source; not modern validation", "locator": "printed 367; PDF 377; §7", "statement": "Two presentations differ in purpose: languages considered under human language generally, and languages in geographic/historical relations.", "quote_status": "OCR-only"}

{"id": "prep:EARLY-03", "printed_page": 369, "pdf_page": 379, "section": null, "terms": ["Form", "technische Mittel", "Wirkung"], "quote": "Diese technischen Mittel verändern
sich auch, entstehen und gehen unter, es tritt eines an die Stelle
des andren, und darum dass die bestimmte Form fehlt, mangelt
nicht die Wirkung, welche sie sonst in der Sprache hervorbringt.", "meaning": "Particular grammatical devices can change or disappear while their effects remain.", "implication": "Use grammatical form/device here, not an invariant essence; preserve the distinction between means and effect.", "verification": "OCR-only", "issue": "", "source_path": "sources/raw/gs-v-1906.pdf", "source_sha256": "4b9227f0d1ec7065a8c80df11031581399bef1962d085a4e267ba466ac58e17f", "reader": "early", "record_path": "sources/terminology/readings/early-evidence.json", "record_sha256": "3b816dc1a8c26dcdf3276d3610004bc806e50fc349285b1dc6ee17672c01495d", "claim_status": "provisional interpretation of cited source; not modern validation", "locator": "printed 369; PDF 379", "statement": "Particular grammatical devices can change or disappear while their effects remain.", "quote_status": "OCR-only"}

{"id": "prep:EARLY-04", "printed_page": 369, "pdf_page": 379, "section": null, "terms": ["Sprache", "Verrichtung", "geistiger Process"], "quote": "sie ist, auch nicht einmal in der durch sie ge-
                 gebenen Masse von Wörtern und Regeln, ein daliegender Stoff,
sondern eine Verrichtung, ein geistiger Process, wie das Leben
 ein körperlicher. Nichts, was sich auf sie bezieht, kann mit ana-
                      tomischer, sondern nur mit physiologischer Behandlung verglichen
 werden, nichts in ihr ist statisch, alles dynamisch.", "meaning": "The language is not inert lexical/rule material but an operation or mental process; physiological rather than anatomical treatment is urged.", "implication": "Prefer activity/operation for Verrichtung and mental process for geistiger Process; do not import later formulae or a modern theory.", "verification": "OCR-only", "issue": "OCR line-end hyphenation retained in the quotation.", "source_path": "sources/raw/gs-v-1906.pdf", "source_sha256": "4b9227f0d1ec7065a8c80df11031581399bef1962d085a4e267ba466ac58e17f", "reader": "early", "record_path": "sources/terminology/readings/early-evidence.json", "record_sha256": "3b816dc1a8c26dcdf3276d3610004bc806e50fc349285b1dc6ee17672c01495d", "claim_status": "provisional interpretation of cited source; not modern validation", "locator": "printed 369; PDF 379", "statement": "The language is not inert lexical/rule material but an operation or mental process; physiological rather than anatomical treatment is urged.", "quote_status": "OCR-only"}

{"id": "prep:EARLY-05", "printed_page": 370, "pdf_page": 380, "section": null, "terms": ["Bau", "Mittel", "Verfahren"], "quote": "Auf dem andren
forscht man nach der Art der Anwendung und des Gebrauchs
dieser Mittel, nach der Gesammtbehandlung, die sie erfahren, und
ergründet in möglicher Vollständigkeit von allen Seiten aus das
Verfahren der Sprache im Ganzen, von dessen Darstellung erst
die wahre Durchschauung ihres Wesens abhängt.", "meaning": "The second route investigates how means are used and treated together, yielding an account of the language's overall procedure.", "implication": "Use structure for Bau but procedure/manner of operating for Verfahren; do not turn the latter into an inventory of structural parts.", "verification": "OCR-only", "issue": "OCR line-end hyphenation retained in the quotation.", "source_path": "sources/raw/gs-v-1906.pdf", "source_sha256": "4b9227f0d1ec7065a8c80df11031581399bef1962d085a4e267ba466ac58e17f", "reader": "early", "record_path": "sources/terminology/readings/early-evidence.json", "record_sha256": "3b816dc1a8c26dcdf3276d3610004bc806e50fc349285b1dc6ee17672c01495d", "claim_status": "provisional interpretation of cited source; not modern validation", "locator": "printed 370; PDF 380", "statement": "The second route investigates how means are used and treated together, yielding an account of the language's overall procedure.", "quote_status": "OCR-only"}

{"id": "prep:EARLY-06", "printed_page": 371, "pdf_page": 381, "section": "13", "terms": ["Studium", "Darstellung", "Allgemeines", "Einzelnes"], "quote": "Das Studium verlangt einen\nandern Weg, als die Darstellung des durch Studium Erkannten.", "meaning": "The order of inquiry differs from the order of presenting what has been learned.", "implication": "Distinguish study/investigation from exposition; the general-to-particular presentation does not license beginning empirical study from a preconceived general scheme.", "verification": "OCR-only", "issue": "", "source_path": "sources/raw/gs-v-1906.pdf", "source_sha256": "4b9227f0d1ec7065a8c80df11031581399bef1962d085a4e267ba466ac58e17f", "reader": "early", "record_path": "sources/terminology/readings/early-evidence.json", "record_sha256": "3b816dc1a8c26dcdf3276d3610004bc806e50fc349285b1dc6ee17672c01495d", "claim_status": "provisional interpretation of cited source; not modern validation", "locator": "printed 371; PDF 381; §13", "statement": "The order of inquiry differs from the order of presenting what has been learned.", "quote_status": "OCR-only"}

{"id": "prep:EARLY-07", "printed_page": 373, "pdf_page": 383, "section": "16", "terms": ["Typus", "Begriff", "individualisiren"], "quote": "Die Allgemeinheit dieses Typus besteht darin, dass Alles, was von ihm auszusagen ist, nur durch den reinen Begriff der Sprache bedingt und von allen andren Umständen abgesehen wird, die, aus den übrigen menschlichen Anlagen und den auf sie einwirkenden Verhältnissen entspringend, in der Wirklichkeit den allgemeinen Typus individualisiren.", "meaning": "The general type abstracts from individualizing circumstances and is determined by the pure concept of language.", "implication": "Provisional rendering: general type/pattern of the linguistic process, not language type in a morphological classification. Preserve the conceptual rather than genealogical basis.", "verification": "image-checked", "issue": "Image checked: OCR BegritF corrected to printed Begriff; typographic line-end hyphens removed and whitespace normalized in this quotation.", "source_path": "sources/raw/gs-v-1906.pdf", "source_sha256": "4b9227f0d1ec7065a8c80df11031581399bef1962d085a4e267ba466ac58e17f", "reader": "early", "record_path": "sources/terminology/readings/early-evidence.json", "record_sha256": "3b816dc1a8c26dcdf3276d3610004bc806e50fc349285b1dc6ee17672c01495d", "claim_status": "provisional interpretation of cited source; not modern validation", "locator": "printed 373; PDF 383; §16", "statement": "The general type abstracts from individualizing circumstances and is determined by the pure concept of language.", "quote_status": "image-checked"}

{"id": "prep:EARLY-08", "printed_page": 374, "pdf_page": 384, "section": "20", "terms": ["Sprache", "Gedanke", "bildendes Organ", "Thätigkeit"], "quote": "dass die Sprache nicht bloss die\n  Bezeichnung des, unabhängig von ihr geformten Gedanken, sondern\n  selbst das bildende Organ des Gedanken ist.", "meaning": "Language forms thought rather than merely designating independently formed thought.", "implication": "Keep formative organ of thought provisionally; avoid a mere communication-instrument paraphrase or a modern determinist label.", "verification": "OCR-only", "issue": "", "source_path": "sources/raw/gs-v-1906.pdf", "source_sha256": "4b9227f0d1ec7065a8c80df11031581399bef1962d085a4e267ba466ac58e17f", "reader": "early", "record_path": "sources/terminology/readings/early-evidence.json", "record_sha256": "3b816dc1a8c26dcdf3276d3610004bc806e50fc349285b1dc6ee17672c01495d", "claim_status": "provisional interpretation of cited source; not modern validation", "locator": "printed 374; PDF 384; §20", "statement": "Language forms thought rather than merely designating independently formed thought.", "quote_status": "OCR-only"}

{"id": "prep:EARLY-09", "printed_page": 375, "pdf_page": 385, "section": "21", "terms": ["Articulation", "Geräusch", "Form", "Geist"], "quote": "Die Articulation beruht auf der Gewalt des Geistes über\ndie Sprachwerkzeuge, sie zu einer Behandlung des Tons zu\nnöthigen, welche der Form seines Wirkens entspricht.", "meaning": "Articulation is defined in relation to the mind's control of speech organs and the form of its activity.", "implication": "Keep articulation distinct from audible sound/noise; Form here belongs to mental activity, not specifically grammar or syntax.", "verification": "OCR-only", "issue": "", "source_path": "sources/raw/gs-v-1906.pdf", "source_sha256": "4b9227f0d1ec7065a8c80df11031581399bef1962d085a4e267ba466ac58e17f", "reader": "early", "record_path": "sources/terminology/readings/early-evidence.json", "record_sha256": "3b816dc1a8c26dcdf3276d3610004bc806e50fc349285b1dc6ee17672c01495d", "claim_status": "provisional interpretation of cited source; not modern validation", "locator": "printed 375; PDF 385; §21", "statement": "Articulation is defined in relation to the mind's control of speech organs and the form of its activity.", "quote_status": "OCR-only"}

{"id": "prep:EARLY-10", "printed_page": 378, "pdf_page": 388, "section": "27", "terms": ["Bildung", "Gefallen", "Sprechen"], "quote": "Der viel wesentlichere Entstehungsgrund der
  Sprache ist das Gefallen am Sprechen, und daher ist es auf die
  Bildung der Sprachen von so wichtigem Einfluss, wie schweigsam
  oder geschwätzig ein Volk ist.", "meaning": "Pleasure in speaking is made a more fundamental origin than instrumental need, and national speaking habits affect language formation.", "implication": "Use formation/development of languages for Bildung here, not education; retain the comparative causal assertion as Humboldt's.", "verification": "OCR-only", "issue": "", "source_path": "sources/raw/gs-v-1906.pdf", "source_sha256": "4b9227f0d1ec7065a8c80df11031581399bef1962d085a4e267ba466ac58e17f", "reader": "early", "record_path": "sources/terminology/readings/early-evidence.json", "record_sha256": "3b816dc1a8c26dcdf3276d3610004bc806e50fc349285b1dc6ee17672c01495d", "claim_status": "provisional interpretation of cited source; not modern validation", "locator": "printed 378; PDF 388; §27", "statement": "Pleasure in speaking is made a more fundamental origin than instrumental need, and national speaking habits affect language formation.", "quote_status": "OCR-only"}

{"id": "prep:EARLY-11", "printed_page": 379, "pdf_page": 389, "section": "29", "terms": ["Individualitaet", "Ton", "Eigenthümlichkeit", "Gattung"], "quote": "In der Natur des Tones, als solchen, liegt endlich allein die wahre Individualitaet jeder Sprache. Was man thun und versuchen mag, ihre Eigenthümlichkeiten zu schildern, so bestimmt man nur immer näher und näher die Gattung, welcher sie angehört; als diese und keine andere Sprache spricht sie sich nur selbst vor dem Ohre aus.", "meaning": "Sound is said to bear the language's ultimate individuality, which descriptive classification never exhausts.", "implication": "Keep true individuality here; read with the express qualifications at §§49–50 rather than weakening it silently or letting it establish a sound-only essence.", "verification": "image-checked", "issue": "Image checked; whitespace normalized and typographic line-end hyphens removed; source spelling Individualitaet preserved.", "source_path": "sources/raw/gs-v-1906.pdf", "source_sha256": "4b9227f0d1ec7065a8c80df11031581399bef1962d085a4e267ba466ac58e17f", "reader": "early", "record_path": "sources/terminology/readings/early-evidence.json", "record_sha256": "3b816dc1a8c26dcdf3276d3610004bc806e50fc349285b1dc6ee17672c01495d", "claim_status": "provisional interpretation of cited source; not modern validation", "locator": "printed 379; PDF 389; §29", "statement": "Sound is said to bear the language's ultimate individuality, which descriptive classification never exhausts.", "quote_status": "image-checked"}

{"id": "prep:EARLY-12", "printed_page": 380, "pdf_page": 390, "section": "31", "terms": ["Denken", "Begriff", "Denkkraft", "Ich", "Du"], "quote": "der Mensch bedarf, abge-
  I sehen von allen körperlichen und Empfindungsbeziehungen, zum
     blossen Denken eines dem I c h entsprechenden D u , der Begriff
     erreicht seine Bestimmtheit und Klarheit erst durch das Zurück-
                  strahlen aus einer fremden Denkkraft.", "meaning": "A concept gains determinacy and clarity by being reflected back from another thinking power/person.", "implication": "Use concept for Begriff, capacity/power of thought for Denkkraft; retain another rather than alien/enemy for fremd here.", "verification": "OCR-only", "issue": "", "source_path": "sources/raw/gs-v-1906.pdf", "source_sha256": "4b9227f0d1ec7065a8c80df11031581399bef1962d085a4e267ba466ac58e17f", "reader": "early", "record_path": "sources/terminology/readings/early-evidence.json", "record_sha256": "3b816dc1a8c26dcdf3276d3610004bc806e50fc349285b1dc6ee17672c01495d", "claim_status": "provisional interpretation of cited source; not modern validation", "locator": "printed 380; PDF 390; §31", "statement": "A concept gains determinacy and clarity by being reflected back from another thinking power/person.", "quote_status": "OCR-only"}

{"id": "prep:EARLY-13", "printed_page": 382, "pdf_page": 392, "section": "33", "terms": ["Sprachkraft", "Kraft", "Individualität", "Gattung"], "quote": "Diese Kraft ist, wie jede, natürlich eine individuelle, aber nach
  allen den Gattungsbegriffen individualisirt, vermöge welcher jede
  Gattung gegen eine allgemeinere höhere als Individuum genommen
  werden kann.", "meaning": "Linguistic power is individual yet can be individuated at nested group levels.", "implication": "Use linguistic power/capacity consistently enough to preserve the argument; distinguish individual speaker from a group treated relatively as an individual.", "verification": "OCR-only", "issue": "", "source_path": "sources/raw/gs-v-1906.pdf", "source_sha256": "4b9227f0d1ec7065a8c80df11031581399bef1962d085a4e267ba466ac58e17f", "reader": "early", "record_path": "sources/terminology/readings/early-evidence.json", "record_sha256": "3b816dc1a8c26dcdf3276d3610004bc806e50fc349285b1dc6ee17672c01495d", "claim_status": "provisional interpretation of cited source; not modern validation", "locator": "printed 382; PDF 392; §33", "statement": "Linguistic power is individual yet can be individuated at nested group levels.", "quote_status": "OCR-only"}

{"id": "prep:EARLY-14", "printed_page": 383, "pdf_page": 393, "section": "34", "terms": ["Wesen", "Einheit", "Ansicht"], "quote": "wenn man das Menschengeschlecht als zahllose zu der-\n         selben Gattung gehörende Naturen, und nicht vielmehr als Eine\nin zahllose Individuen zerspaltene betrachtet, eine Ansicht,", "meaning": "Humboldt explicitly marks the claim of humanity as one nature divided into individuals as personal conviction, not confidently asserted general doctrine.", "implication": "Preserve the parenthetical epistemic qualification and metaphysical vocabulary; do not report this unity as an empirically established premise.", "verification": "OCR-only", "issue": "The selected quotation ends at a comma; OCR line-end hyphenation retained.", "source_path": "sources/raw/gs-v-1906.pdf", "source_sha256": "4b9227f0d1ec7065a8c80df11031581399bef1962d085a4e267ba466ac58e17f", "reader": "early", "record_path": "sources/terminology/readings/early-evidence.json", "record_sha256": "3b816dc1a8c26dcdf3276d3610004bc806e50fc349285b1dc6ee17672c01495d", "claim_status": "provisional interpretation of cited source; not modern validation", "locator": "printed 383; PDF 393; §34", "statement": "Humboldt explicitly marks the claim of humanity as one nature divided into individuals as personal conviction, not confidently asserted general doctrine.", "quote_status": "OCR-only"}

{"id": "prep:EARLY-15", "printed_page": 384, "pdf_page": 394, "section": "36", "terms": ["Sprachvermögen", "Sprachkraft", "Wachsen", "Lernen"], "quote": "Das
  Sprechenlernen der Kinder ist nicht ein Zumessen von Wörtern,
  Niederlegen im Gedächtniss, und Wiedernachlallen mit den Lippen,
  sondern ein Wachsen des Sprachvermögens durch Alter und
  Uebung.", "meaning": "Child language learning is described as growth of linguistic capacity rather than stored vocabulary plus repetition.", "implication": "Use growth/development of linguistic capacity, not acquisition of a fixed code; distinguish this source claim from any present-day acquisition theory.", "verification": "OCR-only", "issue": "", "source_path": "sources/raw/gs-v-1906.pdf", "source_sha256": "4b9227f0d1ec7065a8c80df11031581399bef1962d085a4e267ba466ac58e17f", "reader": "early", "record_path": "sources/terminology/readings/early-evidence.json", "record_sha256": "3b816dc1a8c26dcdf3276d3610004bc806e50fc349285b1dc6ee17672c01495d", "claim_status": "provisional interpretation of cited source; not modern validation", "locator": "printed 384; PDF 394; §36", "statement": "Child language learning is described as growth of linguistic capacity rather than stored vocabulary plus repetition.", "quote_status": "OCR-only"}

{"id": "prep:EARLY-16", "printed_page": 387, "pdf_page": 397, "section": "39", "terms": ["Weltansicht", "Eigenthümlichkeit", "Subjectivitaet"], "quote": "da nun auch auf die Sprache\nin derselben Nation eine gleichartige Subjectivitaet einwirkt, so\nliegt in jeder Sprache eine eigenthümliche Weltansicht.", "meaning": "A language's distinctive world-view arises from mutually related word effects and national subjectivity.", "implication": "Use distinctive view of the world/world-view for Weltansicht; do not substitute ideology, and preserve its linguistic and perceptual bearings.", "verification": "OCR-only", "issue": "", "source_path": "sources/raw/gs-v-1906.pdf", "source_sha256": "4b9227f0d1ec7065a8c80df11031581399bef1962d085a4e267ba466ac58e17f", "reader": "early", "record_path": "sources/terminology/readings/early-evidence.json", "record_sha256": "3b816dc1a8c26dcdf3276d3610004bc806e50fc349285b1dc6ee17672c01495d", "claim_status": "provisional interpretation of cited source; not modern validation", "locator": "printed 387; PDF 397; §39", "statement": "A language's distinctive world-view arises from mutually related word effects and national subjectivity.", "quote_status": "OCR-only"}

{"id": "prep:EARLY-17", "printed_page": 388, "pdf_page": 398, "section": "40", "terms": ["Sprache", "Sprechen", "Vorrath", "System", "Macht"], "quote": "Aus dem Sprechen aber erzeugt sich die Sprache, ein
  Vorrath von Wörtern und System von Regeln, und wächst, sich
  durch die Folge der Jahrtausende hinschlingend, zu einer von
  dem jedesmal Redenden, dem jedesmaligen Geschlecht, der
  Nation, ja zuletzt selbst von der Menschheit in gewisser Art
  unabhängigen Macht an.", "meaning": "A historically accumulating stock of words and rules grows from speaking and acquires relative independence from speakers.", "implication": "Let Sprache shift between language activity and historically available language where the argument explicitly does; do not replace every instance with speech or code.", "verification": "OCR-only", "issue": "", "source_path": "sources/raw/gs-v-1906.pdf", "source_sha256": "4b9227f0d1ec7065a8c80df11031581399bef1962d085a4e267ba466ac58e17f", "reader": "early", "record_path": "sources/terminology/readings/early-evidence.json", "record_sha256": "3b816dc1a8c26dcdf3276d3610004bc806e50fc349285b1dc6ee17672c01495d", "claim_status": "provisional interpretation of cited source; not modern validation", "locator": "printed 388; PDF 398; §40", "statement": "A historically accumulating stock of words and rules grows from speaking and acquires relative independence from speakers.", "quote_status": "OCR-only"}

{"id": "prep:EARLY-18", "printed_page": 391, "pdf_page": 401, "section": "45", "terms": ["Einheit", "Ursprache", "Element"], "quote": "Mit der in dem so eben aufgestellten Grundsatz ausgesprochenen 45.
Einheit mehrerer Sprachen ist keinesweges die Einheit einer Ur-
            sprache gemeint, sondern die, dass jede irgend ein Element in sich
trägt, das auch einer andren angehört, und weil dies der Fall bei
Allen ist, alle mittelbar durch einander verändert und betroffen
sind.", "meaning": "The unity claimed for connected languages means shared elements and indirect mutual effects, not one original language.", "implication": "Reserve original/primordial language for Ursprache and avoid genealogical paraphrases for this unity.", "verification": "OCR-only", "issue": "OCR line-end hyphenation retained in the quotation.", "source_path": "sources/raw/gs-v-1906.pdf", "source_sha256": "4b9227f0d1ec7065a8c80df11031581399bef1962d085a4e267ba466ac58e17f", "reader": "early", "record_path": "sources/terminology/readings/early-evidence.json", "record_sha256": "3b816dc1a8c26dcdf3276d3610004bc806e50fc349285b1dc6ee17672c01495d", "claim_status": "provisional interpretation of cited source; not modern validation", "locator": "printed 391; PDF 401; §45", "statement": "The unity claimed for connected languages means shared elements and indirect mutual effects, not one original language.", "quote_status": "OCR-only"}

{"id": "prep:EARLY-19", "printed_page": 393, "pdf_page": 403, "section": "47", "terms": ["Gleichartigkeit", "geschichtlicher Zusammenhang", "Anlagen"], "quote": "der Grundsatz
ausgesprochen ist, nach welchem der geschichtliche Zusammen-
         hang der Sprachen von derjenigen Gleichartigkeit unterschieden

term_sense.definition: A manner of inquiry from general principles, contrasted with attention to particular human speaking situations.

term_sense.definition: An impression/copy: a word is explicitly denied to be a copy of the thing in itself; it derives from the image produced in the soul.

term_sense.definition: Bare abstractness of thought contrasted with language’s uptake of the form of external reality.
term_sense.label: Bare abstractness of thought contrasted with language’s uptake of the form of external reality

term_sense.definition: Dependence of language on the speaker, considered together with its independence and inherited constraints.

term_sense.definition: Pure and complete discrimination of form from material content.

term_sense.definition: Wearing/grinding-down influence of native interaction on earlier imported foreign material.

term_sense.definition: Intentional calling, warning or summoning, distinguished from need and sheer pleasure in sounding.

term_sense.definition: Branching-off of a group or language, distinguished analytically from mixture.

term_sense.rule: Keep the claim of near-sound-filling use; do not substitute a modern category of discourse marker.

term_sense.definition: Thought as the breath/exhalation of living activity, unable to be fixed so as to destroy its capacity to pass into further forms.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use breath for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Utterance or stating as a condition attended to by the linguistic organization of the Periode.
term_sense.label: Aussage
term_sense.rule: Do not automatically make this a formal logical assertion with a specified truth status.

term_sense.definition: Elaboration of a concept along its many associative threads, offered as one possible source of multiple meanings.
term_sense.label: Elaboration of a concept along its many associative threads, offered as one possible source of multiple meanings
term_sense.rule: Retain the author’s critical qualification zu scharfsinnig.

term_sense.definition: Actual pronunciation, in which sound quantity is grounded and by whose laws accent is constrained.
term_sense.label: Actual pronunciation, in which sound quantity is grounded and by whose laws accent is constrained
term_sense.rule: Distinguish realized speech from written indication.

term_sense.definition: The construction/organization of a language, compared across languages and distinguished from their attained development.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use structure while keeping coordinated relations and operation visible; not a merely inert object.

term_sense.definition: Construction of language viewed as rising from its basic parts.
term_sense.label: Construction of language viewed as rising from its basic parts
term_sense.rule: The architectural metaphor does not establish a fixed modern modular architecture.

term_sense.definition: A language’s organized structure, approached through the pattern of construction.
term_sense.label: Bau
term_sense.rule: Preserve coordinated relations, not an inert anatomical inventory.

term_sense.definition: Scholarly treatment or further working of linguistic material, which may systematize as well as over-artificialize it.
term_sense.label: Scholarly treatment or further working of linguistic material, which may systematize as well as over-artificialize it
term_sense.rule: Keep scholarly treatment distinct from spontaneous living usage.

term_sense.definition: A word's meaning, whose evocation is distinguished from the further generative relation supplied by articulation.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use meaning here; neither local occurrence warrants the unrelated importance/significance gloss.

term_sense.definition: Meaning considered as a determinant of word formation in addition to sound changes.
term_sense.label: Meaning considered as a determinant of word formation in addition to sound changes
term_sense.rule: Distinguish semantic contribution from derivational sound resemblance.

term_sense.definition: Semantic contribution of individual words, distinguished from the sense of a whole expression.
term_sense.label: Bedeutung
term_sense.rule: Use meaning for the attested Bedeutung here.

term_sense.definition: Need, especially practical mutual assistance, rejected as the predominant explanation of language's origin.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use need for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Need for expression to which linguistic capacity is adequate.
term_sense.label: Need for expression to which linguistic capacity is adequate
term_sense.rule: Not a finite externally fixed list of concepts.

term_sense.definition: Fertilizing metaphor for intellect making existing sounds yield richer ideas.
term_sense.label: Fertilizing metaphor for intellect making existing sounds yield richer ideas
term_sense.rule: Not literal biological reproduction.

term_sense.definition: Grasping words/articulation, distinguished from merely responding to unarticulated sounds.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use grasping for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: A concept formed from the flow of representations and attaining determinacy and clarity through reflection from another thinking power.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Keep concept distinct from thinking, thought-content and representation.

term_sense.definition: The pure concept of language determining what may be said of the general process type.
term_sense.label: conceptual condition
term_sense.rule: Retain the conceptual standard; do not replace it by a historical average or ancestry.

term_sense.caution: Tesseract Begriii' is corrected from the image.
term_sense.definition: Concept receiving linguistic designation in the word, not a physical thing or the sound alone.
term_sense.label: conceptual unity designated by the word
term_sense.rule: The later text further qualifies completion and individual realization.

term_sense.caution: Do not make conceptual deduction certify an empirically unsupported universal.
term_sense.definition: A concept as an object of thought or determination, used both in deductions about grammar and for content expressed by words.
term_sense.label: Begriff
term_sense.rule: Use concept for what is philosophically determined in this concept/fact contrast.

term_sense.definition: Derivation purely from concepts, the stipulated route for fundamental grammatical determinations.
term_sense.label: Begriffsableitung
term_sense.rule: Distinguish conceptual deduction from historical reconstruction.

term_sense.definition: Designation of a concept through the particular motivating conception expressed by the word.
term_sense.label: Designation of a concept through the particular motivating conception expressed by the word
term_sense.rule: Do not reduce it to a mere arbitrary sound-label.

term_sense.definition: Designation of a concept, from which pure grammatical relation-indication must be distinguishable.
term_sense.label: Begriffsbezeichnung
term_sense.rule: Keep concept designation separate from relation designation and do not infer that all concepts are concrete things.

term_sense.definition: A delimitation whose determinate form permits rather than destroys the movement toward other forms.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use delimitation for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Delimitation of a presented object or conceptual content, here perceived as indefinite in a sound-symbolic example.
term_sense.label: Delimitation of a presented object or conceptual content, here perceived as indefinite in a sound-symbolic example
term_sense.rule: Do not turn the source’s sound symbolism into verified etymology.

term_sense.definition: Method of treating language as a dynamic process: physiological rather than anatomical.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use treatment for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: An individual's or nation's particular handling/use of language, through which change and innovation occur.
term_sense.label: handling of language
term_sense.rule: Use treatment/handling/use according to the bearer, not medical treatment.

term_sense.definition: The grammatical handling of words that constitutes their shared class status.
term_sense.label: Behandlung
term_sense.rule: Keep treatment as an operation on words, not the label assigned by a grammarian.

term_sense.definition: A mode of handling language that a writer can newly establish as an epoch.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use mode of treatment for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Admixture of other material in the gradual formation of new languages.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use admixture for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Being alive or animate as a feature drawn from apprehension of nature into language.
term_sense.label: Belebtseyn
term_sense.rule: This is the source’s natural-world input, not already a modern grammatical animacy feature.

term_sense.definition: Naming of particular newly discovered objects, distinguished from subtler conceptual modifications.
term_sense.label: Naming of particular newly discovered objects, distinguished from subtler conceptual modifications
term_sense.rule: Do not use it indiscriminately for all Bezeichnung.

term_sense.definition: Contact: inherited language meets the force of an individual generation; the opening also speaks of contact among peoples.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use contact for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The constitution of grammatical and lexical means investigated before their whole combined use.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use constitution for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Quality or characteristic, distinguished from an object and an action as a lexical source of designation.
term_sense.label: Quality or characteristic, distinguished from an object and an action as a lexical source of designation
term_sense.rule: Do not identify directly with adjective word-class.

term_sense.definition: General bodily quality concept used as material for designating other concepts.
term_sense.label: General bodily quality concept used as material for designating other concepts
term_sense.rule: Differentiate the concept from Beschaffenheitswort and a grammatical adjective.

term_sense.definition: Word expressing a quality; lexical conceptual source for designation and formation.
term_sense.label: Word expressing a quality; lexical conceptual source for designation and formation
term_sense.rule: Do not identify directly with a grammatically marked adjective.

term_sense.definition: Pure contemplation of an already present object, explicitly denied as an adequate account of any class of representation.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use contemplation for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The changing limitedness of human beings, contrasted with truth as unboundedly fixed.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use limitedness for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: A restriction potentially imposed by a determinate form but overcome through its relations to further forms.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use restriction for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: A possessive pronoun treated as tightly joined to its substantive in the cited language descriptions.
term_sense.label: Besitzpronomen
term_sense.rule: Use possessive pronoun for the attested Besitzpronomen here.

term_sense.definition: The grammatical and lexical components into which language can be analyzed, as distinct from their overall procedure.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use constituent for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Capacity for grammatical determination, whose poverty restricts freedom of period construction in Humboldt’s comparison.
term_sense.label: grammatical determinability
term_sense.rule: Distinguish determinability from already attained precision; preserve Humboldt’s evaluative claim.

term_sense.definition: The human being’s susceptibility to determination through the gradations of language.
term_sense.label: human susceptibility to linguistic determination
term_sense.rule: Not proof of absolute linguistic determination; distinguish this susceptibility from grammatical determinability in §132.

term_sense.definition: Determinacy of a concept, completed together with clarity through another thinker.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use determinacy for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Determinacy of thinking, contrasted elsewhere with unbounded or ambiguous conceptual content.
term_sense.label: Determinacy of thinking, contrasted elsewhere with unbounded or ambiguous conceptual content
term_sense.rule: Not grammatical definiteness of noun phrases.

term_sense.definition: Definiteness or precision of connected expression, paired with clarity.
term_sense.label: Bestimmtheit
term_sense.rule: Not causal determinism; no invariant psychological contrast with Klarheit is established.

term_sense.definition: Determination contained in a delimitation which calls up related forms and thereby overcomes restriction.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use determination for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: An individual's alleged original destination toward one language, contrasted with accidentally acquired another language.
term_sense.label: claimed linguistic affinity
term_sense.rule: Attribute this claim; do not turn it into a verified inherited language assignment.

term_sense.definition: Determination or specification of the principal concept by added conceptual material.
term_sense.label: specification of a concept
term_sense.rule: Do not equate all Bestimmung with an assigned dictionary definition.

term_sense.definition: A part’s determination or function within the analyzed period.
term_sense.label: Bestimmung
term_sense.rule: Keep the determination distinct from how visibly it is indicated; not necessarily a lexical definition.

term_sense.definition: Act or placement of prominence which groups adjacent syllables.
term_sense.label: Act or placement of prominence which groups adjacent syllables
term_sense.rule: Distinguish the realizing emphasis from written Accentzeichen.

term_sense.definition: Available manner of toning/accenting syllables in the Chinese inventory discussion.
term_sense.label: Available manner of toning/accenting syllables in the Chinese inventory discussion
term_sense.rule: Preserve the local Chinese context; not identical with word accent’s organizing function.

term_sense.definition: Inflectional sounds to which grammatical diversity would wrongly be reduced if supplied and intrinsic grammar were conflated.
term_sense.label: Beugungslaut
term_sense.rule: Do not let the audible exponent exhaust grammatical difference.

term_sense.caution: Historical source account, not modern confirmation of its acquisition claims.
term_sense.definition: Movement of the speech organs through which a deaf learner is said to apprehend articulation.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use movement for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Movement/action through which objects attract attention and receive designation.
term_sense.label: Movement/action through which objects attract attention and receive designation
term_sense.rule: Keep its conceptual role distinct from the resulting word class.

term_sense.definition: General bodily movement/action concept used to designate others.
term_sense.label: General bodily movement/action concept used to designate others
term_sense.rule: Keep conceptual source and linguistic realization separate.

term_sense.definition: Word expressing movement/action as a general conceptual source.
term_sense.label: Word expressing movement/action as a general conceptual source
term_sense.rule: Not automatically a grammatically classified verb.

term_sense.definition: Without reflective conscious awareness, through the operation of grammatically formed languages.
term_sense.label: bewusstlos
term_sense.rule: Not physically unconscious or devoid of mental activity.

term_sense.definition: Conscious awareness in which normally minute individual distinctions can become sharply apparent.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use consciousness for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Reflective consciousness contrasted with obscure feeling as routes through which patterned vocabulary can affect speakers.
term_sense.label: Reflective consciousness contrasted with obscure feeling as routes through which patterned vocabulary can affect speakers
term_sense.rule: Keep explicit awareness distinct from unreflective feeling.

term_sense.definition: Awareness or consciousness of thought’s laws, capable of degrees of clarity and not identical with explicit grammatical schooling.
term_sense.label: Bewusstseyn
term_sense.rule: Preserve degrees and the contrast with the subsequent unconscious operation; no modern consciousness theory is supplied.

term_sense.definition: To designate or indicate conceptual content through a word.
term_sense.label: To designate or indicate conceptual content through a word
term_sense.rule: Nominal Bezeichnung is a related but separate lexeme. The later text differentiates conceptual manner from sound choice.

term_sense.definition: To designate the grammatical relations by technical means, separately from the view of them and the sounds used.
term_sense.label: bezeichnen
term_sense.rule: Specify whether the object is a content concept or a grammatical relation; do not equate designation with meaning.

term_sense.definition: Concept used to designate another, distinguished from the concept to be designated.
term_sense.label: Concept used to designate another, distinguished from the concept to be designated
term_sense.rule: Keep the conceptual vehicle distinct from the designated concept.

term_sense.definition: What is designated, considered through its different temporal and spatial states.
term_sense.label: What is designated, considered through its different temporal and spatial states
term_sense.rule: Distinguish the designated object from its word and a speaker’s particular representation.

term_sense.definition: What is designated, put in place of a purely formal sign in the criticized procedure.
term_sense.label: Bezeichnetes
term_sense.rule: Keep designated content distinct from the act of designation and from the sign.

term_sense.definition: Designation: the merely labeling account of independently formed thought which the formative-organ argument rejects.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Preserve designation as a role, not a claim that words merely attach labels to finished thoughts.

term_sense.definition: The assignment of particular sounds to the expression of different concepts within a sound system.
term_sense.label: sound and concept
term_sense.rule: Keep the sound/concept relation distinct from pure imitation of things.

term_sense.definition: The manner in which a word indicates its concept to the hearer, including conceptual apprehension rather than sound choice alone.
term_sense.label: conceptual manner of indicating
term_sense.rule: Preserve the speaker/hearer asymmetry: designation for the hearer is apprehension from the speaker’s side.

term_sense.definition: Designation of grammatical relations, contrasted with missing or substantively mediated indication.
term_sense.label: Bezeichnung
term_sense.rule: Specify whether a relation is designated and by what means; do not use a blanket modern denotation/signification split.

term_sense.definition: Designation of content, here an action, as opposed to the verb’s grammatical connecting role.
term_sense.label: designation of semantic content
term_sense.rule: Do not translate every Bezeichnung as formal marking; identify whether content or relation is designated.

term_sense.definition: Manner of designation through related concepts, considered from subjective and objective sides.
term_sense.label: Manner of designation through related concepts, considered from subjective and objective sides
term_sense.rule: Not confined to choosing sounds.

term_sense.definition: A language’s manner of designation, potentially failing to separate grammatical form purely from content.
term_sense.label: Bezeichnungsart
term_sense.rule: Keep a mode of marking distinct from its individual sounds and from the relations meant.

term_sense.definition: Rule-governed ways of making lexical expressions, conventionally placed in grammars though they concern vocabulary formation.
term_sense.label: Rule-governed ways of making lexical expressions, conventionally placed in grammars though they concern vocabulary formation
term_sense.rule: Do not infer theoretical grammar membership from handbook placement.

term_sense.definition: Relation among concepts/things and to the understanding that thinks them.
term_sense.label: Relation among concepts/things and to the understanding that thinks them
term_sense.rule: Preserve the relation’s bearer; not merely a word’s etymological association.

term_sense.definition: A grammatical relation in which words are interpreted, fixed in some phrases by customary use.
term_sense.label: grammatical relation
term_sense.rule: Keep the grammatical relation distinct from its customary interpretation and from an overt marker; no invariant boundary from Verhältniss is asserted.

term_sense.definition: With respect to speech-connection: a framing relationship in the definition of a grammatical relation.
term_sense.label: with-respect-to construction
term_sense.rule: Render the prepositional expression as a respect or standpoint where appropriate, not as an additional marked grammatical relation.

term_sense.definition: Word expressing relation, considered both as the understanding’s activity and as a relation viewed in objects.
term_sense.label: Word expressing relation, considered both as the understanding’s activity and as a relation viewed in objects
term_sense.rule: Preserve the two viewpoints rather than force exclusive classification.

term_sense.definition: The image of a thing produced in the soul, of which the word is an imprint rather than a copy of the thing itself.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use image for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: An expositional image/outline of languages derived after detailed study, progressively individualized for the reader.
term_sense.label: exposition
term_sense.rule: Use picture/image for the comparative presentation, not a literal visual representation.

term_sense.definition: Sensory image/comparison through which sound may evoke a perceived property without making the whole word a symbol.
term_sense.label: Sensory image/comparison through which sound may evoke a perceived property without making the whole word a symbol
term_sense.rule: Not automatically a literal picture or an exhaustive concept.

term_sense.definition: Speech considered as an image of the objects and events it concerns.
term_sense.label: Bild
term_sense.rule: Keep the representational analogy, not a literal picture or an exhaustive copy.

term_sense.definition: Language's capacity to be shaped, partly restoring the balance against inherited language's power over individuals.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use plasticity for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Attained development of language stocks, distinguished from their construction and evaluated in stages.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Keep the developmental ranking explicit and distinct from structural organization.

term_sense.definition: Formation of a sentence as the upper point of stepwise empirical study from the sound element.
term_sense.label: formation of expression
term_sense.rule: Use formation for producing a linguistic structure, not education.

term_sense.definition: Gradual formation of nations through separation and cohesion, after which their distinctiveness becomes visible.
term_sense.label: historical formation
term_sense.rule: Retain the gradual collective process and do not imply deliberate invention.

term_sense.definition: Intellectual cultivation affected by how the sequence of thoughts appears in living delivery.
term_sense.label: intellectual cultivation
term_sense.rule: Distinguish human cultivation from forming a word.

term_sense.definition: Grammatical formation of speech’s parts, paired with their lawful freedom of combination.
term_sense.label: Bildung
term_sense.rule: Use grammatical formation here, not automatically education or general cultural cultivation.

term_sense.definition: Scientific grammatical education, expressly unnecessary for the unconscious effect of grammatically formed languages.
term_sense.label: grammatical education
term_sense.rule: Use grammatical education here; distinguish it from the grammatical formation of speech parts in §141.

term_sense.definition: General state of cultivation invoked alongside custom and way of life to explain differences in lexical elaboration.
term_sense.label: General state of cultivation invoked alongside custom and way of life to explain differences in lexical elaboration
term_sense.rule: Keep as historical evaluative vocabulary rather than a modern causal measure.

term_sense.definition: A stage of development on which a language may mix more or less non-ideational sounding with speech.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use stage of development for the defined local use.

term_sense.caution: Not a universal rejection of exceptive bis auf; occurrence-specific reading.
term_sense.definition: An endpoint phrase in the claim of freedom from foreign influence up to European subjugation.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use the temporal reading provisionally and record its scope with the subjugation boundary.

term_sense.definition: An explicit sometimes qualifying the false claim of identical structure.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use sometimes for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The lightning image for individual freedom suddenly stepping beyond presently determining influences.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use lightning flash for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Speech element situated by habitual fixation within a continuum of possible articulatory positions.
term_sense.label: Speech element situated by habitual fixation within a continuum of possible articulatory positions
term_sense.rule: Explain its spoken bearer; the claim is not that written characters lie in the organs.

term_sense.definition: A linking sound element inserted between closely connected words; discussed as arising among intermediate sounds.
term_sense.label: Buchstabe
term_sense.rule: Do not make the passage about written spelling merely because the word is Buchstabe.

term_sense.definition: Alphabetic writing which stabilizes analysis and transmission of sound relations without preserving the sound event itself.
term_sense.label: Alphabetic writing which stabilizes analysis and transmission of sound relations without preserving the sound event itself
term_sense.rule: Keep the written reminder distinct from living sound.

term_sense.definition: Alteration of adjacent speech elements under mutual influence, with a language-specific frequency and treatment.
term_sense.label: Alteration of adjacent speech elements under mutual influence, with a language-specific frequency and treatment
term_sense.rule: Do not read as replacement of written characters.

term_sense.definition: Change of individual speech elements used to signal conceptual distinctions.
term_sense.label: Change of individual speech elements used to signal conceptual distinctions
term_sense.rule: The operation may serve inflection here without being synonymous with every inflection.

term_sense.definition: Case category in the author’s note on alternate pronoun forms.
term_sense.label: Case category in the author’s note on alternate pronoun forms
term_sense.rule: Authorial example note; no new paradigm is inferred.

term_sense.definition: Case relations said to follow necessarily from the category of relation, distinct from additional cases requiring content concepts.
term_sense.label: Casus
term_sense.rule: Do not infer that the four cases must have overt endings in every language.

term_sense.definition: Case inflection as audible differentiation, whose absence leaves the intended relation to be mentally supplied.
term_sense.label: Casusbeugung
term_sense.rule: Keep the case relation distinct from its inflectional realization.

term_sense.definition: Case-marking components listed with articles and verbs as elements describable comparatively in monographs.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use case sign for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Causal verb class named through a suspended compound as an example of rule-based word formation.
term_sense.label: Causal verb class named through a suspended compound as an example of rule-based word formation
term_sense.rule: The list does not license an invented modern paradigm.

term_sense.definition: A named class of Indian speech sounds used to illustrate enlargement of an alphabet.
term_sense.label: A named class of Indian speech sounds used to illustrate enlargement of an alphabet
term_sense.rule: Retain the historical label or explain it cautiously; no automatic modern phonetic equation.

term_sense.definition: The felt and partly analysable overall character of a language, not exhausted by a list of elements.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use character for the felt overall language-character, preserving its relation to minute constituents without reducing it to their inventory or equating it with a later inner-form doctrine.

term_sense.definition: Characteristic balance of logical, sensory, and affective stimulation in a language and its literature.
term_sense.label: Characteristic balance of logical, sensory, and affective stimulation in a language and its literature
term_sense.rule: The text allows change; do not make it an immutable essence.

term_sense.definition: Characterizing languages through their distinctive properties, possible independently of settling influence upon mind.
term_sense.label: charakterisiren
term_sense.rule: Do not equate characterization with forcing languages into rigid classes or with asserting a fixed national essence.

term_sense.caution: Historical social grouping, not a fixed present scientific classification.
term_sense.definition: Classes within a national language whose common life produces distinctive dialects independently of descent.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use class for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Class under which the word gathers aspects or individuals of reality.
term_sense.label: Class under which the word gathers aspects or individuals of reality
term_sense.rule: Do not assume a grammatical word-class in this occurrence.

term_sense.caution: The difference of bearer and argumentative use does not justify inventing two unrelated lexical meanings.
term_sense.definition: A grouping by shared properties; word classes are required by common grammatical treatment, whereas fixed classes of whole languages are explicitly rejected.
term_sense.label: word classification
term_sense.rule: Identify the classified items: the text permits grammatical classes of words but rejects forcing living languages into fixed classes.

term_sense.definition: Classification of languages that cannot be established adequately by lists of technical devices alone.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use classification for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Classification of languages by word division, here the qualified monosyllabic/multisyllabic contrast.
term_sense.label: Classification of languages by word division, here the qualified monosyllabic/multisyllabic contrast
term_sense.rule: An analytic grouping whose facticity and boundaries are explicitly qualified.

term_sense.definition: Classifying concepts to disclose the language’s procedure of designation.
term_sense.label: Classifying concepts to disclose the language’s procedure of designation
term_sense.rule: Distinct lexeme from Classification, with a closely related local operation.

term_sense.definition: Colouring in painting used as an analogy for the richness or poverty of sounding in language.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use colouring for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Language as completing thought rather than merely transporting it.
term_sense.label: Complement
term_sense.rule: Avoid a merely optional addition to already complete thought.

term_sense.definition: Centering on language in the ideal of its full penetration of thought.
term_sense.label: Concentrirung
term_sense.rule: Not a narrow modern attention mechanism; it concerns language’s formal contribution to expression.

term_sense.definition: Conjugation listed among the grammatical means whose nature must first be studied before their use together.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use conjugation for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Conjugation effected through an auxiliary verb in the proposed descriptive solution.
term_sense.label: Conjugation
term_sense.rule: Distinguish the grammatical system of forms from any one sound or the verb’s conceptual content.

term_sense.definition: A numbered conjugational formation requiring particular content determinations, contrasted with necessary voice oppositions.
term_sense.label: Conjugationsform
term_sense.rule: Do not silently identify these numbered Arabic formations with modern paradigms.

term_sense.definition: Conjunctions named among grammatical words expressing a relation rather than substantive content.
term_sense.label: Conjunction
term_sense.rule: Use the grammatical label; do not add a modern exhaustive classification.

term_sense.definition: The named mood treated as the necessary opposite of the indicative.
term_sense.label: Conjunctivus
term_sense.rule: Retain the source’s label; do not silently replace it with Manchester’s conditional.

term_sense.definition: Consistency with which a language pursues its system.
term_sense.label: Consequenz
term_sense.rule: Not consequence as a resulting event.

term_sense.definition: Consonantal speech elements whose contact can trigger changes and constrain word structure.
term_sense.label: Consonantal speech elements whose contact can trigger changes and constrain word structure
term_sense.rule: This record preserves the source’s category without adding a modern articulatory inventory.

term_sense.definition: Logical organization of a word’s conceptual contribution, one of three aspects of its effect.
term_sense.label: Logical organization of a word’s conceptual contribution, one of three aspects of its effect
term_sense.rule: Not necessarily sentence syntax.

term_sense.definition: The organization or joining of speech whose pattern determines individual parts.
term_sense.label: linguistic construction
term_sense.rule: No modern Construction Grammar is implied.

term_sense.definition: Mathematical constructions used as an analogy for grasping ranges of possible cases without enumerating them individually.
term_sense.label: mathematical construction
term_sense.rule: Keep this mathematical analogy distinct from grammatical constructions.

term_sense.definition: The general organization of a language’s construction, abstracted from individual utterances.
term_sense.label: Constructionsbau
term_sense.rule: Keep the general pattern separate from a single instance of speech.

term_sense.definition: An arrangement of construction leaving combined material together rather than separating it into simple parts.
term_sense.label: Constructionsordnung
term_sense.rule: Use constructional arrangement for the attested Constructionsordnung here.

term_sense.definition: A regulated pattern permitting some connections as lawful and usual and excluding others.
term_sense.label: Constructionstypus
term_sense.rule: Keep the governing pattern distinct from the individual licensed constructions.

term_sense.definition: Continuous range of articulatory movements out of which particular sound positions are fixed.
term_sense.label: Continuous range of articulatory movements out of which particular sound positions are fixed
term_sense.rule: Different from a claim that a language has no sound distinctions.

term_sense.definition: Cultivation of language that can remove merely sound-filling words or refine them into finer nuances.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use cultivation for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Exposition of what has been learned, whose appropriate order differs from the order of empirical study.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Keep study and exposition distinct; general-first presentation does not authorize a priori empirical inquiry.

term_sense.definition: Presentation of thought by linguistic means, assessable beyond bare satisfaction of content.
term_sense.label: Presentation of thought by linguistic means, assessable beyond bare satisfaction of content
term_sense.rule: Not a transparent copy independent of the language.

term_sense.definition: The two modes of presentation, intrinsic and geographical/historical, differing in content and method while remaining connected.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use mode of presentation for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: A mode of presenting languages; the two distinguished modes are deliberately kept in connection.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use way of presenting for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The recorded/written product of intellectual activity, paired with what is spoken and distinguished from language's range of possible production.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use what is recorded for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: What is distinctive within shared likeness; general human linguistic power is individually determined rather than occupying a separate compartment.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use the distinctive for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The spoken and written result of intellectual activity, distinguished from the larger range of language's possible sounds and combinations.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use what is produced for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Foreign linguistic material which national individuality handles with its own power during mixture and reshaping.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use foreign material for the defined local use.

term_sense.caution: Do not turn this into an invariant opposition across Humboldt’s other uses of fremd or into a demand to make the English strange.
term_sense.definition: What belongs to the foreign original and should be felt through the translation without being obscured by the translation’s intrusive strangeness.
term_sense.label: the foreign element retained through translation
term_sense.rule: Keep the substantivized foreign element distinct from Fremdheit in the explicit contrast.

term_sense.definition: The indefinite whole language of which an articulated word presents itself as a part.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use the whole for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: A connected whole in which parts and divisions acquire their function.
term_sense.label: A connected whole in which parts and divisions acquire their function
term_sense.rule: Keep the relevant bearer explicit rather than infer a biological organism.

term_sense.definition: A whole closed through the stated network of governing dependencies, as opposed to unrestricted possible wholes of thinking.
term_sense.label: Ganzes
term_sense.rule: Keep the grammatical closure condition; do not assume that every whole of thought is a Periode.

term_sense.definition: What humans share and each individually determines, grounding both mutual understanding and the urge for completion through others.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use what is shared for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: What is distinct in another thinking power, serving as a test of one's inward products rather than merely repeating them.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use what is distinct for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The spoken product, paired with the recorded product and distinguished from the range language can produce.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use what is spoken for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The common element which becomes individually determined in character, not an independent layer beside distinctiveness.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use what is alike for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The like element in another thinking power which stimulates one's own, distinguished from the different element which tests one's inner products.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use what is alike for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The ideational side in which commonality must not be located exclusively, since individuality pervades all aspects of language.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use the ideational for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The immediate individual fact which analysis cannot fully represent, nevertheless to be grasped in unity with commonality.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use the individual for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The object-presenting side of the word, explicitly identified here with its matter.
term_sense.label: The object-presenting side of the word, explicitly identified here with its matter
term_sense.rule: Different from a claim of unbiased truth.

term_sense.definition: The poetic element in joyful sounding without need or intention, figured as a spark in animal dullness.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use the poetic for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The subjective side constituted by the faculties’ relation and unified cooperation.
term_sense.label: The subjective side constituted by the faculties’ relation and unified cooperation
term_sense.rule: Not merely optional personal opinion.

term_sense.definition: Dead inherited material over which living mental activity exercises some power, restoring balance against language's accumulated force.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use what is handed down for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: What is to be designated, whose conceptual emergence itself can depend on designation.
term_sense.label: What is to be designated, whose conceptual emergence itself can depend on designation
term_sense.rule: Do not assume its complete independence from language.

term_sense.definition: Language's peculiar existence, dependent on renewed thinking for validity yet independent in its historical totality.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use existence for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Existence independently of a sign, contrasted with the concept’s completion through the word.
term_sense.label: Existence independently of a sign, contrasted with the concept’s completion through the word
term_sense.rule: Do not infer this independence for every linguistic concept.

term_sense.definition: The external existence of languages independent of each current speaker, extending to their grammar.
term_sense.label: Daseyn
term_sense.rule: Use existence for the attested Daseyn here.

term_sense.definition: Intervention of an additional concept not contained in pure philosophical deduction, making a grammatical form only possible rather than strictly necessary.
term_sense.label: Dazwischenkunft
term_sense.rule: Keep conceptual mediation distinct from adding an overt linguistic sign.

term_sense.definition: Declension listed with conjugation, composition and derivation among grammatical/lexical means.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use declension for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Declension as the grammatical system in which the named case relations are distinguished.
term_sense.label: Declination
term_sense.rule: Keep the relation category separate from an individual inflected realization.

term_sense.definition: Declinable, here negated of words whose endings can nonetheless be traced to case inflections.
term_sense.label: declinirbar
term_sense.rule: Preserve the negation and the contrast between current indeclinability and the explanation of an ending.

term_sense.definition: Explicit definition contrasted with the word’s unitary indication of a concept.
term_sense.label: Explicit definition contrasted with the word’s unitary indication of a concept
term_sense.rule: A word does not simply recite its complete definition.

term_sense.definition: Thinking as a mental action and progressive inner development, leading through need for language to bodily action.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use thinking for ongoing mental action, distinct from a formed thought or concept.

term_sense.definition: Thinking as the activity from which linguistic expression proceeds and which it occasions again.
term_sense.label: Thinking as the activity from which linguistic expression proceeds and which it occasions again
term_sense.rule: Distinguish active thinking from the vocabulary as material.

term_sense.definition: Thinking as activity moving in originally given and habitual paths together with speaking.
term_sense.label: Denken
term_sense.rule: Distinguish the activity from a finished Gedanke, without making thought and language separable entities.

term_sense.caution: Denkenden is not an inflection of Sprechender. Do not turn these locally connected roles into mutually exclusive classes of people or assume a silent rather than speaking thinker.
term_sense.definition: The individual in whose mind the word is to become an object, produced by that individual and acting back upon them; the following sentence requires reality in a hearer who responds.
term_sense.label: the person thinking
term_sense.rule: Preserve the person denoted by the substantivized participle. Keep the thinker, word as object, and responding hearer distinct in the explanation.

term_sense.definition: Thought-form as contrasted with what specifically linguistic constructions add.
term_sense.label: Denkform
term_sense.rule: Keep the contrast with Sprachform; do not create an unsupported technical distinction from Gedankenform.

term_sense.definition: General law of thought invoked as the basis of grammatical, rather than individual lexical, analogy.
term_sense.label: General law of thought invoked as the basis of grammatical, rather than individual lexical, analogy
term_sense.rule: Do not infer that grammatical similarity alone proves historical relationship.

term_sense.definition: A law of thought to which the operation of grammar belongs, grounding the claim that grammar cannot be absent inwardly.
term_sense.label: Denkgesetz
term_sense.rule: Keep its asserted universality distinct from every language’s overt grammatical signs.

term_sense.definition: Another person's power of thought through which a concept is reflected back and gains determinacy.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use power of thought for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Power of thinking whose active direction restrains dwelling on obscure symbolic connections.
term_sense.label: Power of thinking whose active direction restrains dwelling on obscure symbolic connections
term_sense.rule: Distinct from imagination and symbolizing understanding.

term_sense.definition: Capacity for thinking, paired with capacity for feeling as a bearer of language's influence.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: The contracted printed Denk- is completed from the coordinated compound; do not invent an independent observed form.

term_sense.definition: The capacity for thought upon which grammatical forms are said to act.
term_sense.label: Denkvermögen
term_sense.rule: Not automatically identical to Verstand or a modern psychological test measure.

term_sense.definition: A way of thinking, coordinated with way of feeling as something affected by grammatical view.
term_sense.label: Denkweise
term_sense.rule: The print supplies Denk- as a coordinated ellipsis sharing -weise; no separate full spelling is claimed.

term_sense.definition: Clarity to which thinking cannot come without its required connection with sound.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use clarity for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Distinct intelligibility of a concept/expression impaired by irrelevant determinations.
term_sense.label: Distinct intelligibility of a concept/expression impaired by irrelevant determinations
term_sense.rule: Keep conceptual distinctness separate from acoustic audibility.

term_sense.definition: Clarity of connected expression sufficient in many practical and scientific matters.
term_sense.label: Deutlichkeit
term_sense.rule: Do not make this suffice for all the artistic and intellectual effects later attributed to form.

term_sense.definition: The later general Greek dialect is a context in which the dual is said to have disappeared.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use dialect for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: A language variety capable of enriching another variety and the general language.
term_sense.label: A language variety capable of enriching another variety and the general language
term_sense.rule: Not necessarily subordinate in expressive capability.

term_sense.definition: Alternative label for words indicating thought operations and relations.
term_sense.label: Alternative label for words indicating thought operations and relations
term_sense.rule: Not dialectal variation.

term_sense.definition: Poetic production contrasted with yet capable of joining abstract philosophy.
term_sense.label: Poetic production contrasted with yet capable of joining abstract philosophy
term_sense.rule: Do not collapse its distinctive conceptual/affective orientation into mere verse form.

term_sense.definition: Poetry as art through language, requiring rich and subtle linguistic resources.
term_sense.label: Dichtung
term_sense.rule: Not automatically all fiction or all invented utterance.

term_sense.definition: A counterexpectational/concessive link retaining likeness or a shared lower level despite differences.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Translate the relation expressed in the full clause, not one mechanical particle equivalent.

term_sense.definition: An inward drive to use speech organs in accordance with thinking, distinguished from the power to do so.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use drive for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: A chosen addressee standing opposite I in common action rather than merely one object among others.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Keep the I/Thou relation distinguishable from third-person objects.

term_sense.definition: You as the other pole of the reciprocal personal relation language adds.
term_sense.label: Du
term_sense.rule: Keep the paired I/you relationship; not a generic third-person other.

term_sense.definition: The dual named as a grammatical device lost in later general Greek; its disappearance illustrates change in technical means.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use dual for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The dual as an additional form for one specified number, contrasted with necessary plurality.
term_sense.label: Dualis
term_sense.rule: Keep the author’s necessary/contingent contrast; do not generalize an overt dual to every language.

term_sense.definition: The unalterable two-sidedness of language as address and response, grounded in the need for I and Thou.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use dualism for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Perceived dullness or muffled character of sound.
term_sense.label: Perceived dullness or muffled character of sound
term_sense.rule: Not conceptual stupidity in this occurrence.

term_sense.definition: Mental penetration/forming of sound through which it becomes articulated.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use permeation for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Penetration of thought by linguistic form, explaining its specifically linguistic effect.
term_sense.label: Durchdringung
term_sense.rule: Preserve the figurative interrelation without asserting two separately existing substances.

term_sense.definition: Insight into a language's nature that depends on presenting its procedure as a whole.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use insight for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Dynamic as opposed to static in the characterization of language; later used for individual freedom over conditioned language.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use dynamic for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Purely dynamic operation as the individual's power over language contrasted with language's physiologically conditioned operation over the individual.
term_sense.label: individual freedom
term_sense.rule: Preserve the local contrast; not modern physical dynamics.

term_sense.definition: Balanced proportion of rhythm and accent.
term_sense.label: Balanced proportion of rhythm and accent
term_sense.rule: Preserve the aesthetic evaluation.

term_sense.definition: Proper name, still said to gather temporal/spatial states under a general unity.
term_sense.label: Proper name, still said to gather temporal/spatial states under a general unity
term_sense.rule: Preserve the author’s claim about generality; not an imported present-day naming theory.

term_sense.definition: Concept of a property, named through a suspended compound in the inventory of lexical content.
term_sense.label: Concept of a property, named through a suspended compound in the inventory of lexical content
term_sense.rule: Not a grammatical adjective class by itself.

term_sense.definition: Class of possession/property expressions, later criticized as based on a particular factual relation rather than purely deducible categories.
term_sense.label: Class of possession/property expressions, later criticized as based on a particular factual relation rather than purely deducible categories
