term_sense.definition: A hearer whose active developing linguistic power responds to the speaker through a shared nature.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use hearer for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Hearer for whom a word’s apprehensional content functions as designation.
term_sense.label: Hearer for whom a word’s apprehensional content functions as designation
term_sense.rule: Do not presume passive reception of identical content.

term_sense.definition: Mutual practical assistance, rejected as the predominant need from which language arose.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use assistance for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Resources needed to study and check individual languages, especially grammars, dictionaries and collected materials.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use resources for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Auxiliary resources recruited by the mind when language-form contributes fewer of its own.
term_sense.label: Hülfsmittel
term_sense.rule: Do not make all compensating resources intrinsic overt grammar.

term_sense.definition: An auxiliary verb used to carry conjugation; adding be still leaves the same question about its verbal positing.
term_sense.label: Hülfsverbum
term_sense.rule: Do not treat the auxiliary as a solution to the infinite marking regress.

term_sense.definition: Auxiliary words as one device accompanying verbs, contrasted with inflected verbs in proposed feature classification.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use auxiliary word for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Inherited verbal shell repeatedly enlivened through actual thinking and speech.
term_sense.label: Inherited verbal shell repeatedly enlivened through actual thinking and speech
term_sense.rule: Keep the explicit metaphor and actual-use contrast.

term_sense.definition: The I distinguished from non-I and placed in a chosen reciprocal relation with a Thou.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Only indexical/theoretical I is terminological; ordinary authorial first-person uses remain ordinary.

term_sense.definition: I as one pole of the reciprocal personal relation language adds.
term_sense.label: Ich
term_sense.rule: Use this technical nominal I only here; ordinary authorial Ich elsewhere is not this term.

term_sense.definition: Pertaining to objects of thought as apprehended and connected through thought-units.
term_sense.label: Pertaining to objects of thought as apprehended and connected through thought-units
term_sense.rule: Not necessarily optimal or morally ideal.

term_sense.definition: Ideal or conceptual as the viewpoint of relations considered before technical means and sounds.
term_sense.label: ideal
term_sense.rule: Not necessarily ideal as perfectly good or normatively best; preserve the three-level contrast.

term_sense.definition: Ideal in the artist’s image of perfect form, used as an analogy for an inward linguistic pattern.
term_sense.label: idealisch
term_sense.rule: Do not simply identify the aesthetic ideal of perfection with ideale grammatische Ansicht.

term_sense.definition: An idea that can meet sound in genuine synthesis not further derivable by analytic explanation.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Do not automatically replace Idee with Begriff; preserve the local idea/sound contrast.

term_sense.definition: Ideal unity recognizable in a growing whole of phenomena and linguistic productions.
term_sense.label: Ideal unity recognizable in a growing whole of phenomena and linguistic productions
term_sense.rule: Do not equate every Idee mechanically with the lexeme Begriff.

term_sense.definition: An idea invoked in the comparison for how speech-form adheres to content without being that material content.
term_sense.label: Idee
term_sense.rule: Keep the comparative wie; do not impose a Kantian or Platonic technical definition or a fixed boundary from Begriff/Gedanke.

term_sense.definition: Pertaining to the world constituted in thought/language, placed in relation to the actual world.
term_sense.label: Pertaining to the world constituted in thought/language, placed in relation to the actual world
term_sense.rule: Distinct lexeme from ideal; not simply physically unreal in every sense.

term_sense.definition: Designation of ideas considered in relation to mere sounding, as colour is to painting.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use designation of ideas for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The author's own development of ideas through which he must supply the general conceptual framework lacking elsewhere.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use development of ideas for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Richness and depth of ideas achieved in words through active intellectual development.
term_sense.label: Richness and depth of ideas achieved in words through active intellectual development
term_sense.rule: Distinct from the number of word-sounds.

term_sense.definition: Material of ideas imagined as an object of merely dividing and analyzing, contrasted with lively conceptual production.
term_sense.label: Material of ideas imagined as an object of merely dividing and analyzing, contrasted with lively conceptual production
term_sense.rule: Occurs in a rejected image of how rich conceptual content arises.

term_sense.definition: Connection of ideas, here a practical/light mode in which a language’s orientation may keep thought.
term_sense.label: Connection of ideas, here a practical/light mode in which a language’s orientation may keep thought
term_sense.rule: Preserve the local evaluative qualification.

term_sense.definition: Identity of thinking and speaking invoked to justify expressive adequacy and continuing development.
term_sense.label: Identity of thinking and speaking invoked to justify expressive adequacy and continuing development
term_sense.rule: Not a claim that all speakers have identical individual representations.

term_sense.definition: Particular languages considered under general human language as species under a genus.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use idiom for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: A single-casting metaphor for the unified verbal form rather than an aggregate of separate feature-signs.
term_sense.label: in Einem Guss
term_sense.rule: Keep the unity of the verb, not a claim of mechanical fusion that abolishes all distinctions.

term_sense.definition: The totality/range of sounds and their lawful possible transformations which a specific intellectual activity can produce.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use totality for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The indicative as one pole of the author’s necessary mood opposition.
term_sense.label: Indicativus
term_sense.rule: Retain the author’s opposition without assigning all modern mood properties.

term_sense.definition: The position that contrasting modes of grammatical designation deserve equal grammatical valuation simply because relations can be understood.
term_sense.label: grammatischer Indifferentismus
term_sense.rule: Keep this a position being tested and rejected, not a statement that grammar is unimportant.

term_sense.definition: The language's singular identity said to be fully manifest only in its own sound rather than exhausted by classification.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Retain the emphatic sound claim and read it with §§49–50 rather than silently reducing or universalizing it.

term_sense.definition: Strict individuality located only in the present speaker; a nation's language is individual only comparatively.

term_sense.definition: Designation or marking of the plural, which may be omitted when number is already clear otherwise.

term_sense.rule: Distinguish the marking from plurality and from a particular plural sign.

term_sense.definition: A plural marker placed at a group boundary and applying to the group’s parts.
term_sense.label: Pluralzeichen
term_sense.rule: Use plural marker for the attested Pluralzeichen here.

term_sense.definition: The predicate joined with the grammatical subject in the active predicative presentation.
term_sense.label: Praedicat
term_sense.rule: Retain the subject–predicate relation; do not equate the label with every verb or with logical possibility alone.

term_sense.definition: Prepositions considered as relational uses of former substantives, often carrying case inflection in the cited Sanskrit account.
term_sense.label: Praeposition
term_sense.rule: Keep historical substantive origin distinct from present relational function; no modern Sanskrit analysis is certified.

term_sense.definition: A principle of freedom in individual human power over language, distinguished from language's conditioned force over humans.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use principle for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Community separating itself as a principle of language and dialect formation.
term_sense.label: collective formation
term_sense.rule: Preserve the named explanatory basis without converting it into a universal mechanism.

term_sense.definition: A principle grounding unity, here the thought-relation among a Satz’s parts.
term_sense.label: Princip
term_sense.rule: Identify what unity or operation it grounds; not an extra substantive constituent.

term_sense.definition: The common mental process repeated in each language, whose general type supplies the comparison point.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use process for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Language as the product through which the living individuality of a people can be studied.
term_sense.label: Product
term_sense.rule: Do not import a later technical Ergon opposition into this ordinary local use.

term_sense.definition: Pronoun as expressing the fundamental I/Thou relation through second versus third person distinctions.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use pronoun for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Pronoun category in the discussion of abbreviated versus full forms.
term_sense.label: Pronoun category in the discussion of abbreviated versus full forms
term_sense.rule: Do not infer that the abbreviated forms are proved exclusively enclitic; the note denies that certainty.

term_sense.definition: A pronoun that can stand for the word governed by a verb.
term_sense.label: Pronomen
term_sense.rule: Use pronoun for the attested Pronomen here.

term_sense.definition: A pronominal form common across languages in the author's claim, showing the need to distinguish an addressee from others.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use pronominal form for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Prose as a distinct kind of discourse with its own cultivated linguistic feeling.
term_sense.label: Prose as a distinct kind of discourse with its own cultivated linguistic feeling
term_sense.rule: Not defined here as merely absence of poetry.

term_sense.definition: Another thinker as a touchstone of the reality of inward productions, paired with stimulation from likeness.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use touchstone for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Sources for the projected inquiry: available collected resources together with prior preparatory works.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use source for the defined local use.

term_sense.caution: Historical label and argument; not certification of a modern racial taxonomy.
term_sense.definition: Racial distinctions in the historical vocabulary, said not to cancel humanity or reproductive continuity.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use races for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: General reasoning unsupported by examples, liable to overstatement, a danger Humboldt acknowledges in his whole-language claim.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use reasoning for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Physical roughness of speech organs or their sounds, distinguished from an intellectual impulse.
term_sense.label: Physical roughness of speech organs or their sounds, distinguished from an intellectual impulse
term_sense.rule: Historical physiological speculation, not a verified biological judgement.

term_sense.definition: Orthography as evidence by which deviations in transmitted pronunciation may be recognized.
term_sense.label: Orthography as evidence by which deviations in transmitted pronunciation may be recognized
term_sense.rule: Orthographic evidence is not identical with living pronunciation.

term_sense.definition: Discourse analyzed logically by general grammar into forms needed to connect thoughts; a product of language rather than its whole process.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use discourse for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Connected discourse whose divisions simultaneously reveal its construction as a whole.
term_sense.label: Connected discourse whose divisions simultaneously reveal its construction as a whole
term_sense.rule: Distinct from Sprache as language and from words abstracted from use.

term_sense.caution: Do not replace every Rede with one sentence or with an abstract system independent of speaking.
term_sense.definition: Speech in which the unity of a thought is expressed as a connected whole.
term_sense.label: Rede
term_sense.rule: Use connected speech where the unity and joining of an uttered thought are at issue.

term_sense.definition: Accent varying with the nature of the discourse; its habitual treatment remains characteristic of a language.
term_sense.label: Accent varying with the nature of the discourse; its habitual treatment remains characteristic of a language
term_sense.rule: Keep its variation in use distinct from fixed word accent.

term_sense.definition: The construction of connected speech, evaluated here in its Greek realization.
term_sense.label: Redebau
term_sense.rule: Retain the author’s comparative evaluation without adopting a modern hierarchy.

term_sense.definition: An element of connected speech differentiated in analyzing its construction.
term_sense.label: Redeelement
term_sense.rule: Use speech element for the attested Redeelement here.

term_sense.definition: Grammatical speech-form considered apart from material content and grasped by understanding in its lawfulness and imagination in its freedom.
term_sense.label: Redeform
term_sense.rule: Not a single inflection or an ordinary speech genre; preserve its formal organization and productive effect.

term_sense.definition: The grammatical joining of speech apprehended as a living inward pattern.
term_sense.label: Redefügung
term_sense.rule: Keep the joining distinct from a taxonomic type of languages.

term_sense.definition: Use or purpose of discourse for which a language provides fitting expressions.
term_sense.label: Use or purpose of discourse for which a language provides fitting expressions
term_sense.rule: Differentiate communicative purpose from mere historical word frequency.

term_sense.definition: Speaking as a human activity, expressly not a merely organic bodily operation in the strict sense.
term_sense.label: reden
term_sense.rule: Nominalized Reden here is activity; plural Reden on printed448 is instead an inflection of Rede.

term_sense.definition: The person speaking whose visible speech-organ movements are used in the historical account of deaf learners.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use speaker for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Speaking participant to whose intention accent belongs.
term_sense.label: Speaking participant to whose intention accent belongs
term_sense.rule: Do not merge the lexeme with Sprechender; the roles can coincide.

term_sense.definition: An expression or utterance whose sense can exceed the isolated word actually uttered.
term_sense.label: expression as a meaningful whole
term_sense.rule: Do not default to frozen idiom.

term_sense.definition: A habitual expression reproduced as one without attending to its component construction.
term_sense.label: habitual expression
term_sense.rule: Use fixed expression for the attested Redensart here.

term_sense.definition: A part-of-speech class whose words receive the same grammatical treatment.
term_sense.label: Redetheil
term_sense.rule: Distinguish the class from a semantic action or thing concept and from a class marker.

term_sense.definition: Combination of discourse opposed as form to words as matter, using both rules and sometimes its own sounds.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Do not equate it simply with rules or import a narrower modern syntax definition.

term_sense.definition: The connection of words into articulated whole speech, treated as grammar’s subject.
term_sense.label: Redeverbindung
term_sense.rule: Use speech-connection for the attested Redeverbindung here.

term_sense.definition: Rules apply both to word formation and to discourse connection, so rules versus sounds is not matter versus form.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use rule for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: A regular principle governing whether concept-classes are designated through composition or learned derivation, contrasted with chance.
term_sense.label: A regular principle governing whether concept-classes are designated through composition or learned derivation, contrasted with chance
term_sense.rule: A handbook’s rule is not itself proof of the proposed linguistic organization.

term_sense.definition: Grammatical rules as part of the externally sustained structure, although instantiated in living thought.
term_sense.label: Regel
term_sense.rule: Use rule for the attested Regel here.

term_sense.definition: Regularity of a rich patterned word-building system, affecting use and speakers’ feeling.
term_sense.label: Regularity of a rich patterned word-building system, affecting use and speakers’ feeling
term_sense.rule: Not a guarantee that every observed form follows one undivided rule.

term_sense.definition: System of formation rules distinguished from the actual sounds compared.
term_sense.label: System of formation rules distinguished from the actual sounds compared
term_sense.rule: A rule pattern is not identical with the particular word-sounds exemplifying it.

term_sense.definition: Governing words on which others immediately or mediately depend in the definition of a whole.
term_sense.label: regierende Worte
term_sense.rule: Not necessarily modern syntactic heads with a fixed formal theory.

term_sense.definition: A comparative index intended to restore some overview of each language after a thematically divided exposition.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use index for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Richness as capacity to satisfy expression, under which criterion languages are equally rich; the following pages distinguish other degrees and kinds.
term_sense.label: Richness as capacity to satisfy expression, under which criterion languages are equally rich; the following pages distinguish other degrees and kinds
term_sense.rule: Keep capacity for expression distinct from number and variety of word forms.

term_sense.definition: Grammatical richness evaluated against the contrasting apparent gain in pure intellectuality.
term_sense.label: Reichthum
term_sense.rule: Retain the grammatical bearer; not simply number of dictionary words.

term_sense.definition: Pure as qualifying the concept of language that supplies the general type independently of other individualizing circumstances.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use pure for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Purity of conceptual indication without extraneous determination.
term_sense.label: Purity of conceptual indication without extraneous determination
term_sense.rule: The local criterion concerns adequacy to the intended use.

term_sense.definition: Relation as the conceptual category invoked to derive the basic cases.
term_sense.label: Relation
term_sense.rule: Keep this philosophical category distinct from a case ending or an individual grammatical relation.

term_sense.definition: Rhythmic temporal ordering whose balance with accent may be disturbed by emphatic intellectual speech.
term_sense.label: Rhythmic temporal ordering whose balance with accent may be disturbed by emphatic intellectual speech
term_sense.rule: Keep distinct from accent, though their treatment interacts.

term_sense.definition: Poetic rhythm whose mere echo can generate a poem, illustrating form’s productive role.
term_sense.label: Rhythmus
term_sense.rule: Retain the capacity to prompt new creation, not merely decorate completed content.

term_sense.definition: Direction or orientation of intellectual activity contained even within the broad feeling under study.
term_sense.label: Direction or orientation of intellectual activity contained even within the broad feeling under study
term_sense.rule: Not merely physical movement.

term_sense.definition: Direction or orientation of thinking and speaking, one explication of form.
term_sense.label: Richtung
term_sense.rule: Do not turn a direction of activity into a substantive object.

term_sense.definition: Unrefined or uncultivated condition proposed as one possible obstacle to aesthetic treatment of speech.
term_sense.label: Unrefined or uncultivated condition proposed as one possible obstacle to aesthetic treatment of speech
term_sense.rule: Keep separate from physical Rauhigkeit and retain attribution.

term_sense.definition: Return influence of language’s form on thinking, distinguished from the immediate purpose of communicating thought.
term_sense.label: Return influence of language’s form on thinking, distinguished from the immediate purpose of communicating thought
term_sense.rule: Preserve the explanatory direction; not only external response.

term_sense.definition: The returning effect of objectified linguistic thought upon its subject.
term_sense.label: Rückwirkung
term_sense.rule: Keep return-effect distinct from only one-way external determination.

term_sense.definition: Original substantive meaning that can disappear so that a word functions only relationally.
term_sense.label: Sachbedeutung
term_sense.rule: Etymological origin alone does not settle current grammatical function.

term_sense.definition: Object/content concept whose word can be repurposed for grammatical indication.
term_sense.label: Object/content concept whose word can be repurposed for grammatical indication
term_sense.rule: Distinguish the earlier lexical source from its grammatical use.

term_sense.definition: A content-bearing concept used to express a grammatical relation, as in the back/behind illustration.
term_sense.label: Sachbegriff
term_sense.rule: Not necessarily a concrete physical object; keep conceptual content distinct from relation indicated as relation.

term_sense.definition: Neuter as the grammatical gender contrasted with feminine in the ship example.
term_sense.label: sachlich
term_sense.rule: Not factual, objective or matter-of-fact in this grammatical use.

term_sense.definition: Originally content-bearing words that can become genuine relation-words.
term_sense.label: Sachwort
term_sense.rule: Not restricted to nouns: the accompanying Chinese example is originally a verb.

term_sense.definition: Perceived softness of sound, paired with hardness.
term_sense.label: Perceived softness of sound, paired with hardness
term_sense.rule: Use the local sound quality contribution; preserve the stated contrast.

term_sense.definition: A sentence whose elements can be traced through many categories and relations to display the interdependence of language.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use sentence for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Sentence or clause as a unit contributing weight to the meaning of discourse.
term_sense.label: unit within discourse
term_sense.rule: Choose the syntactic/discourse unit by context, not an isolated word.

term_sense.definition: The author’s preceding propositions/assertions about languages’ expressive capacity.
term_sense.label: proposition or assertion
term_sense.rule: Not a count of finite clauses in this occurrence.

term_sense.caution: Use proposition only where a logical-judgement use is explicitly at issue, such as the separately recorded assertion use;§136 itself supplies no modern truth-condition definition. Preserve the contrast with Periode, and do not infer a new sense from printed448’s unresolved same-Satz phrase.
term_sense.definition: A simple or compound unit whose unity is supplied by relations of thought, distinguished from the Periode’s additional linguistic organization.
term_sense.label: Satz
term_sense.rule: Default to sentence with an explicit local Satz/Periode explanation: thought-relations give Satz its unity, whereas Periode adds linguistic organization. Reserve proposition for an explicitly logical context.

term_sense.definition: Continual creation through freedom in humanity and individuals, preventing exhaustive prediction or derivation of language's course.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use creating for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Creating sounds and concepts as distinguishable activities of linguistic growth, with different stated limits.
term_sense.label: Creating sounds and concepts as distinguishable activities of linguistic growth, with different stated limits
term_sense.rule: Do not merge sound-stock growth and conceptual development.

term_sense.definition: The transient acoustic occurrence to which a written sign refers.
term_sense.label: The transient acoustic occurrence to which a written sign refers
term_sense.rule: Do not imply that writing makes the acoustic event permanent.

term_sense.definition: Acuteness or ingenuity that may generate plausible but insecure interpretations of sound/meaning agreement.
term_sense.label: Acuteness or ingenuity that may generate plausible but insecure interpretations of sound/meaning agreement
term_sense.rule: Ingenuity is not source verification.

term_sense.definition: Dividing point at which internal sound-stock expansion gives way to more inward semantic treatment, expressly underdetermined by historical evidence.
term_sense.label: Dividing point at which internal sound-stock expansion gives way to more inward semantic treatment, expressly underdetermined by historical evidence
term_sense.rule: Preserve the author’s explicit evidential limit.

term_sense.definition: Analytical differentiation of parts that may remain fused in actual speech.
term_sense.label: Scheidung
term_sense.rule: Use separation for the attested Scheidung here.

term_sense.definition: An apparent object or dream image from which a word must be distinguished by gaining reality in a hearer and respondent.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use apparent object for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: A sketch of language in operation requiring a certain unity, distinguished from separately conducted grammatical monographs.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use description for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Resounding sound, sometimes without ideas or determinate semantic effect, distinguished from richer articulated expression.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use resounding for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Ringing/blaring vocal noise in the author’s list of sounds accompanying speech tones.
term_sense.label: Ringing/blaring vocal noise in the author’s list of sounds accompanying speech tones
term_sense.rule: Retain as a historical perceptual label, not an exact modern segment class.

term_sense.definition: Clicking/smacking noise named among accompanying vocal sounds.
term_sense.label: Clicking/smacking noise named among accompanying vocal sounds
term_sense.rule: Do not silently infer a full modern account of click consonants.

term_sense.definition: Rasping or rattling vocal noise named among accompaniments.
term_sense.label: Rasping or rattling vocal noise named among accompaniments
term_sense.rule: No modern phonetic equivalence is established here.

term_sense.definition: Limits of finitude within which freedom moves yet may become self-determining.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use limit for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Thought's natural lack of limits, preserved through forms that enable passage into further forms.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use unboundedness for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The animal cry demanded by feeling, one of the motives united in articulated sound.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use cry for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Writing that gives intellectual activity an enduring body and can keep dormant thoughts reawakenable across generations.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Distinguish writing from spoken activity and from language's renewed existence in thought.

term_sense.definition: Writing introduced as a condition of further systematization of an already spoken sound inventory.
term_sense.label: Writing introduced as a condition of further systematization of an already spoken sound inventory
term_sense.rule: Distinguish the written system from the prior sound relations.

term_sense.definition: A significant writer possessing an individual language and capable of marking new epochs in a language's treatment.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use writer for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Written signs whose chosen precision can act back upon pronunciation and become a real possession of the speaking community.
term_sense.label: Written signs whose chosen precision can act back upon pronunciation and become a real possession of the speaking community
term_sense.rule: A written sign is distinct from the sound whose articulation it helps fix.

term_sense.definition: Written shapes as one possible object of a speaker’s sensory representation on hearing a word.
term_sense.label: Written shapes as one possible object of a speaker’s sensory representation on hearing a word
term_sense.rule: One possibility in a question, not a universal account of word understanding.

term_sense.definition: Sharp determinacy of a word’s concept.
term_sense.label: Sharp determinacy of a word’s concept
term_sense.rule: Distinguish conceptual sharpness from literal sound intensity.

term_sense.definition: Creative power of mind manifested in forming new conceptual divisions; the compound continues with vermögen on p425.
term_sense.label: Creative power of mind manifested in forming new conceptual divisions; the compound continues with vermögen on p425
term_sense.rule: Do not silently merge the two page fragments into one page’s quotation.

term_sense.definition: The inward subject for which a thing becomes an object through a concept and the image produced by perception.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Preserve the local inward bearer without asserting a strict invariant faculty division from Geist.

term_sense.definition: The whole of mental powers involved in producing and understanding a word, including intellectual, sensory, and affective contributions.
term_sense.label: The whole of mental powers involved in producing and understanding a word, including intellectual, sensory, and affective contributions
term_sense.rule: Choose mind where soul would impose a religious doctrine; preserve the unified-powers account.

term_sense.definition: The inward human locus in which a grammatical view has its basis, posed as a problem of investigation.
term_sense.label: Seele
term_sense.rule: Do not claim that this question itself establishes a distinct psychological faculty.

term_sense.definition: The soul’s total power cooperating in the formation and effects of a word.
term_sense.label: The soul’s total power cooperating in the formation and effects of a word
term_sense.rule: The text resists treating the unified power as separable pieces.

term_sense.definition: Orientation or mood of the soul accompanying differing ways of speaking about one object.
term_sense.label: Orientation or mood of the soul accompanying differing ways of speaking about one object
term_sense.rule: Not only an isolated momentary emotion.

term_sense.definition: The word’s own motivating conceptual manner of designation, distinguishing expressions for the same object.
term_sense.label: The word’s own motivating conceptual manner of designation, distinguishing expressions for the same object
term_sense.rule: Distinguish historically recoverable motivation from what speakers still feel.

term_sense.definition: Introspection into what a word sensorially brings before the soul, made difficult because the observational intention changes its object.
term_sense.label: Introspection into what a word sensorially brings before the soul, made difficult because the observational intention changes its object
term_sense.rule: Do not present introspective data as transparent or invariant.

term_sense.definition: Self-determining freedom as it steps beyond currently determining external influences within finitude.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use self-determining for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Self-active, said of the subject as actively uniting predicate with itself.
term_sense.label: selbstthätig
term_sense.rule: Do not read it as merely independent of external causes or as modern free agency.

term_sense.definition: Inward self-activity on which understanding depends: conversation mutually awakens existing linguistic power.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use self-activity for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Language’s self-activity, obscured if its grammatical treatment is absorbed into logic.
term_sense.label: Selbstthätigkeit
term_sense.rule: Retain language’s activity; do not reduce the noun to the adjective for a grammatical subject.

term_sense.definition: Autonomous as qualifying power that can depart from or shorten the regular course of language formation.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Keep the independent power in the warning against mechanical derivation; not unrestricted arbitrary invention.

term_sense.definition: Independence of the word corresponding to the independent being it expresses.
term_sense.label: Independence of the word corresponding to the independent being it expresses
term_sense.rule: Not individual political autonomy.

term_sense.definition: Lowering of the voice, paired with raising.
term_sense.label: Lowering of the voice, paired with raising
term_sense.rule: Use the local prosody contribution; preserve the stated contrast.

term_sense.definition: Positing considered with being as something modified by mood, not independently supplied by a further sign.
term_sense.label: Setzen
term_sense.rule: Keep the operation or determination distinct from its audible designation and from spatial placement.

term_sense.definition: Being in itself, the investigation of which is named metaphysical and said to reach a limit of explanation.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use being for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Being considered in impersonal conceptual logic and as existential positing in the verb; neither is simply identical with an auxiliary word for be.
term_sense.label: Seyn
term_sense.rule: Identify the conceptual level: absolute being in logic or existential positing in grammar; do not replace either with an overt verb marker.

term_sense.definition: Manifestness of grammatical form in speech, supporting clarity of awareness.
term_sense.label: Sichtbarkeit
term_sense.rule: A visibility metaphor can concern audible speech; do not silently turn it into written orthography.

term_sense.definition: Meaning/content upon which sound-filling syllables or words have no determinate effect.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use meaning for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The senses for which intellectual activity becomes outwardly perceptible through speech sound.
term_sense.label: sensory faculties
term_sense.rule: Use senses for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The semantic content whose nuance changes, rather than a sensory faculty.
term_sense.label: meaning
term_sense.rule: Keep distinct from Sinn for language and bodily senses.

term_sense.definition: Discriminating aptitude or sense, here for subtle sound differences.
term_sense.label: discriminating aptitude
term_sense.rule: Distinct from the semantic sense of a word.

term_sense.definition: Sensory faculty of bodily perception, invoked in explaining finer sound sensitivity.
term_sense.label: bodily sensory faculty
term_sense.rule: The associated comparison of peoples is a historical authorial claim.

term_sense.definition: Sense or import apprehended in a complete expression.
term_sense.label: sense of an expression
term_sense.rule: Use sense for the attested Sinn here.

term_sense.definition: Receptive sense or sensibility stimulated by reality, distinct from the meaning of an expression.
term_sense.label: receptive sense
term_sense.rule: Do not use meaning in this receptive occurrence.

term_sense.definition: Sensory content named through the suspended compound Sinnen- und Gefühlsgehalt.
term_sense.label: Sensory content named through the suspended compound Sinnen- und Gefühlsgehalt
term_sense.rule: Preserve its qualified negation as material and retention as form.

term_sense.definition: Sensory as the aspect through which air's seeming incorporeality corresponds to mind.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use sensory for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Available to sensory powers, contrasted analytically with logical construction and feeling.
term_sense.label: Available to sensory powers, contrasted analytically with logical construction and feeling
term_sense.rule: Not modern sensual in the erotic sense.

term_sense.definition: Accessible in the sensible, audible material of language, distinguished from the user’s apprehension.
term_sense.label: sinnlich
term_sense.rule: Not necessarily sensual in an affective or sexual sense, and not the meaning Sinn of an expression.

term_sense.definition: Words related in meaning whose differences may arise from dialectal borrowing with associated concepts.
term_sense.label: Words related in meaning whose differences may arise from dialectal borrowing with associated concepts
term_sense.rule: Do not infer perfect equivalence from the relation.

term_sense.definition: The split within a subject by which representation becomes an object, insufficient for complete objectivity without another thinker.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use division for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: A domain in which Thou is distinguished from all objects by chosen common action.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use sphere for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Range or domain in which related positions or contents stand: a sound’s possible positions here, and a conceptual field in later use.
term_sense.label: range of possible sound positions
term_sense.rule: Keep range distinct from the sound fixed at one point.

term_sense.definition: A bounded range within which the limits of freedom's effects can be investigated.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use scope for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Spontaneity of choosing another as Thou rather than treating that other only as third-person non-I.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use spontaneity for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The word-level linguistic accent that can bind enclitic words rather than merely juxtaposing words through discourse accent.
term_sense.label: The word-level linguistic accent that can bind enclitic words rather than merely juxtaposing words through discourse accent
term_sense.rule: Check its local opposition to Redeaccent rather than invent a new independent accent system.

term_sense.definition: Analysis of language divided here into procedure and constituents rather than the inherited scope of general grammar alone.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use analysis of language for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Bodily and mental linguistic dispositions permitting variation within natural bounds.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use linguistic disposition for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: National dispositions in which the total sound system is said already to lie before writing refines its explicit arrangement.
term_sense.label: National dispositions in which the total sound system is said already to lie before writing refines its explicit arrangement
term_sense.rule: Do not equate with a modern biological mechanism.

term_sense.definition: Structure of language across parts in which a common orientation can recur.
term_sense.label: Structure of language across parts in which a common orientation can recur
term_sense.rule: Do not restrict to word morphology alone.

term_sense.definition: The structure of a language as an object of historical investigation with philosophically determined concepts.
term_sense.label: Sprachbau
term_sense.rule: Use language structure for the attested Sprachbau here.

term_sense.definition: A person's or nation's degree and kind of need for language, varying along with feeling for and treatment of language.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use need for language for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Handling or cultivation of language, especially writing in native languages and the interaction of several literatures.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use treatment of language for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Handling of language that can balance quantity/rhythm with accent.
term_sense.label: Handling of language that can balance quantity/rhythm with accent
term_sense.rule: Not a named grammar method or a writing convention.

term_sense.definition: Word considered abstractly as a constituent of language rather than a fully actual concept in a soul.
term_sense.label: Word considered abstractly as a constituent of language rather than a fully actual concept in a soul

term_sense.definition: A part of language whose relation to wholes is fluid: parts can become wholes and wholes parts through articulated organization.

term_sense.definition: An animal kind whose cries and tonal manners supply an analogy for distinctive linguistic sound systems.

term_sense.definition: A daughter language into which a supposed mother language transforms through separated and mixed generations.

term_sense.definition: Dead as qualifying inherited language material considered apart from its renewed animation in living use.

term_sense.definition: Sound with which intellectual activity must unite and which it forms into articulated speech.

term_sense.definition: The tone of personal conviction rather than confident universal assertion in which the unity-of-humanity claim is offered.

term_sense.definition: Audible sound which is to be separated from accompanying noise and made a true speech sound.

term_sense.definition: Sounds considered as physical material apart from speakers’ apprehension, contrasted with language understood through that apprehension.
term_sense.label: Ton

term_sense.definition: The characteristic manners of sound of animal kinds, compared with distinct sound systems in languages.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Do not assume musical key; inspect the mental/tonal manner phrase separately.

term_sense.definition: National handling of sounds as a factor in word formation, distinguished from meaning.
term_sense.label: National handling of sounds as a factor in word formation, distinguished from meaning
term_sense.rule: Ton is not necessarily pitch here.

term_sense.definition: Distinct unity of sound that identifies a word whole.
term_sense.label: Distinct unity of sound that identifies a word whole
term_sense.rule: This unity realizes rather than replaces conceptual unity.

term_sense.definition: Accentually organized sound-domain created by beginning a new prominence.
term_sense.label: Accentually organized sound-domain created by beginning a new prominence
term_sense.rule: Do not import a modern prosodic constituency model as an exact equivalence.

term_sense.definition: Feeling for sound in which a people's relatively fixed sound preferences are said to be deeply grounded.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use feeling for sound for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The sound system corresponding to intellectual activity, helping determine the laws of possible combinations and transformations.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use sound system for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Sound alteration in formation which need not itself introduce a semantic nuance.
term_sense.label: Sound alteration in formation which need not itself introduce a semantic nuance
term_sense.rule: Keep Ton distinct from pitch alone and sound change distinct from conceptual change.

term_sense.definition: A unified initial picture of all American languages intended to avoid scattered accounts of each language.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use overall picture for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: A total image of grammatical organization produced by imagination under linguistic constraints, rather than exhaustive counting.
term_sense.label: Totalbild
term_sense.rule: Not a claim that every possible construction has been enumerated.

term_sense.definition: The overall felt impression of language character, better conveyed by language samples than by isolated lists of constituents.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use overall impression for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The totality of language through which the same individuality extends from sounds to world-representation.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use totality for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The whole reality of a bodily object from which linguistic apprehension abstracts at one feature.
term_sense.label: The whole reality of a bodily object from which linguistic apprehension abstracts at one feature
term_sense.rule: Do not confuse the whole object with all its linguistically selected aspects.

term_sense.definition: Totality or exhaustiveness of possible grammatical combinations, unattainable by accumulating individual analyses alone.
term_sense.label: Totalitaet
term_sense.rule: Do not imply that a finite list of examples certifies the whole range.

term_sense.definition: A dream image as the model of an apparent object, distinguished from a word realized in another hearer/respondent.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use dream image for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The separation of individuality which through group divergence confronts the unity of human nature.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use separation for the defined local use.

term_sense.caution: OCR Wones corrected to Wortes.
term_sense.definition: Analytic separation of the word as sound from the word as concept, explicitly denied as a separation in nature.
term_sense.label: Analytic separation of the word as sound from the word as concept, explicitly denied as a separation in nature

term_sense.definition: Separation of concepts as one of logic’s operations, distinguished from their connection and derivation.
term_sense.label: Trennung
term_sense.rule: Identify the separated units; not deletion of words or necessarily a chronological breakup of language.

term_sense.caution: This is Humboldt’s Agamemnon policy, not a verified technical headword of Grundzüge or a command to copy German syntax. Do not identify it without argument with Nord’s later ethical loyalty.
term_sense.definition: The translation principle directed to the original’s true character rather than its accidental details at the cost of that character.
term_sense.label: faithfulness to the original’s character
term_sense.rule: Use faithfulness/fidelity in this translation-policy comparison; preserve its specified object, the original’s character.

term_sense.definition: Sound as bearer of thoughts when shaped through articulation.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use bearer for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The common pattern of the mental process of language, defined by the pure concept of language abstracting from individualizing circumstances.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Name the process bearer; not automatically a taxonomic language class or a single ancestral language.

term_sense.definition: Pattern or model of the Sanskrit sound inventory said to spread across other languages.
term_sense.label: Pattern or model of the Sanskrit sound inventory said to spread across other languages
term_sense.rule: Not automatically an entire language’s typological class.

term_sense.definition: An organizing pattern of construction from which characteristics of parts of speech are derived.
term_sense.label: Typus
term_sense.rule: Identify the bearer; not a taxonomic class of languages.

term_sense.definition: Mere sounding considered alongside idea-designation, connecting the animal component to articulated language.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use sounding for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Coordination of thinking and speech organs which Humboldt treats as a basis of linguistic ability.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use accord for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Agreement in thoughts and feelings which also involves divergence because each speaker understands individually.
term_sense.label: interpersonal agreement
term_sense.rule: Retain the qualified agreement rather than identity of inner thought.

term_sense.definition: Grammatical redundancy that can persist in a conventional expression.
term_sense.label: grammatische Ueberflüssigkeit
term_sense.rule: Use grammatical redundancy for the attested grammatische Ueberflüssigkeit here.

term_sense.definition: Transition from demonstrative pronoun to article, illustrating why presence of a technical form may be difficult to decide.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use transition for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: A gradual historical transition in a word’s shift from substantive content to relational function.
term_sense.label: Uebergang
term_sense.rule: Do not describe the functional shift as an instantaneous loss inferred solely from etymology.

term_sense.definition: Tradition as a possible source of knowledge of earlier states and wider historical connection.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use tradition for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Conviction strengthened through social communication, paired with its stimulation of thought.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use conviction for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Practice through which children's linguistic capacity grows, not mere repetition of memorized vocabulary.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use practice for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Practice of speaking through which the separation of words and expressions develops.
term_sense.label: Uebung
term_sense.rule: Not automatically institutional education or conscious grammatical drilling.

term_sense.definition: Extent or scope; here one meaning’s reach, elsewhere the range/count of available sound or word forms.
term_sense.label: Extent or scope; here one meaning’s reach, elsewhere the range/count of available sound or word forms
term_sense.rule: State what has the extent; broad scope does not imply several meanings.

term_sense.definition: Reshaping of sounds, distinguished from changes in subjective apprehension and broad meanings.
term_sense.label: Reshaping of sounds, distinguished from changes in subjective apprehension and broad meanings
term_sense.rule: Keep the historical change’s bearer explicit.

term_sense.definition: Intercourse/common life that can produce dialects without influence from common descent.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use interaction for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Possible transformations of speech sounds governed by laws arising from intellectual activity and its sound system.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use transformation for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Sensory wrapping through which intellectual content is appropriated in language.
term_sense.label: Sensory wrapping through which intellectual content is appropriated in language
term_sense.rule: Retain the metaphor and distinguish it from a complete independent concept merely dressed afterward.

term_sense.definition: The outer outline from which exposition begins after detailed study, before progressive individualization.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use outline for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Expression through several words rather than one word for the concept.
term_sense.label: Expression through several words rather than one word for the concept
term_sense.rule: The text allows equal communicative clarity while distinguishing broader intellectual effects.

term_sense.definition: To give an existing word a new conceptual impress or determination, rather than assign a new word to a fully ready-made concept.
term_sense.label: To give an existing word a new conceptual impress or determination, rather than assign a new word to a fully ready-made concept
term_sense.rule: Keep the metaphor and direction of conceptual development.

term_sense.caution: Authorial explanatory footnote citing Bopp; separate from the editor’s deletion note below.
term_sense.definition: Giving a root the formal status of a word; an impression/metaphor of stamping.
term_sense.label: Giving a root the formal status of a word; an impression/metaphor of stamping
term_sense.rule: Preserve the distinction between root and formed word.

term_sense.definition: Transformations of language’s subjective intellectual/affective orientation, potentially faster and stronger than sound change.
term_sense.label: Transformations of language’s subjective intellectual/affective orientation, potentially faster and stronger than sound change

term_sense.definition: Changes in national language through continuing common life, whose speed and character depend on interaction and depth of use.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use change for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Rule-governed alteration of existing word-sounds in productive lexical families.
term_sense.label: Rule-governed alteration of existing word-sounds in productive lexical families
term_sense.rule: Differentiate it from inventing entirely new unrelated sound forms.

term_sense.definition: Independence of language in relation to individual producers, inseparable from its dependence on renewed subjective production.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use independence for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Indeterminacy of conceptual limits or included determinations in lexical designation.
term_sense.label: Indeterminacy of conceptual limits or included determinations in lexical designation
term_sense.rule: Distinct from the breadth of one determinate meaning.

term_sense.definition: Unbounded continuation of conceptual creation contrasted with a limit to sound-stock creation.
term_sense.label: Unbounded continuation of conceptual creation contrasted with a limit to sound-stock creation
term_sense.rule: Not a quantified mathematical infinity proved in this passage.

term_sense.definition: Mathematical quantities treated as individually negligible, used as an analogy for very small expressive sacrifices.
term_sense.label: unendlich kleine Grössen
term_sense.rule: Retain the analogy; no measurement or independent mathematical account of expressive losses is established.

term_sense.definition: Infinity toward which thought strives beyond darkness and restriction, compared with the apparent unboundedness of air.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use infinity for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Indefinite/unbounded reach toward which linguistic thought strives beyond any single word.
term_sense.label: Indefinite/unbounded reach toward which linguistic thought strives beyond any single word

term_sense.definition: Noncorporeal content contrasted with bodily things in the matter of thought.
term_sense.label: Noncorporeal content contrasted with bodily things in the matter of thought

term_sense.definition: Air's apparent incorporeality, a sensory correspondence to mind in the argument for its suitability as speech material.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use incorporeality for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Irregular grammatical composition retained without component analysis in habitual expressions.
term_sense.label: Unregelmässigkeit
term_sense.rule: Use irregularity for the attested Unregelmässigkeit here.

term_sense.definition: Nonsensory conceptual content designated through bodily metaphors.
term_sense.label: Nonsensory conceptual content designated through bodily metaphors
term_sense.rule: Not senseless or meaningless.

term_sense.definition: Varied subtypes of a historically connected language formed through divergence and mixture.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use subtype for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: European subjugation as the temporal boundary to the opening's claimed absence of foreign influence.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use subjugation for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Proportioned subordination of concepts in the articulation of thought.
term_sense.label: Unterordnung
term_sense.rule: Do not automatically substitute a modern syntactic hierarchy or a social relation of subjection.

term_sense.definition: The proposed distinction between procedure and constituents, expressly not to be drawn too rigidly.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use distinction for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Original imperfection in an arrested-development interpretation explicitly rejected for monosyllabic languages.
term_sense.label: Original imperfection in an arrested-development interpretation explicitly rejected for monosyllabic languages
term_sense.rule: Do not convert the rejected characterization into an endorsed description.

term_sense.definition: Unlikeness among grammatical devices used as a basis of unsuccessful essential language classification.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use dissimilarity for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: A cause or motive of utterance, especially the need for conversational development of ideas and feelings.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use cause for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Cause with final and productive roles attributed to language in the ideal of pure linguistic form.

term_sense.definition: Cause whose role alternates with effect in the account of word formation and apprehension.
term_sense.label: Cause whose role alternates with effect in the account of word formation and apprehension
term_sense.rule: Not an independently established physiological mechanism.

term_sense.definition: An original language whose single or multiple existence Humboldt considers possible but not established or needed for explaining observed language phenomena.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Do not equate general human language or contact-connected unity with one original language.

term_sense.definition: The origin of American peoples and languages, left unspecified while their later internal history motivates continental study.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use origin for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Historical origin of the language or its forms, whose remoteness limits direct investigation.
term_sense.label: Historical origin of the language or its forms, whose remoteness limits direct investigation
term_sense.rule: Do not turn inaccessible beginnings into established reconstruction.

term_sense.definition: Relatively earlier or less transformed, expressly glossed here as retaining fewer traces of major upheaval.
term_sense.label: Relatively earlier or less transformed, expressly glossed here as retaining fewer traces of major upheaval

term_sense.definition: Originally or primordially given in the proposed natural order, rather than necessarily earliest historically attested.

term_sense.definition: Original or earlier in the semantic history of a word, potentially lost in its present relational use.

term_sense.definition: The faculty of judgment supporting the pure-thinking aspect of language, alongside understanding.

term_sense.definition: The fundamental I/Thou pattern of speaking expressed in second- versus third-person pronouns.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Do not render as proto-language or primordial language.

term_sense.definition: The original pattern of a language’s period construction resting in the mind and becoming conscious through use.
term_sense.label: Urtypus
term_sense.rule: Not a reconstructed proto-language or a natural class of languages; preserve the mental pattern and its realization.

term_sense.definition: A verbal ending named among group-final means of indicating grammatical relations.
term_sense.label: Verbalendung
term_sense.rule: Use verbal ending for the attested Verbalendung here.

term_sense.definition: A verbal form as a grammatical realization, which itself would require existential designation if every relation demanded a separate sign.

term_sense.definition: A word’s verbal status or nature as established either by grammatical designation or by customary use.
term_sense.label: Verbalnatur
term_sense.rule: Do not equate conventional verb use with an overt morphological verb marker.

term_sense.definition: The original verbal meaning of a word, potentially forgotten as it serves a relational function.
term_sense.label: Verbalsinn
term_sense.rule: Distinguish semantic content from Verbalnatur as current grammatical status.

term_sense.definition: The necessary connection of intellectual activity with sound, through which thought becomes clear and representation becomes concept.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use connection for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Historical connection between peoples through which already formed speech and linguistic elements pass and change.
term_sense.label: historical connection
term_sense.rule: Identify the historical/contact relation rather than a logical relation or demonstrated pure descent.

term_sense.definition: Combination of words in discourse, distinguished from formation of vocabulary.
term_sense.label: Combination of words in discourse, distinguished from formation of vocabulary
term_sense.rule: Name the bearer; conceptual combination and sound contact may also be discussed.

term_sense.definition: Connection among words or concepts, distinguished from the connected items and from their designation; its exact level depends on the context.
term_sense.label: Verbindung

term_sense.definition: A means of connecting a Satz; here the verb’s grammatical function rather than its action meaning.
term_sense.label: Verbindungsmittel
term_sense.rule: Keep the grammatical operation distinct from a merely content-bearing concept.

term_sense.definition: A connecting stroke used to show elements joined into the same word in the displayed notation.
term_sense.label: Verbindungsstrich
term_sense.rule: Use connecting stroke for the attested Verbindungsstrich here.

term_sense.definition: The relation in which the separated words are joined, made recognizable by their treatment.
term_sense.label: Verbindungsverhältniss
term_sense.rule: Use relation of connection for the attested Verbindungsverhältniss here.

term_sense.definition: Verb as a grammatical constituent; an inflected verb may perform the representation of a participle.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use verb for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Verb category, including forms that can be built lexically from a prior verb and a stem.
term_sense.label: Verb category, including forms that can be built lexically from a prior verb and a stem
term_sense.rule: Distinguish conceptual/lexical contribution from a category’s overt marking.

term_sense.definition: The verb considered as naming an action, distinguished from its specifically grammatical connecting function.
term_sense.label: verb as action designation
term_sense.rule: When the action-designation view is discussed, do not assume that semantic action-content itself establishes grammatical verb status.

term_sense.definition: The verb as the connecting means of the Satz, the specifically grammatical view.
term_sense.label: verb as grammatical connector
term_sense.rule: Preserve the distinction from action meaning; the author’s criterion is grammatical function.

term_sense.definition: The verb be added to another verb, considered as a possible grammatical auxiliary rather than a final solution to existential positing.
term_sense.label: Verbum seyn
term_sense.rule: Keep the word be separate from the conceptual Seyn it is supposed to make explicit.

term_sense.definition: Social association as the strongest means of approaching truth and measuring one's distance from it.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use association for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The overall way a language uses and treats its means, distinguished non-rigidly from its constituents.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use procedure or way of operating for how language coordinates and applies its means; preserve the expressly non-rigid opposition to constituents.

term_sense.definition: A choice of publication/expository procedure: present general conclusions before separate grammars and dictionaries.
term_sense.label: expository procedure
term_sense.rule: Do not turn an author's publication procedure into the language's internal activity.

term_sense.definition: Procedure of inquiry, here comparing designating and designated concepts in both directions.
term_sense.label: Procedure of inquiry, here comparing designating and designated concepts in both directions
term_sense.rule: Distinguish the analyst’s procedure from the language’s own way of forming expressions.

term_sense.definition: A manner of proceeding in analysis which can misrepresent a language if it conflates supplied and intrinsic grammar.
term_sense.label: analytical procedure
term_sense.rule: Distinguish the analyst’s method from a language’s own operation when the bearer changes.

term_sense.definition: A language’s overall grammatical way of proceeding, contrasted with treatment of individual grammatical parts.
term_sense.label: language’s grammatical procedure
term_sense.rule: Not merely the analyst’s list of forms or a fixed typological class.

term_sense.definition: A general manner of proceeding in grammatical designation, subject to many further determinations.
term_sense.label: Verfahrungsart
term_sense.rule: Not a complete language class defined by one procedure.

term_sense.definition: A mode of proceeding that defines form operationally.
term_sense.label: Verfahrungsweise
term_sense.rule: Retain the manner of operating rather than an inventory of outputs.

term_sense.definition: The forgetting of earlier substantive content in a grammatical word’s current relational use.
term_sense.label: Vergessenheit
term_sense.rule: Not an assertion of a conscious decision to erase meaning; the transition is historical and gradual.

term_sense.definition: Comparative study of language whose grammatical basis depends on distinguishing grammar in language from grammar supplied by users.
term_sense.label: vergleichendes Sprachstudium
term_sense.rule: Not only genealogical comparison or a fixed typological classification.

term_sense.definition: Comparison of language samples for their overall character, whose fruits still require detailed constituent analysis.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use comparison for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Comparison that must first establish internal word relations before direct cross-language comparison.
term_sense.label: Comparison that must first establish internal word relations before direct cross-language comparison
term_sense.rule: The same ordinary word is methodologically consequential here.

term_sense.definition: The necessary comparison point supplied by a conceptually defined general pattern of language's mental process.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use point of comparison for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: A language's relation to others and place within the larger field, which a successful character description should reveal.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use relation for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Interrelation or relational determination of concepts/things, viewed through the understanding’s activity.
term_sense.label: Interrelation or relational determination of concepts/things, viewed through the understanding’s activity
term_sense.rule: Avoid treating it as only physical proportion.

term_sense.definition: A relation connecting items; in §143 the spatial relation is extracted from a substantive concept, distinct from that content and its sign.
term_sense.label: Verhältniss
term_sense.rule: Distinguish a relation from the content concept, its word, and its audible designation.

term_sense.definition: A relative concept, here the notion of base word within historically bounded inquiry.
term_sense.label: A relative concept, here the notion of base word within historically bounded inquiry

term_sense.definition: Concept of a relation between things or concepts, contrasted with concepts of properties.

term_sense.definition: A relational concept alone, as the operative contribution of a former content word whose substantive meaning has disappeared.

term_sense.rule: Keep the conceptual contribution distinct from the physical word and from its historical substantive meaning.

term_sense.definition: Designation of a relation as relation, visibly distinct in the argument from designating a substantive concept.
