term_sense.rule: Do not equate the relation, its designation and the sound that carries the designation.

term_sense.definition: Relational word named in a suspended compound with Beziehungswörter.
term_sense.label: Relational word named in a suspended compound with Beziehungswörter
term_sense.rule: The relation can be viewed subjectively or objectively.

term_sense.definition: A relation-word needed to connect a substantive concept with its principal word, even when the concept itself stands for a relation.
term_sense.label: Verhältnisswort
term_sense.rule: Distinguish the relational word from the Sachbegriff it relates; do not equate mental requirement with an audible word.

term_sense.definition: Actual interaction of speakers through which similarities can be transmitted from already formed language.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Do not narrow automatically to commerce, transport or correspondence.

term_sense.definition: Linking several words by sound alteration and contraction across their contact.
term_sense.label: Linking several words by sound alteration and contraction across their contact
term_sense.rule: Keep audible linking distinct from grammatical or conceptual unity.

term_sense.definition: Chaining of words within which dependence on governing words can make a grammatical whole.
term_sense.label: Verkettung
term_sense.rule: Preserve the connected sequence without substituting a modern constituency theory.

term_sense.definition: Connection of thoughts in discourse, for which general grammar examines necessary word forms.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use connection for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Connection of concepts whose unity may not straightforwardly coincide with audible separation.
term_sense.label: Connection of concepts whose unity may not straightforwardly coincide with audible separation
term_sense.rule: Not evidence that every sound break is a separate concept.

term_sense.definition: Embodiment of an intellectual production which prompts a corresponding production in another.
term_sense.label: Embodiment of an intellectual production which prompts a corresponding production in another
term_sense.rule: Not transfer of the same physical or mental substance.

term_sense.definition: Mixture of nations paired with separation as a cause of divergence among their languages.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use mixture for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Mediator between opposed natures, the role assigned here to imagination.
term_sense.label: Mediator between opposed natures, the role assigned here to imagination
term_sense.rule: Keep the explicit referent Einbildungskraft; not a separate faculty.

term_sense.definition: Mediation by speech organs between mental striving and its outward acoustic material.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use mediation for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Mediation through sounds by which objects are made into thoughts.
term_sense.label: Mediation through sounds by which objects are made into thoughts
term_sense.rule: Do not equate medium and resulting conceptual content.

term_sense.definition: Mediation by factual concepts, contrasted with what can be derived purely grammatically from concepts.
term_sense.label: Vermittlung
term_sense.rule: Not merely a communicative medium; the mediation here qualifies conceptual deduction.

term_sense.definition: Capacity to turn heard material increasingly into understanding, paired with drive in the growth account.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use capacity here; distinguish it from the paired drive and from acquired material.

term_sense.caution: The bearers and English renderings are conditional; this does not establish a strict universal Kraft/Vermögen taxonomy.
term_sense.definition: Capacity or faculty: a mental power cooperating in word formation, and a language’s capacity to satisfy the need for expression.
term_sense.label: Mental capacity/power whose relation and cooperation constitute the subjective form of a word
term_sense.rule: Use faculties for the cooperating mental powers in§90 (p421), and capacity for a language’s ability to meet expressive need in§110 (p434). A capacity is not one actual act or its resulting content.

term_sense.definition: The capacity in the mind that forms language, not unconditionally ruled by language arriving from outside.
term_sense.label: Vermögen
term_sense.rule: Retain the denial of language’s unconditional domination; do not reduce capacity to its current exercise.

term_sense.definition: Hearing/perception of sound, analytically distinguished from the inward possibility of articulation.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use perception for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Reason shared with other humans, expressly distinguished from specifically linguistic ability in the account of deaf learners.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Keep reason and language ability distinct where the source does; do not infer a complete modern faculty system.

term_sense.definition: Synthesizing reason producing philosophically rich expressions, distinguished from technical construction by Verstand.
term_sense.label: Synthesizing reason producing philosophically rich expressions, distinguished from technical construction by Verstand
term_sense.rule: The etymological example Vernunft on p422 is cited-example use, not a competing faculty definition.

term_sense.definition: Language as an operation or performance rather than a ready-made material stock.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use operation for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: An operation or performance; speaking is expressly denied to be strictly a merely organic bodily operation.
term_sense.label: Verrichtung
term_sense.rule: Retain the denial that speaking is an organic operation in the strict bodily sense.

term_sense.definition: Diversity of kinds allowed within natural bounds by human bodily and mental linguistic dispositions.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use diversity in kind for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The small but pervasive difference between individual understandings of a word, recurring through each person's whole language.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use difference for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Diversity or difference of grammatical views and procedures among languages, beyond merely different sounds.
term_sense.label: Verschiedenheit
term_sense.rule: Identify what differs; do not reduce all diversity to sound, fixed classes or value ranking.

term_sense.definition: Running together or slurring sounds in continuous discourse, checked at pauses required by understanding.
term_sense.label: Running together or slurring sounds in continuous discourse, checked at pauses required by understanding
term_sense.rule: Preserve the contrast between sound continuity and intellectual segmentation.

term_sense.definition: Interweavings of thought whose course is marked by language and belongs to pure language-form’s domain.
term_sense.label: Verschlingung
term_sense.rule: Keep the metaphor of organized relations; not physical entanglement or proof of a modern recursive formalism.

term_sense.definition: Fusion of sound and concept constituting the word’s peculiar position between human and world.
term_sense.label: Fusion of sound and concept constituting the word’s peculiar position between human and world
term_sense.rule: Not a physical mixing of independent conceptual substances.

term_sense.definition: Reordering or transposition within word formation, paired with syllable repetition.
term_sense.label: Reordering or transposition within word formation, paired with syllable repetition
term_sense.rule: No specific modern metathesis rule is supplied.

term_sense.definition: Giving thought sensible embodiment, one condition added by specifically linguistic form.
term_sense.label: Versinnlichung
term_sense.rule: Not an assertion that thought is merely sensory matter.

term_sense.caution: Different activities of this faculty are retained as contextual uses, not counted as new lexical senses. The separate sense-of-expression idiom requires its own construction and context.
term_sense.definition: Understanding as an intellectual faculty engaged in analysis, distinctions and thought, locally contrasted with other faculties such as creative imagination or synthesizing reason.
term_sense.label: faculty of understanding
term_sense.rule: Prefer understanding where faculty contrasts matter. In im Verstande des Redenden the possessor identifies the speaker’s faculty; it is not the idiom in the sense.

term_sense.caution: The preposition im alone is not a diagnostic. Syntax, possessor and the surrounding argument decide the local use.
term_sense.definition: The meaning or interpretation in which something is taken, as in the strictest or proper sense, rather than the intellectual faculty of a person.
term_sense.label: sense or interpretation in a qualifying idiom
term_sense.rule: Use sense for the cited qualifying idioms im strengsten/eigentlichen Verstände. A possessed phrase such as im Verstande des Redenden refers instead to the speaker’s understanding.

term_sense.definition: The word’s intellectual content, united with sensory contribution in imagination’s sphere.
term_sense.label: The word’s intellectual content, united with sensory contribution in imagination’s sphere
term_sense.rule: Distinct from the faculty Verstand and its action.

term_sense.definition: The intellectual weight or contribution of words and syllables made more or less prominent in delivery.
term_sense.label: The intellectual weight or contribution of words and syllables made more or less prominent in delivery
term_sense.rule: Do not conflate the compound with the faculty Verstand or with acoustic volume alone.

term_sense.definition: The complete intellectual act of language contained in the word.
term_sense.label: The complete intellectual act of language contained in the word
term_sense.rule: Distinct from a static sound or written object.

term_sense.definition: The rule of understanding through which speech-form’s lawfulness is grasped, contrasted with imagination’s grasp of its freedom.
term_sense.label: Verstandesregel
term_sense.rule: Do not merge understanding’s rule with creative imagination.

term_sense.definition: Intelligibility of one's words tested with others, through which one comes to understand oneself.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use intelligibility for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Understanding as an inward activation of one's own linguistic power rather than passive reception.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Keep the hearer's self-activity and the explicit qualification by non-understanding; it is neither passive reception nor impossibility of communication.

term_sense.definition: Understanding which always includes non-understanding because individual concepts and feelings never coincide completely.
term_sense.label: qualified interpersonal understanding
term_sense.rule: Keep the explicit non-understanding qualification; do not imply that mutual understanding is impossible.

term_sense.definition: Understanding through overlapping thought-spheres, not exact identity of individual representations.
term_sense.label: Understanding through overlapping thought-spheres, not exact identity of individual representations
term_sense.rule: Do not imply transfer of an identical complete mental content.

term_sense.definition: Possibility of mutual understanding constraining how far a new expression or meaning may go beyond what is already understood.
term_sense.label: Possibility of mutual understanding constraining how far a new expression or meaning may go beyond what is already understood
term_sense.rule: Not agreement on all beliefs or identical representations.

term_sense.definition: Intelligibility of discourse, immediately affected by the sound system.
term_sense.label: Intelligibility of discourse, immediately affected by the sound system
term_sense.rule: Distinguish comprehensibility from complete identity of thought.

term_sense.definition: Intelligibility as the first, but not sole, aim of grammatical form.
term_sense.label: Verständlichkeit
term_sense.rule: Do not treat successful comprehension as exhausting form’s linguistic and creative effects.

term_sense.definition: Mutual understanding made possible by what human beings share.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use understanding for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Comprehension of connected speech, ideally guided by grammatical form rather than lexical sense alone.
term_sense.label: Verständniss
term_sense.rule: Distinguish comprehension of speech from Verstand as a faculty and from mere lexical guessing.

term_sense.definition: Attentive dwelling or deepening in one object, contrasted with rapid movement through linguistic sequences.
term_sense.label: Attentive dwelling or deepening in one object, contrasted with rapid movement through linguistic sequences
term_sense.rule: Not an automatic evaluative improvement.

term_sense.definition: Transformation of objects through language enabling mind to grasp their worldly connectedness.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use transformation for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Relationship among languages as an object chiefly of historical/geographical inquiry, not established by a feature inventory alone.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use relationship/affinity and identify the linguistic-historical or human-metaphysical relation; do not infer common descent from the noun alone.

term_sense.definition: Inner affinity of human beings explained by unity of essence rather than merely of a classificatory idea in Humboldt's qualified metaphysical claim.
term_sense.label: human affinity
term_sense.rule: Do not identify this metaphysical affinity with demonstrated language descent.

term_sense.definition: Kinship or affinity of sound which alone cannot distinguish historical connection from shared physical possibilities.
term_sense.label: sound affinity and possible historical relation
term_sense.rule: Keep acoustic resemblance separate from genealogical inference.

term_sense.definition: Obscure feeling of affinity between concept and sound that can guide without fixing one representation.
term_sense.label: Obscure feeling of affinity between concept and sound that can guide without fixing one representation
term_sense.rule: Do not turn felt affinity into proven historical kinship.

term_sense.definition: Fine grammatical articulations likened to branches within the formal pattern.
term_sense.label: Verzweigung
term_sense.rule: Not genealogical branching of language families or a modern syntactic tree theory.

term_sense.definition: Change in words/forms themselves or in differently modified use, two distinguishable kinds of language change.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use change for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Multiplicity of meanings, distinguished from extensive scope of one meaning; dictionaries can exaggerate it by mixing contextual uses.
term_sense.label: Multiplicity of meanings, distinguished from extensive scope of one meaning; dictionaries can exaggerate it by mixing contextual uses
term_sense.rule: Do not treat every contextual specification as an independent lexical sense.

term_sense.definition: Multiplicity within what is alike, creating the task of tracing shared and individual determinations.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use multiplicity for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Vocabulary learning as a comparison rejected for the self-accelerating growth of a child's linguistic power.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use vocabulary learning for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Vocalic sound that determines and can itself constitute a syllable.
term_sense.label: Vocalic sound that determines and can itself constitute a syllable
term_sense.rule: Do not read as a written vowel-letter only.

term_sense.definition: Vocalic ending bearing the Chinese intonation in the author’s explanatory note.
term_sense.label: Vocalic ending bearing the Chinese intonation in the author’s explanatory note
term_sense.rule: This is Humboldt’s historical analysis, not newly verified Chinese phonology.

term_sense.definition: Vowel sound considered with respect to its quantity and the inventory’s completeness.
term_sense.label: Vowel sound considered with respect to its quantity and the inventory’s completeness
term_sense.rule: The quantity contrast continues on p406; do not complete the quotation silently.

term_sense.definition: Series of vowels involved in patterned word changes.
term_sense.label: Series of vowels involved in patterned word changes
term_sense.rule: Do not impose an unmentioned reconstructed ablaut system.

term_sense.definition: Volitive verb class enumerated as productive lexical formation.
term_sense.label: Volitive verb class enumerated as productive lexical formation
term_sense.rule: Keep separate from causal verbs despite joint enumeration.

term_sense.definition: A people with its own language and sound system, distinguished from the language itself and from subgroups within it.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use people for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: A people as the collective bearer of reciprocal speaking and thinking in the author’s explanatory claim.
term_sense.label: Volk
term_sense.rule: Preserve reciprocity; do not turn this into independently established uniform psychology of every individual.

term_sense.definition: Popular varieties contrasted with a higher purified variety in the author’s evaluative discussion of affective expression.
term_sense.label: Popular varieties contrasted with a higher purified variety in the author’s evaluative discussion of affective expression
term_sense.rule: Retain attribution and historical evaluative framework.

term_sense.definition: A separated group of people that may mix with another beyond all previous indirect linguistic connection.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use group of people for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The complete living individuality of a people, contrasted with an abstract general concept of mind.
term_sense.label: Volksindividualitaet
term_sense.rule: Use individuality of a people for the attested Volksindividualitaet here.

term_sense.definition: A grouping of peoples in Humboldt’s developmental ranking of languages and communities.
term_sense.label: Volksstamm
term_sense.rule: Retain the historically evaluative framing; do not import a specific modern biological taxonomy.

term_sense.definition: Completeness/perfection reached by Greek general grammar in certain points, not the whole proposed science of language.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use perfection for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Completion of the concept through the word, grounding the argument against treating words as mere signs.
term_sense.label: Completion of the concept through the word, grounding the argument against treating words as mere signs
term_sense.rule: Does not mean a concept first existed fully independently and was then labeled.

term_sense.definition: Full development or perfection of grammatical forms, considered as an evaluative degree of realization.
term_sense.label: Vollendung
term_sense.rule: Not necessarily a dated endpoint or a universal linear evolutionary stage.

term_sense.definition: Greater completeness with which articulation evokes meaning, apart from its additional generative relation among words.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use completeness for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Completeness/perfection of a word-building system as assessed by the author.
term_sense.label: Completeness/perfection of a word-building system as assessed by the author
term_sense.rule: Retain its historical evaluative force; no modern ranking is certified.

term_sense.definition: Perfection of a language as Humboldt evaluates the operation of its specifically linguistic form.
term_sense.label: Vollkommenheit
term_sense.rule: Retain the evaluative claim as Humboldt’s; not neutral descriptive completeness or modern consensus.

term_sense.definition: Completeness of collected linguistic materials, acknowledged to be unattainable by the nature of the task.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use completeness for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Completeness of expressing the mutually related concepts belonging to a sphere.
term_sense.label: Completeness of expressing the mutually related concepts belonging to a sphere
term_sense.rule: Name the assessed sphere; not absolute completion of a living language.

term_sense.definition: Completeness of a thought as dependent on the determinations supplied by precise grammatical development.
term_sense.label: Vollständigkeit
term_sense.rule: Keep this as the author’s strong claim about thought, not merely grammatical well-formedness.

term_sense.definition: Added preceding sound in extending a word, paired with following Nachklänge.
term_sense.label: Added preceding sound in extending a word, paired with following Nachklänge
term_sense.rule: Keep this sound addition distinct from specifically syllabic Vorsilben; no modern affix inventory is inferred.

term_sense.definition: The stock of words accumulated from speaking, together with a system of rules becoming relatively independent of present speakers.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use stock for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Available stock of words treated in its meanings and mutual relations.
term_sense.label: Available stock of words treated in its meanings and mutual relations
term_sense.rule: Not a list whose entries can be assessed independently of use.

term_sense.definition: Addition before an existing word-sound in derivation.
term_sense.label: Addition before an existing word-sound in derivation
term_sense.rule: Not a proposal in this occurrence.

term_sense.definition: Added preceding syllable named through the suspended compound Vor- und Nachsilben.
term_sense.label: Added preceding syllable named through the suspended compound Vor- und Nachsilben
term_sense.rule: Not separately recovered as a candidate token; headword expands an actual suspended compound.

term_sense.definition: The moving activity of representing from which a concept separates and becomes an object to the subject.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use representing for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Activity of representing an object, whose freedom can be constrained by the word’s overt original motivation.
term_sense.label: Activity of representing an object, whose freedom can be constrained by the word’s overt original motivation
term_sense.rule: Distinct from the representation as a product.

term_sense.definition: Representation that cannot become a concept without thinking's connection with sound.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use representation where it can become a concept through the sound-linked process; distinguish representation, concept, object impression and word effect.

term_sense.definition: A representation formed through sensory activity and inner action, separating as an object and being taken back into the subject.
term_sense.label: subject–object formation
term_sense.rule: Preserve the synthetic sensory/inner formation rather than a mere copy of an already present object.

term_sense.definition: The individual representation of an object occasioned by a word, distinguished from the object itself.
term_sense.label: The individual representation of an object occasioned by a word, distinguished from the object itself
term_sense.rule: Do not silently translate as concept or physical image in all cases.

term_sense.definition: A mental representation of the possible infinite variety of grammatical arrangements, gained through broad use of a language.
term_sense.label: Vorstellung
term_sense.rule: Not necessarily a sensory picture or a fixed technical stage in a Kantian taxonomy.

term_sense.definition: The conception that language merely designates perceived objects, explicitly rejected as exhausting language's content.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use conception for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Characteristic manner of representing things supplied by language, distinguished from the sounds alone.
term_sense.label: Characteristic manner of representing things supplied by language, distinguished from the sounds alone
term_sense.rule: Keep intellectual presentation separate from acoustic form.

term_sense.definition: The way of representing that can remain participial although an inflected verb is used.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use way of representing for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Individual manner of representation both allowed and guided by the word.
term_sense.label: Individual manner of representation both allowed and guided by the word
term_sense.rule: Related to Vorstellungsart and Anschauungsweise, but keep the distinct lexeme.

term_sense.definition: Living manner of spoken delivery, an element of language beyond its detached dead constituents.
term_sense.label: Living manner of spoken delivery, an element of language beyond its detached dead constituents
term_sense.rule: Not necessarily a lecture as an institutional event.

term_sense.definition: Presentation or delivery in language, here as an art drawing upon imagination.
term_sense.label: Vortrag
term_sense.rule: Use delivery where the art of presenting is salient; not automatically a logical proposition or an oral lecture only.

term_sense.definition: A people-stock level in the nested determination of general linguistic power, prior to nation, dialect and individual.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use people stock for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Growth of linguistic capacity through age and practice, replacing the model of deposited words and lip repetition.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use growth for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Choice of an other as Thou, whose spontaneity distinguishes it from merely I versus third-person non-I.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use choice for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Truth as the unboundedly fixed goal which finite thinkers approach through social union and mutual testing.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use truth for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Perception of objects, necessarily mixed with subjectivity and entering word formation and conceptual content.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use perception for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Sensory perception from which a mentally formed word-object may be more or less independent.
term_sense.label: Sensory perception from which a mentally formed word-object may be more or less independent
term_sense.rule: Keep perceived object, mental representation, and concept analytically distinct.

term_sense.definition: Mutual relation of concepts filling a common sphere, potentially indicated in the expressions themselves.
term_sense.label: Mutual relation of concepts filling a common sphere, potentially indicated in the expressions themselves
term_sense.rule: Different from causal Wechselwirkung.

term_sense.caution: OCR-corrupted form requires image confirmation before use.
term_sense.definition: Mutual influence of neighbouring sounds which a language may attend to finely and subject to fixed rules.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use mutual influence for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Reciprocal action linking all parts of language and language with a nation, producing distinctive direction.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use reciprocal action for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Reciprocal influence between the spirit’s sound formation and sound’s effects on intellectual activity.
term_sense.label: Reciprocal influence between the spirit’s sound formation and sound’s effects on intellectual activity
term_sense.rule: Preserve both directions rather than a one-way determinism.

term_sense.definition: Reciprocal interaction, invoked in the personal relation and as a possible further case-relation.
term_sense.label: Wechselwirkung
term_sense.rule: Distinguish reciprocal relationship from a one-direction effect.

term_sense.definition: Awakening the linguistic power already in a hearer through mutual speaking, distinguished from depositing contents.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use awakening for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Female in the natural classification invoked to explain an English gender assignment.
term_sense.label: female classification
term_sense.rule: Keep the attributed natural sex apart from the feminine grammatical pronoun.

term_sense.definition: Feminine as the grammatical pronoun category applied even to a man-of-war.
term_sense.label: feminine grammatical gender
term_sense.rule: Use the grammatical gender label rather than implying the ship is literally female.

term_sense.definition: Mode or duration of dwelling within a sequence of representations, contrasted in symbolizing and linguistic activity.
term_sense.label: Mode or duration of dwelling within a sequence of representations, contrasted in symbolizing and linguistic activity
term_sense.rule: Not simply a measurable interval detached from the cognitive contrast.

term_sense.definition: Latitude within a word allowing different individual representations.
term_sense.label: Latitude within a word allowing different individual representations
term_sense.rule: Distinguish permissible individual variation from unlimited arbitrary sense.

term_sense.definition: The totality of perceived objects, not sufficiently characterized as objects merely designated by language.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use world for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: World as the total domain apprehended through language; the text distinguishes actual reality and language’s own ideal world.
term_sense.label: World as the total domain apprehended through language; the text distinguishes actual reality and language’s own ideal world
term_sense.rule: Keep external reality and its language-specific ordering distinct.

term_sense.caution: The uses do not imply identical beliefs or one ideology for all speakers. The later Weltansicht/Weltanschauung interpretive distinction is a control, not an invariant lexical law proved here.
term_sense.definition: A view/standpoint of the world belonging to an individual and further shaped and intensified through language; a language’s connected presentation can thus have its own distinctive world-view.
term_sense.label: view or standpoint of the world
term_sense.rule: Preserve the individual standpoint already possible independently of language in§39 and the additional contribution made by language. Keep individual and language bearers explicit.

term_sense.definition: Presentation of the world as a function of language alongside thinking.
term_sense.label: Weltdarstellung
term_sense.rule: Not an ideological doctrine or a ready-made inventory of external objects.

term_sense.definition: A continent as the geographical scope of comparison, whose languages do not thereby constitute one genealogical unit.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use continent for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The world-representation end of the whole language in which individuality extends from its alphabet/basic sounds.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Keep this observed expression distinguishable from Weltansicht unless a local reason warrants convergence.

term_sense.definition: A turn or formulation of expression through which the thought itself is modified.
term_sense.label: Wendung
term_sense.rule: Do not treat alternate wording as necessarily expressing one completely unchanged thought.

term_sense.definition: Language as the sensible instrument through which inward grammatical form unfolds.
term_sense.label: Werkzeug
term_sense.rule: Identify whether the local tool is language, a bodily organ or an instrument concept; not merely a device for transporting ready-made thoughts.

term_sense.definition: Language as an instrument whose form acts back on thinking.
term_sense.label: Language as an instrument whose form acts back on thinking
term_sense.rule: Keep its formative feedback as well as immediate communicative purpose.

term_sense.definition: Essence/nature in the qualified metaphysical claim that human beings are divided manifestations of one essence.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use essence for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: A being with the human's twofold bodily and mental nature united in one.
term_sense.label: human being
term_sense.rule: Use being for the entity; not essence in every occurrence.

term_sense.definition: A being/entity made by the inseparable unity of word-sound and concept.
term_sense.label: entity or being
term_sense.rule: Not merely a material object.

term_sense.definition: The full nature/constitution of an object, which a word cannot supply exhaustively.
term_sense.label: full nature or constitution
term_sense.rule: Distinct from a being/entity counted as one.

term_sense.definition: The essential constitution of language considered in the derivation of grammatical commonality.
term_sense.label: essential constitution
term_sense.rule: Not automatically a separate metaphysical substance; distinguish the count use meaning a being.

term_sense.definition: The whole human being in its capacity to be affected by language.
term_sense.label: individual being
term_sense.rule: Distinguish an individual being from Wesen as essence or constitution.

term_sense.definition: Reality/substantial standing of a word attained in a hearer/respondent, distinguishing it from an apparent or dream object.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use reality for the defined local use.

term_sense.caution: Attribution of Humboldt's claim; no independent biological verification.
term_sense.definition: Resistance alleged in modified speech organs when an acquired language interacts with ancestral dispositions.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use resistance for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: The apparent conflict of language's independence/dependence and foreignness/belonging, not solved by dividing it into separate portions.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use conflict for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Reproducing what is heard, presented as a possible competing account of children's adaptation to another people's language.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use reproduction for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Repeating with the lips as a rejected component of a mechanical deposit-and-repeat account of learning speech.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use parroting for the defined local use.

term_sense.caution: Retain the source's so-called qualification; not an endorsed present classification.
term_sense.definition: The source's qualified label for peoples whose abundant expressions and songs undermine a need-only origin story.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use so-called savages for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Dependent on choice or discretionary determination, contrasted here with quantity grounded in pronunciation.
term_sense.label: Dependent on choice or discretionary determination, contrasted here with quantity grounded in pronunciation
term_sense.rule: Choose by context; not every occurrence means random or careless.

term_sense.definition: Arbitrary or at discretion in the emergence of language, here denied by Humboldt’s claim of inner necessity.
term_sense.label: willkührlich
term_sense.rule: Do not silently equate this with a later doctrine concerning arbitrariness of signs.

term_sense.definition: Language's living operation as an integrated whole, requiring a unified description rather than disconnected constituent monographs.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use operation or working for integrated living activity; distinguish the operation from its effect and from the inherited stock it animates.

term_sense.definition: Actual realization of the capacity to produce an unlimited number of related articulated words.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use actuality for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: External reality whose form language should take into its own form in the author’s argument about lexical richness.
term_sense.label: External reality whose form language should take into its own form in the author’s argument about lexical richness
term_sense.rule: Distinct from the linguistic presentation or particular mental apprehension.

term_sense.definition: Reality from which humans are mediated by the world of sounds created in language.
term_sense.label: Wirklichkeit
term_sense.rule: Do not infer that the external world is denied or created from nothing.

term_sense.definition: Further intellectual activity to which the word’s embodied sound supplies material.
term_sense.label: Further intellectual activity to which the word’s embodied sound supplies material
term_sense.rule: Not merely a static store of content.

term_sense.definition: The effect of a grammatical form that can remain although the particular form disappears or is replaced.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Distinguish device, operation and effect; do not silently add a causal mechanism.

term_sense.definition: Effect which can in turn become a cause in reciprocal subjective word formation and use.
term_sense.label: Effect which can in turn become a cause in reciprocal subjective word formation and use
term_sense.rule: Keep reciprocal roles distinct from a single irreversible causal sequence.

term_sense.definition: Effect or action, inseparably joined with return-effect in the account of language’s production and influence.
term_sense.label: Wirkung
term_sense.rule: Preserve the reciprocal structure; not one-way determination or modern physical energy.

term_sense.definition: General grammar as an established organized inquiry, distinguished from the wider analysis demanded here.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use science for the defined local use.

term_sense.caution: This local function remains provisional; the short occurrence needs sentence-level judgment.
term_sense.definition: Modal/discourse qualification in claims about language resemblance; it does not by itself establish a repeated frequency.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Translate the local sentence relation; do not automatically repeat bisweilen's sometimes.

term_sense.definition: Pleasing audible quality of discourse, distinguished from its intelligibility and intellectual contribution.
term_sense.label: Pleasing audible quality of discourse, distinguished from its intelligibility and intellectual contribution
term_sense.rule: Retain its aesthetic contribution rather than treating it as mere ease of articulation.

term_sense.definition: A word born from subjective perception whose sound adds a third contribution to a concept beyond object impression and subjective reception.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Distinguish the word, the sound carrying it, its concept and the object; keep plural choices responsive to context.

term_sense.definition: An articulated word presented by its form as a part of an indefinitely generative whole language.
term_sense.label: generative articulation
term_sense.rule: Retain the word's internal elements and relations to further words rather than treating it only as an indivisible signal.

term_sense.definition: A linguistic individual uniting sound and concept; the simple word contains the complete intellectual action attributed to language.
term_sense.label: sound-concept linguistic individual
term_sense.rule: Retain Worte/Wörter as observed forms without importing a dictionary-only distribution.

term_sense.definition: The actual word is a current thought or spoken realization, contrasted with its inherited shell.
term_sense.label: word actualized in thought or speech
term_sense.rule: Preserve the distinction from a dead inherited form.

term_sense.caution: Do not reverse §129’s proposed whole-to-parts order or make dictionary isolation the word’s entire existence.
term_sense.definition: A word usable as an incomplete expression whose full sense must be supplied; words are also parts separated from connected speech.
term_sense.label: Wort
term_sense.rule: Use word as a separable component or an utterance capable of contextual completion.

term_sense.definition: Division of discourse into words as perceptible units.
term_sense.label: Division of discourse into words as perceptible units
term_sense.rule: Not necessarily written word spacing.

term_sense.definition: Accent belonging to the word and helping constitute it as a unit, rather than changing with the particular discourse.
term_sense.label: Accent belonging to the word and helping constitute it as a unit, rather than changing with the particular discourse
term_sense.rule: Use the local prosody contribution; preserve the stated contrast.

term_sense.definition: Organization of a language’s word formations revealed by internal analysis and comparison.
term_sense.label: Organization of a language’s word formations revealed by internal analysis and comparison
term_sense.rule: Use the local word formation contribution; preserve the stated contrast.

term_sense.definition: Word formation which has rules of its own, blocking an equation of words/matter with sounds alone.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use word formation for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Formation of words under a language’s rules and habits, not necessarily recovery of absolute origins.
term_sense.label: Formation of words under a language’s rules and habits, not necessarily recovery of absolute origins
term_sense.rule: Distinguish from combining existing words in discourse.

term_sense.definition: A class of words treated in accordance with the general organization of expression.
term_sense.label: Wortclasse
term_sense.rule: Keep the class distinct from its marker and from the semantic content of an individual word.

term_sense.definition: Breaks defined by words, compared with the breaks of rhythm.
term_sense.label: Breaks defined by words, compared with the breaks of rhythm
term_sense.rule: Distinguish word boundary from metrical boundary.

term_sense.definition: Division into words, contrasted with larger auditory grouping.
term_sense.label: Division into words, contrasted with larger auditory grouping
term_sense.rule: Use the local segmentation contribution; preserve the stated contrast.

term_sense.definition: Elements of words whose stock does not exhaust the broad mental process of language including its effect on thought and feeling.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use word element for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Word forms needed for connecting thoughts in discourse, examined by general grammar as only part of language.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use word form for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: A word form collected in grammatical investigation; inventorying forms is insufficient without a guiding organization.
term_sense.label: Wortform
term_sense.rule: Do not equate a list of word forms with the complete organization of a language.

term_sense.definition: Whole words regarded as units requiring their own audible unity.
term_sense.label: Whole words regarded as units requiring their own audible unity
term_sense.rule: Preserve the unity of each word rather than a loose collection of words.

term_sense.definition: The word’s content, of which accompanying feeling had so far been considered one part.
term_sense.label: The word’s content, of which accompanying feeling had so far been considered one part
term_sense.rule: Includes more than referential content.

term_sense.definition: A word group whose written sense can be understood before one is certain of its alphabetic composition, analogized with taking a word as an indivisible whole.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use word group for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: An internally closed grouping of words within a period, with restricted rearrangement.
term_sense.label: Wortgruppe
term_sense.rule: Use word group for the attested Wortgruppe here.

term_sense.definition: The content of the word as designated by its motivating properties or, if opaque, its articulated sound.
term_sense.label: The content of the word as designated by its motivating properties or, if opaque, its articulated sound
term_sense.rule: Distinct from the sound’s physical occurrence.

term_sense.definition: A word’s sounded form in families developed from one base sound.
term_sense.label: A word’s sounded form in families developed from one base sound
term_sense.rule: Not automatically a pitch value.

term_sense.definition: Inherited audible word forms which can remain relatively stable while their meanings shift.
term_sense.label: Inherited audible word forms which can remain relatively stable while their meanings shift
term_sense.rule: Not only the exact wording of a written passage.

term_sense.definition: Richness of vocabulary increased by productive word families as well as separate new expressions.
term_sense.label: Richness of vocabulary increased by productive word families as well as separate new expressions
term_sense.rule: Not only raw count of memorized words.

term_sense.definition: Separation into words, distinguished from a merely audible separation of component syllables.
term_sense.label: Separation into words, distinguished from a merely audible separation of component syllables
term_sense.rule: The text marks difficulty deciding its conceptual counterpart.

term_sense.definition: Word order considered as a possible grammatical indication only under a stringent fixedness and independent-anchor condition.
term_sense.label: Wortstellung
term_sense.rule: Retain all conditions, completed on printed 470: a fixed point must be recognizable independently of order.

term_sense.definition: The intended determinate manner of connecting words, which can have its own non-substantive sign.
term_sense.label: Wortverbindung
term_sense.rule: Keep the intended connection apart from its sign and from newly introduced substantive content.

term_sense.definition: Linking words through changes of speech elements, adding to Sanskrit’s complex sound system.
term_sense.label: Linking words through changes of speech elements, adding to Sanskrit’s complex sound system
term_sense.rule: Use the local sound operation contribution; preserve the stated contrast.

term_sense.definition: Simple base reached by analysis of more complex words; analysis does not recover an absolute beginning.
term_sense.label: Simple base reached by analysis of more complex words; analysis does not recover an absolute beginning
term_sense.rule: Do not imply that all historical originals were demonstrably monosyllabic.

term_sense.definition: Root word with both grammatical distribution and lexical derivational roles; not necessarily the universal origin of all other words.
term_sense.label: Root word with both grammatical distribution and lexical derivational roles; not necessarily the universal origin of all other words
term_sense.rule: Do not force every lexical item under assumed roots.

term_sense.definition: A dictionary prepared under shared principles alongside grammars to supply material for continuing language research.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use dictionary for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: An individual's own lexical selection through preferring, avoiding and excluding particular sounds/words.
term_sense.label: individual lexical selection
term_sense.rule: Preserve the metaphor of an individual dictionary rather than an actual published book.

term_sense.definition: Lexicographic work whose arrangement may wrongly present contextual meanings as an unordered plurality.
term_sense.label: Lexicographic work whose arrangement may wrongly present contextual meanings as an unordered plurality
term_sense.rule: Keep dictionary representation distinct from the language’s actual semantic structure.

term_sense.definition: Knowledge of isolated words, insufficient by itself for a language’s distinctive intellectual character.
term_sense.label: Knowledge of isolated words, insufficient by itself for a language’s distinctive intellectual character
term_sense.rule: Use the local method contribution; preserve the stated contrast.

term_sense.definition: Direct comparison of words, used when fuller structural evidence is unavailable but requiring investigation of each word’s origin.
term_sense.label: Direct comparison of words, used when fuller structural evidence is unavailable but requiring investigation of each word’s origin
term_sense.rule: Retain the methodological limitation rather than treating a lookup match as proof.

term_sense.caution: OCR Wörten'orrath corrected from image.
term_sense.definition: The vocabulary as available material of discourse and the accumulated material of a nation’s thought.
term_sense.label: The vocabulary as available material of discourse and the accumulated material of a nation’s thought
term_sense.rule: Not merely a list detached from use.

term_sense.definition: Stock of words whose productive formation is distinguished from connecting words in discourse.
term_sense.label: Stock of words whose productive formation is distinguished from connecting words in discourse
term_sense.rule: Closely related to Wörtervorrath; retain the observed compound form.

term_sense.definition: Translation of an expression’s elements separately, which may misrepresent the conventional whole.
term_sense.label: wörtliche Uebersetzung
term_sense.rule: Retain the warning about interpreting whole formulas through their elements.

term_sense.definition: Number as a verbal determination, distinct from its sound designation or a separately added counting word.
term_sense.label: Zahl
term_sense.rule: Do not equate number, plural marking and an explicit numeral.

term_sense.definition: A specified number receiving its own form in the dual, contrasted with general multiplicity.
term_sense.label: specified quantity
term_sense.rule: Keep a specified quantity distinct from the plural category and from the marker realizing it.

term_sense.caution: The expanded headword indexes the printed coordinated expression; it is not a separate fully spelled occurrence.
term_sense.definition: Designation of number among the verbal determinations, not the verbal whole itself.
term_sense.label: Zahlbezeichnung
term_sense.rule: Keep the determination and its designation separate. The coordinated shortened forms share the suffix bezeichnung in the print.

term_sense.definition: Subtlety or delicacy of mental and expressive response, among qualities attributed to linguistic cultivation.
term_sense.label: Zartheit
term_sense.rule: Not physical fragility or merely sentimental softness.

term_sense.definition: Signs or pictures used to express thoughts, distinguished in the historical deafness argument from understanding articulated language.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Do not equate the author's signs/pictures with a contemporary signed-language category.

term_sense.definition: Written reminder of a speech sound.
term_sense.label: written reminder-sign
term_sense.rule: Differentiate this ordinary reminder-sign from the later argument about words as signs.

term_sense.definition: A sign standing for what can exist independently of it; contrasted with a word whose concept receives completion through it.
term_sense.label: sign with independently existing designated content
term_sense.rule: A word may serve a sign’s purpose without being reducible to this relation.

term_sense.caution: Empty is the source’s description in this polemic, not a claim that speakers cannot understand or that all signs lack contribution.
term_sense.definition: A sign contrasted with substituting what is designated for it; the immediately parallel phrase contrasts putting a concept in place of form.
term_sense.label: empty sign contrasted with designated content
term_sense.rule: Preserve both parallels in§141. The formal reading is supported by this local opposition, not by importing§147’s strict criterion into the fragment.

term_sense.definition: A word considered as a sign for concepts and objects from the dictionary standpoint used in the comparison.
term_sense.label: lexical sign under dictionary abstraction
term_sense.rule: Retain the analytic dictionary standpoint; this is not a blanket equation of every living word with a detachable label.

term_sense.definition: Time in which an action occurs, invoked to motivate a verbal tense determination.
term_sense.label: Zeit
term_sense.rule: Do not collapse the time of an action, the concept of futurity and its grammatical designation.

term_sense.caution: The expanded headword indexes the printed coordinated expression; it is not a separate fully spelled occurrence.
term_sense.definition: Designation of time among the verbal determinations, not the verbal whole itself.
term_sense.label: Zeitbezeichnung
term_sense.rule: Keep the determination and its designation separate. The coordinated shortened forms share the suffix bezeichnung in the print.

term_sense.definition: Chronological succession of languages, which must not be neglected but must not be assumed where origins are unknown.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use chronological sequence for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Syllabic temporal quantity, subsequently grounded in pronunciation rather than arbitrary assignment.
term_sense.label: Syllabic temporal quantity, subsequently grounded in pronunciation rather than arbitrary assignment
term_sense.rule: Keep distinct from accent and from calendar time.

term_sense.definition: To decompose or analyze; here mechanically brooding over idea-material is rejected as the source of rich language.
term_sense.label: To decompose or analyze; here mechanically brooding over idea-material is rejected as the source of rich language
term_sense.rule: Distinct lexeme from Zergliederung; preserve whether the activity is endorsed or criticized.

term_sense.definition: Analysis into parts necessary to convert felt individuality into knowledge but unable fully to preserve the living whole.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use analysis for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Analytic decomposition of complex words into simpler roots or constituents.
term_sense.label: Analytic decomposition of complex words into simpler roots or constituents
term_sense.rule: Analysis does not prove an absolute historical beginning.

term_sense.definition: Analytical articulation of existing languages into their parts and relations.
term_sense.label: Zergliederung
term_sense.rule: Use analysis for the attested Zergliederung here.

term_sense.definition: Separation of articulated sound into articulation and audible component, used in the historical deafness argument.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use separation for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Fragmentation of what is said about an individual language when divided across comparative topics, which the initial whole-sketch seeks to avoid.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use fragmentation for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Breaking the whole of speech into words for grammatical analysis.
term_sense.label: Zerschlagung
term_sense.rule: Retain the force of analysis from a whole, not physical destruction.

term_sense.definition: Cutting sounds into separate syllables, invoked for a proposed effect on thought’s flow.
term_sense.label: Cutting sounds into separate syllables, invoked for a proposed effect on thought’s flow
term_sense.rule: Retain the evaluative claim as Humboldt’s, with its qualifications.

term_sense.definition: Generative intellectual production embodied in a word and renewed in another speaker.
term_sense.label: Generative intellectual production embodied in a word and renewed in another speaker
term_sense.rule: Preserve the metaphor without biological literalization.

term_sense.definition: Hissing noise named in the author’s account of accompanying sound.
term_sense.label: Hissing noise named in the author’s account of accompanying sound
term_sense.rule: Retain the evaluative account as the author’s, not present-day acoustic classification.

term_sense.definition: Contingent rather than necessary by pure conceptual deduction; here a particular number receives its own form.
term_sense.label: conceptually contingent
term_sense.rule: Not random or uncaused; distinguish the argument’s level of necessity.

term_sense.definition: External contingencies that combine with inward dispositions to modify an individual's linguistic use.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use contingency for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Futurity extracted from another expression and mentally supplied as a verbal determination.
term_sense.label: Zukunft
term_sense.rule: Keep the future concept apart from a future-tense exponent.

term_sense.definition: Measuring out/apportioning words, a rejected model of children's learning contrasted with growth of capacity.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use apportioning for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Reflection back of a concept from another thinking power, completing its clarity and determinacy.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use reflection back for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Thinking several words together as though one, allowing habitual whole expressions.
term_sense.label: Zusammendenken
term_sense.rule: Use thinking together for the attested Zusammendenken here.

term_sense.definition: Coincidence/coming together of sensory and nonsensory contribution, expressly different in word and symbol.
term_sense.label: Coincidence/coming together of sensory and nonsensory contribution, expressly different in word and symbol
term_sense.rule: Do not treat both relations as an identical fusion theory.

term_sense.caution: The printed parallel uses a different mixing expression. Do not substitute it into this sentence or infer a revision chronology. The infinitive is an editorial lookup lemma; the attested form is zusammengeflossen.
term_sense.definition: Different languages have come together within the same continent; the statement does not itself require the languages to have blended into one.
term_sense.label: geographical convergence of different languages
term_sense.rule: Use converge in§1; keep the geographical grouping distinct from an asserted mixing of the languages.

term_sense.caution: Humboldt’s analysis and historical example are retained as source claims. The difference lies in the local relation, not in an invariant ban on translating this verb with a mixing-related expression.
term_sense.definition: In the discussion of lexical richness, a language such as English is described as having flowed together from different languages, leaving expressions with different origins.
term_sense.label: a language formed through confluence of others
term_sense.rule: Here the language itself is the result of confluence; do not carry over§1’s merely geographical grouping as a universal sense.

term_sense.definition: Combination of basic parts into wholes which tend to become parts of further wholes, common to mental form and articulation.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use combination for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Putting discourse together, another domain in which the same subjective linguistic orientation appears.
term_sense.label: Putting discourse together, another domain in which the same subjective linguistic orientation appears
term_sense.rule: Differentiate discourse combination from lexical formation.

term_sense.definition: Composition or joining of speech from words, contrasted methodologically with analyzing a prior whole.
term_sense.label: Zusammenfügung
term_sense.rule: Use joining together for the attested Zusammenfügung here.

term_sense.definition: Holding together/cohesion combined with separation as principles in gradual national formation.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use cohesion for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Historical connection among languages distinguished from likeness due merely to shared human capacities.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Keep historical connectedness distinct from a presumed single original language.

term_sense.definition: The tight interconnection of parts within language and of language with nation, through which distinctive world-view arises.
term_sense.label: internal interdependence
term_sense.rule: Identify internal/reciprocal relations rather than automatically historical contact.

term_sense.definition: Internal connection of words through formation and sound patterns, to be established before interlanguage comparison.
term_sense.label: internal relation of a linguistic system
term_sense.rule: Not simply surrounding text.

term_sense.definition: Contextual connection of concepts that forces a more specific reading than a word’s simple lexical sense.
term_sense.label: context determining interpretation
term_sense.rule: Do not turn every context-induced reading into a new dictionary sense.

term_sense.definition: Contextual connection contributing to comprehension alongside word order and particles.
term_sense.label: contextual connection
term_sense.rule: Keep contextual recovery distinct from specifically grammatical marking.

term_sense.definition: The interconnection or coherence of a language’s organized whole, distinct from immediate semantic context.
term_sense.label: systemic interconnection
term_sense.rule: Do not force context as the English equivalent when the entire system is the bearer.

term_sense.definition: Semantic connection arising from substantive meaning, able to replace grammatical form as an aid to comprehension.
term_sense.label: Zusammenhang des Sinnes
term_sense.rule: Do not equate recovery by semantic coherence with the full formal effect attributed to genuine grammar.

term_sense.definition: Composition listed with derivation as a means of language and considered also in changes and ordering of words.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use composition for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Word formation joining several concepts into a new one or specifying a principal concept.
term_sense.label: Word formation joining several concepts into a new one or specifying a principal concept
term_sense.rule: Keep conceptual combination distinct from sound contact alone.

term_sense.definition: The composition of a habitual expression from its words, no longer attended to in ordinary use.
term_sense.label: Zusammensetzung
term_sense.rule: Use composition for the attested Zusammensetzung here.

term_sense.definition: Coordinated operation of the linguistic process as a whole, the object of the proposed broader analysis.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use coordinated operation for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Contraction accompanying sound alteration in the linking of words.
term_sense.label: Contraction accompanying sound alteration in the linking of words
term_sense.rule: Do not assume it produces one conceptual word.

term_sense.definition: Contraction of concepts, a tendency Humboldt judges not always expedient in Sanskrit.
term_sense.label: Zusammenziehung
term_sense.rule: Keep the qualification not always expedient; do not invent a precise morphological operation.

term_sense.definition: The configuration of grammatical parts so they fit into the period’s structure.
term_sense.label: Zuschnitt
term_sense.rule: Keep the fitting relation of parts to the whole, not merely their external shape.

term_sense.definition: Reliability of evidence disclosing a word’s original motivation, limiting historical inference.
term_sense.label: Reliability of evidence disclosing a word’s original motivation, limiting historical inference
term_sense.rule: Ingenuity and imagination must not substitute for secure traces.

term_sense.definition: Concession acknowledging that alleged sameness and radical difference disappear under deeper inquiry before retaining broad likeness.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Keep its paired concessive relation to aber rather than forcing an isolated word.

term_sense.definition: Discourse as the purpose of language that grounds the division between its elements and their combination.
term_sense.label: local sense
term_sense.rule: Use purpose for the defined local use.

term_sense.definition: Fitness to a logical purpose in choosing rule-governed formation and expressing related conceptual classes.
term_sense.label: Fitness to a logical purpose in choosing rule-governed formation and expressing related conceptual classes
term_sense.rule: Evaluative criterion, not empirical certification.

term_sense.definition: Intermediate connecting sounds arising within whole speech on both sound-side and logical grounds.
term_sense.label: Zwischenlaut
term_sense.rule: Use intermediate sound for the attested Zwischenlaut here.

term_use.definition: A manner of inquiry from general principles, contrasted with attention to particular human speaking situations.
term_use.label: a priori
term_use.rule: Use a priori for the attested a priori here.

term_use.definition: Divergence or deflection of meanings, compared with less frequent sound divergence.
term_use.label: Divergence or deflection of meanings, compared with less frequent sound divergence
term_use.rule: Keep the two historical trajectories distinct.

term_use.definition: An impression/copy: a word is explicitly denied to be a copy of the thing in itself; it derives from the image produced in the soul.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Retain the negative contrast between a copy of the object and the image formed in the soul.

term_use.definition: Bare abstractness of thought contrasted with language’s uptake of the form of external reality.
term_use.label: Bare abstractness of thought contrasted with language’s uptake of the form of external reality
term_use.rule: Distinct from Abstraction as a method of analysis.

term_use.definition: Dependence of language on the speaker, considered together with its independence and inherited constraints.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use dependence for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Immediate or mediated dependence upon governing words, conditioning closure and understanding of a grammatical whole.
term_use.label: Abhängigkeit
term_use.rule: Do not import a modern dependency-grammar formalism; keep the stated governance criterion.

term_use.definition: Derivation named among the grammatical and lexical means to be studied before their combined use.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use derivation for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Derivation enlarging a simpler sound-form by addition, prefixing, or insertion.
term_use.label: Derivation enlarging a simpler sound-form by addition, prefixing, or insertion
term_use.rule: Keep distinct from Anklang and from composition’s explicit combination of concepts.

term_use.definition: Derivation of concepts or grammatical determinations, distinguished here from their connection and separation.
term_use.label: Ableitung
term_use.rule: In these contexts keep logical deduction distinct from word derivation.

term_use.definition: Pure and complete discrimination of form from material content.
term_use.label: Abscheidung
term_use.rule: Not physical removal of content from an actual utterance; preserve the analytical/cognitive distinction.

term_use.definition: Wearing/grinding-down influence of native interaction on earlier imported foreign material.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Keep imported foreign material as what experiences this influence; do not infer complete homogenization.

term_use.definition: Intentional calling, warning or summoning, distinguished from need and sheer pleasure in sounding.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use intention for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: The construction of absolutely standing participles, given as an arrangement belonging to particular language-form.
term_use.label: absolut stehende Participien
term_use.rule: Retain absolute as a constructional label, not as an ontological claim.

term_use.definition: Separation of human groups, working with holding together to produce gradually distinct nations.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use separation for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Analytic separating of aspects, which need not correspond to different objects; elsewhere physical separation of noise from sound.
term_use.label: Analytic separating of aspects, which need not correspond to different objects; elsewhere physical separation of noise from sound
term_use.rule: Do not turn each analytic separation into an ontological divide.

term_use.definition: Descent applied to languages under an explicit warning: a mother language changes through generations and mixture rather than producing a complete daughter as a separate object.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Retain the descent metaphor and its express restriction; never infer a single pure parent from the term alone.

term_use.definition: Analytic abstraction by which word, object, and individual representation can be distinguished without separate existence.
term_use.label: Analytic abstraction by which word, object, and individual representation can be distinguished without separate existence
term_use.rule: Do not treat the analytic distinction as a detached ontology.

term_use.definition: Abstract-word class in the enumeration of systematically formed vocabulary.
term_use.label: Abstract-word class in the enumeration of systematically formed vocabulary
term_use.rule: Do not confuse the label with the method Abstraction.

term_use.definition: Overt grammatical indication distinguished from a word’s original lexical conceptual class.
term_use.label: Overt grammatical indication distinguished from a word’s original lexical conceptual class
term_use.rule: Keep the label/class separate from the realization indicating it.

term_use.definition: Branching-off of a group or language, distinguished analytically from mixture.
term_use.label: local sense

term_use.definition: Word expressing a quality; lexical conceptual source for designation and formation.
term_use.label: Word expressing a quality; lexical conceptual source for designation and formation
term_use.rule: Do not identify directly with a grammatically marked adjective.

term_use.definition: Pure contemplation of an already present object, explicitly denied as an adequate account of any class of representation.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use contemplation for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: The changing limitedness of human beings, contrasted with truth as unboundedly fixed.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use limitedness for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: A restriction potentially imposed by a determinate form but overcome through its relations to further forms.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use restriction for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: A possessive pronoun treated as tightly joined to its substantive in the cited language descriptions.
term_use.label: Besitzpronomen
term_use.rule: Use possessive pronoun for the attested Besitzpronomen here.

term_use.definition: The grammatical and lexical components into which language can be analyzed, as distinct from their overall procedure.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use constituent for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Capacity for grammatical determination, whose poverty restricts freedom of period construction in Humboldt’s comparison.
term_use.label: grammatical determinability

term_use.definition: The human being’s susceptibility to determination through the gradations of language.
term_use.label: human susceptibility to linguistic determination

term_use.definition: Determinacy of a concept, completed together with clarity through another thinker.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use determinacy for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Determinacy of thinking, contrasted elsewhere with unbounded or ambiguous conceptual content.
term_use.label: Determinacy of thinking, contrasted elsewhere with unbounded or ambiguous conceptual content
term_use.rule: Not grammatical definiteness of noun phrases.

term_use.definition: Definiteness or precision of connected expression, paired with clarity.
term_use.label: Bestimmtheit
term_use.rule: Not causal determinism; no invariant psychological contrast with Klarheit is established.

term_use.definition: Determination contained in a delimitation which calls up related forms and thereby overcomes restriction.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use determination for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: An individual's alleged original destination toward one language, contrasted with accidentally acquired another language.
term_use.label: claimed linguistic affinity
term_use.rule: Attribute this claim; do not turn it into a verified inherited language assignment.

term_use.definition: Determination or specification of the principal concept by added conceptual material.
term_use.label: specification of a concept
term_use.rule: Do not equate all Bestimmung with an assigned dictionary definition.

term_use.definition: A part’s determination or function within the analyzed period.
term_use.label: Bestimmung
term_use.rule: Keep the determination distinct from how visibly it is indicated; not necessarily a lexical definition.

term_use.definition: Act or placement of prominence which groups adjacent syllables.
term_use.label: Act or placement of prominence which groups adjacent syllables
term_use.rule: Distinguish the realizing emphasis from written Accentzeichen.

term_use.definition: Available manner of toning/accenting syllables in the Chinese inventory discussion.
term_use.label: Available manner of toning/accenting syllables in the Chinese inventory discussion
term_use.rule: Preserve the local Chinese context; not identical with word accent’s organizing function.

term_use.definition: Inflectional sounds to which grammatical diversity would wrongly be reduced if supplied and intrinsic grammar were conflated.

term_use.rule: Do not let the audible exponent exhaust grammatical difference.

term_use.caution: Historical source account, not modern confirmation of its acquisition claims.
term_use.definition: Movement of the speech organs through which a deaf learner is said to apprehend articulation.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use movement for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Movement/action through which objects attract attention and receive designation.
term_use.label: Movement/action through which objects attract attention and receive designation
term_use.rule: Keep its conceptual role distinct from the resulting word class.

term_use.definition: General bodily movement/action concept used to designate others.
term_use.label: General bodily movement/action concept used to designate others
term_use.rule: Keep conceptual source and linguistic realization separate.

term_use.definition: Word expressing movement/action as a general conceptual source.
term_use.label: Word expressing movement/action as a general conceptual source
term_use.rule: Not automatically a grammatically classified verb.

term_use.definition: Without reflective conscious awareness, through the operation of grammatically formed languages.
term_use.label: bewusstlos
term_use.rule: Not physically unconscious or devoid of mental activity.

term_use.definition: Conscious awareness in which normally minute individual distinctions can become sharply apparent.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use consciousness for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Reflective consciousness contrasted with obscure feeling as routes through which patterned vocabulary can affect speakers.
term_use.label: Reflective consciousness contrasted with obscure feeling as routes through which patterned vocabulary can affect speakers
