term_use.definition: A community that separates itself accidentally or deliberately, identified as the principle of dialect and language formation.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use community for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: The inward affective life on which internal dispositions and external contingencies act strongly enough to affect linguistic usage.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Do not silently identify it with a fixed modern faculty or with Geist in every context.

term_use.definition: Affective disposition/power in which feelings and resonances are available, distinguished from intellectual powers while interacting with them.
term_use.label: Affective disposition/power in which feelings and resonances are available, distinguished from intellectual powers while interacting with them
term_use.rule: Do not flatten Gemüth into the faculty Verstand.

term_use.definition: A particular affective feeling revealed by emotionally marked expressions.
term_use.label: A particular affective feeling revealed by emotionally marked expressions

term_use.definition: Affective powers combined with intellectual powers in an overall orientation of expression.
term_use.label: Affective powers combined with intellectual powers in an overall orientation of expression
term_use.rule: Retain the distinction while preserving their combination.

term_use.definition: Precision in the conceptual partition expressed by a vocabulary.
term_use.label: Precision in the conceptual partition expressed by a vocabulary
term_use.rule: Do not identify it with numerical measurement precision.

term_use.definition: A generation confronting the accumulated history of language, with younger and departing generations living together.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use generation for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: The productive aptitude for language contrasted with a symbolizing understanding.
term_use.label: The productive aptitude for language contrasted with a symbolizing understanding
term_use.rule: Not merely an honorific for an exceptional individual.

term_use.definition: Gentilic class named among rule-governed vocabulary formations.
term_use.label: Gentilic class named among rule-governed vocabulary formations
term_use.rule: No modern illustrative form is added.

term_use.definition: The structural skeleton of a Periode, combined with the configuration of its parts to define grammatical form.
term_use.label: Gerippe
term_use.rule: Do not equate the skeleton alone with all living linguistic form.

term_use.definition: The audible/noisy component of articulated sound, analytically separated from articulation in what thought requires.

term_use.definition: Accompanying noise contrasted with the sound’s clear conceptual office.
term_use.label: Accompanying noise contrasted with the sound’s clear conceptual office

term_use.definition: The combined treatment grammatical and lexical means receive in a language's overall procedure.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use overall treatment for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Collective powers of the soul gathered in word production and understanding.
term_use.label: Collective powers of the soul gathered in word production and understanding
term_use.rule: Does not license an independently inventoried list of modules.

term_use.definition: Overall orientation of united intellectual and affective powers, contrasted with a single feeling.
term_use.label: Overall orientation of united intellectual and affective powers, contrasted with a single feeling
term_use.rule: Not simply a sum of isolated emotions.

term_use.definition: Singing in birds, compared with human song and pleasure in speaking as more than practical signaling.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use song for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Historical knowledge of prior states and wider connections, whose absence does not justify inventing an origin.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use history for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Historical as the route through actual language development and contact toward knowledge of structure.
term_use.label: geschichtlich
term_use.rule: Keep historical investigation distinct from purely conceptual derivation, while retaining their required cooperation.

term_use.definition: Clear distinctness of sounds from one another, argued to affect conceptual clarity beyond preventing misunderstanding.
term_use.label: Clear distinctness of sounds from one another, argued to affect conceptual clarity beyond preventing misunderstanding

term_use.definition: The living generation and succession of generations through which language's return influence works.
term_use.label: local sense

term_use.definition: Animal kinds among which cries and tonal richness are unequally distributed.
term_use.label: animal kinds

term_use.definition: The human race in whose members something shared is individually determined.
term_use.label: human collective

term_use.definition: Successive human generations through which word sounds and uses are transmitted.
term_use.label: human generation
term_use.rule: Not grammatical gender here.

term_use.definition: A family or lineage of word-sounds developed from a base sound.
term_use.label: family of word-sounds

term_use.definition: Gender assigned to a word, initially lexical in strict analysis but grammatical through its effects on connection.
term_use.label: word gender

term_use.definition: Sex attributed in nature, distinguished from gender assigned to every word for grammatical purposes.

term_use.definition: Grammatical gender marking, a device whose absence in English does not sever close affinity with German.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use gender marking for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Genealogical series of words traced to simpler sound forms.
term_use.label: Genealogical series of words traced to simpler sound forms

term_use.definition: The sex/gender distinction transformed into one made through and for language’s grammatical use.

term_use.definition: Cries of animal kinds used as an analogy for distinctive sound systems.

term_use.rule: Use cry for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Sociability as a condition for full development of human powers and mutual understanding, not merely utility.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use sociability for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Laws from intellectual activity and its sound system that determine possible combinations and transformations.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use law for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Learned regularity governing derivation, contrasted with immediately intelligible composition.
term_use.label: Learned regularity governing derivation, contrasted with immediately intelligible composition
term_use.rule: Preserve local contrast; not every Gesetz denotes a consciously prescribed regulation.

term_use.definition: A guiding law or principle in the local definition of form.
term_use.label: Gesetz

term_use.definition: The laws of thinking from which grammar’s fundamental determinations are to be conceptually derived.
term_use.label: Gesetze des Denkens
term_use.rule: Do not equate them with the individual grammar of a language or a modern biological universal grammar.

term_use.definition: Lawfulness or rule-governed regularity that secures linguistic freedom rather than prescribing one outcome.
term_use.label: Gesetzmässigkeit
term_use.rule: Preserve the relation to freedom; not merely statistical regularity or rigid uniformity.

term_use.definition: The accumulated having-spoken of preceding human generations that constrains the present producer of language.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use past speaking for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Conversation as a need for communicating and developing ideas and feelings, beyond cries for practical aid.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use conversation for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Sensory shape placed beneath an idea in the comparison between word and symbol.
term_use.label: Sensory shape placed beneath an idea in the comparison between word and symbol

term_use.definition: A different presented shape of recurrent content, helping reveal the difference between material content and grammatical form.

term_use.definition: The shaping of sound through articulation that makes it a bearer of thoughts.

term_use.rule: Use shaping for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: The determinate shaping a concept receives through a word.
term_use.label: The determinate shaping a concept receives through a word

term_use.definition: The particular configuration of grammatical form through which its formal effect becomes evident.
term_use.label: Gestaltung
term_use.rule: Keep the resulting configuration distinct from a faculty or a separate substantive content.

term_use.definition: Mind's power over speech organs to make sound conform to the form of its operation.

term_use.definition: Agility or facility of human thought and expression affected by language, alongside vitality and subtlety.
term_use.label: Gewandtheit
term_use.rule: Not bodily dexterity in this mental-development comparison.

term_use.definition: The woven whole of concepts and modes of representation contained in a language and offering a new standpoint to its learner.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use fabric for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Nationally forming habit that assigns sounds particular positions and produces a distinctive inventory.
term_use.label: Nationally forming habit that assigns sounds particular positions and produces a distinctive inventory

term_use.definition: Settled repeated usage fixing how an expression or form is apprehended.
term_use.label: Gewohnheit
term_use.rule: Use habit for the attested Gewohnheit here.

term_use.definition: Likeness in kind arising either through historically transmitted formed language or through shared human capacities; empirical separation remains open.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Keep its possible historical and general-human sources distinct; not automatic identity or common descent.

term_use.definition: Shared character whose individuality can warrant historical connection more securely than a universal resemblance.
term_use.label: Shared character whose individuality can warrant historical connection more securely than a universal resemblance
term_use.rule: Keep observed resemblance distinct from the inference it may support.

term_use.definition: The balance partly restored between inherited language's accumulated power and the individual through linguistic plasticity and living mental force.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use balance for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Effective simultaneity for the investigator when the chronological origins of languages are unknown.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use simultaneity for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Tracks as a metaphor for the given and habitual ways thought and speech proceed.
term_use.label: Gleis
term_use.rule: Preserve the activity-guiding metaphor; not an invariant mechanical constraint.

term_use.definition: Member within a connected thought sequence into which a word’s object is inserted.
term_use.label: Member within a connected thought sequence into which a word’s object is inserted
term_use.rule: A relational part of a whole, not a physical limb here.

term_use.definition: Division and connection of discourse into intellectual wholes, which sound alteration may clarify or obscure.
term_use.label: Division and connection of discourse into intellectual wholes, which sound alteration may clarify or obscure
term_use.rule: Do not equate all Gliederung with modern syntax.

term_use.definition: A Gordian-knot metaphor for the marking regress, cut by the unified effect of grammatical form.
term_use.label: Gordischer Knoten
term_use.rule: Retain the metaphor’s function: a change in explanation, not another overt auxiliary.

term_use.definition: General grammar as traditionally analyzing discourse and necessary word forms, covering only part of the wider coordinated process Humboldt proposes.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Keep the account of general grammar distinct from the proposed full process analysis.

term_use.definition: Grammatical formation which recasts words of one lexical conceptual class into others.
term_use.label: Grammatical formation which recasts words of one lexical conceptual class into others
term_use.rule: The practical grammar-book/lexicon division is separately qualified on p441.

term_use.definition: Practical organization of rule-governed material in a grammar, contrasted with a dictionary’s alphabetical entries.
term_use.label: grammar as practical codification
term_use.rule: The author denies that this practical division determines whether formation belongs to lexicon or discourse.

term_use.caution: Do not infer that a speaker without explicit analysis lacks all operative grammatical relations.
term_use.definition: The discipline concerned with connection of speech; its abstraction presupposes separating words from expressions.
term_use.label: discipline of speech-connection
term_use.rule: Use grammar for the discipline in §128; distinguish its presupposed analysis from the undivided whole of actual speaking.

term_use.definition: Operative grammatical organization, distinguished according to whether it is active in the speaker or present in language itself.
term_use.label: operative grammatical organization
term_use.rule: Keep speaker-borne organization distinct from audible linguistic realization; neither absence of overt marking nor lack of conscious theory proves absence of grammar.

term_use.definition: A descriptive grammar or grammatical account whose analytical choices can make unlike languages appear alike.
term_use.label: descriptive grammatical account
term_use.rule: Distinguish the analyst’s description from the grammar actually present in a language.

term_use.definition: Grammatical as qualifying the means to be inventoried and then examined in their combined use.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use grammatical for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Pertaining to the language’s grammatical formation/classification, distinguished from yet interacting with lexical conceptual class.
term_use.label: Pertaining to the language’s grammatical formation/classification, distinguished from yet interacting with lexical conceptual class
term_use.rule: Do not equate conceptual lexical contribution with an overt grammatical marker.

term_use.definition: Grammatical in the strict connection-of-speech sense, contrasted with lexical assignment to an individual word.
term_use.label: grammatisch
term_use.rule: Keep the local lexical/grammatical boundary and its qualifications; not every linguistic property is grammatical here.

term_use.definition: A language’s way of organizing grammatical relations, whose inward form shapes each utterance.
term_use.label: grammatische Ansicht
term_use.rule: Not the unvarying general grammar itself; it varies between languages.

term_use.caution: Do not identify missing designation with absence of grammar in users.
term_use.definition: The explicit marking or designation of grammatical connections, said here to be sparse.
term_use.label: grammatische Bezeichnung
term_use.rule: Use grammatical marking for the explicit designation whose poverty is contrasted with habitual fixed expressions.

term_use.definition: Linguistic forms whose explanation depends on the language’s handling of sound.
term_use.label: Linguistic forms whose explanation depends on the language’s handling of sound
term_use.rule: Keep grammatical function distinct from the sounds realizing it.

term_use.caution: Shared thought-relations, analyst labels and a language’s own means remain different questions.
term_use.definition: A grammatical determination that an analyst can recover or render in a language despite the lack of its own special designation. The claim does not decide whether strict grammatical form is present in the language itself.
term_use.label: grammatical determination without obligatory overt designation
term_use.rule: Describe recoverability in§133 without equating it with overt linguistic marking. Compare the later strict audible criterion in§147 and the speaker/language distinction of§142.

term_use.definition: The organization of a connection striving toward a grammatically closed whole; its period structure and fitted parts constitute a language’s form.
term_use.label: organization of grammatical connection
term_use.rule: Distinguish this whole-organization sense from a single inflection or the restricted audible indication of §147.

term_use.definition: A fixed, pure indication in audible language that makes a grammatical relation recognizable as relation rather than substantive concept.
term_use.label: fixed pure audible indication
term_use.rule: This explicitly local criterion includes rigorously fixed word order only if it refers to an independently recognizable fixed point; distinguish earlier broader grammatical-form senses.

term_use.definition: Grammatical technique whose two elements require delimitation after the tacit/explicit distinction and its degrees.
term_use.label: grammatische Technik
term_use.rule: Keep technical realization distinct from thought-laws; delimitation is promised for subsequent inquiry, not completed here.

term_use.definition: Grammatical diversity analyzed into viewpoint, technical designation and actual sounds.
term_use.label: grammatische Verschiedenheit
term_use.rule: Keep the three levels distinct, not three fixed classes of languages.

term_use.definition: Grammatical awareness, variable even among individuals of cultivated peoples.
term_use.label: grammatisches Bewusstseyn
term_use.rule: Use grammatical awareness for the attested grammatisches Bewusstseyn here.

term_use.definition: A relation in which a word is considered with respect to connection in speech.
term_use.label: grammatisches Verhältniss
term_use.rule: Do not equate the relation with a sound, ending or grammatical label; gender enters grammar through effects on connection.

term_use.definition: A word expressing only a relation, distinguished from a form that modifies a word’s concept without changing it substantively.
term_use.label: grammatisches Wort
term_use.rule: Distinguish the relational word from both a content word and a bound modification; historical content can be forgotten.

term_use.definition: Earlier/base concept from which subsequent meanings may diverge.
term_use.label: Earlier/base concept from which subsequent meanings may diverge
term_use.rule: Keep its changes distinct from sound changes.

term_use.definition: Basic conceptual contents expressed by words, joined with grammatical determinations in the verb.
term_use.label: Grundbegriff
term_use.rule: Do not infer a fixed theoretical opposition to Stammbegriff beyond their local usages.

term_use.definition: Fundamental determinations of grammar grounded in thought-laws.
term_use.label: Grundbestimmung
term_use.rule: Keep determinations of grammatical relations distinct from sounds that mark them.

term_use.definition: Basic sounds of words, considered as simpler or more variously formed in comparing a language's procedure.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use basic sound for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Simple underlying/base sound forms to which long word-families may be traced, retaining meaning in their simplicity.
term_use.label: Simple underlying/base sound forms to which long word-families may be traced, retaining meaning in their simplicity
term_use.rule: Not automatically a reconstructed phoneme.

term_use.definition: A guiding principle of inquiry, especially shared linguistic elements and transmission, not equivalent to a proved single common origin.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use principle for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Basic units into which both mental activity and articulation divide their domains, recombining into further wholes.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use basic part for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Basic constituents distinguished in analyzing the language’s construction.
term_use.label: Basic constituents distinguished in analyzing the language’s construction
term_use.rule: Do not infer a modern inventory of linguistic levels.

term_use.definition: Basic sounds whose arrangement is said to correspond reciprocally with a language's way of viewing.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use basic sound for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Earlier/base sound form from which a later sound may diverge.
term_use.label: Earlier/base sound form from which a later sound may diverge
term_use.rule: Not necessarily a musical keynote.

term_use.definition: The main outlines of a general linguistic process type that the following inquiry proposes to sketch.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use main outlines for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: A group whose members share the group-final grammatical determinations in the cited constructional description.
term_use.label: Gruppe
term_use.rule: Use the local bounded grouping, not an assumed modern phrase category.

term_use.definition: Bounds of human language and nested linguistic kinds to be sought in comparative inquiry.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use bound for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Boundary delimiting what belongs essentially to the word’s concept and what is merely accidental.
term_use.label: Boundary delimiting what belongs essentially to the word’s concept and what is merely accidental
term_use.rule: Do not treat every empirical object as naturally unambiguous.

term_use.definition: Boundary between tacit and explicit grammar, expressly without a sharp cut because indication approaches genuine form by degrees.
term_use.label: Gränzlinie
term_use.rule: Preserve both the analytical distinction and its gradation; not a strict binary.

term_use.definition: Ferment of the powers of American groups, said to arise through themselves without foreign influence.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Keep the groups as subject of ferment; do not transfer this subject to the separate abrasion clause.

term_use.definition: Sensory handle by which intellectual concepts are grasped through words.
term_use.label: Sensory handle by which intellectual concepts are grasped through words
term_use.rule: Retain the sensory-to-concept direction of development.

term_use.definition: An inward mental action joining sensory activity to produce a representation which then confronts the subject as an object.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use action for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Inner activity producing relational content, distinguished from treating that content as object properties.
term_use.label: inner act of thought
term_use.rule: Not necessarily a bodily action.

term_use.definition: An action as semantic content designated by a verb, distinguished from its grammatical connecting role.
term_use.label: Handlung
term_use.rule: Do not use action meaning as a sufficient definition of a grammatical verb.

term_use.definition: Harmony of music as an analogy for grammatical form’s relation to content.
term_use.label: Harmonie
term_use.rule: Keep the musical analogy rather than claiming identity with grammatical organization.

term_use.definition: Breathy sound added in word formation.
term_use.label: Breathy sound added in word formation
term_use.rule: Do not infer a particular laryngeal feature or written h in every use.

term_use.definition: Breathing or breathy vocal noise among accompanying sounds.
term_use.label: Breathing or breathy vocal noise among accompanying sounds
term_use.rule: Distinct lexeme from Hauch and not evidence for one universal physiological mechanism.

term_use.definition: The principal concept modified by word-forming additions.
term_use.label: The principal concept modified by word-forming additions
term_use.rule: Distinct from the modifying concepts or their sound expression.

term_use.definition: The chief principle that historically connected languages are one language differentiated through divergence and mixture, further qualified against a single original language.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use chief principle for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Principal stock of bodily quality/action concepts from which further designations are drawn.
term_use.label: Principal stock of bodily quality/action concepts from which further designations are drawn
term_use.rule: Not merely acoustic substance.

term_use.definition: The central word of a grouping, explicitly either a substantive or a verb.
term_use.label: Hauptwort
term_use.rule: Do not automatically render as noun here.

term_use.definition: Raising of the voice in the discussion of intonation.
term_use.label: Raising of the voice in the discussion of intonation
term_use.rule: Keep rise of voice distinct from the whole grammatical or conceptual role of accent.

term_use.definition: Perceived brightness or clarity of sound.
term_use.label: Perceived brightness or clarity of sound
term_use.rule: Retain its cross-sensory descriptive role; not a measured acoustic parameter.

term_use.definition: Derivation from concepts, available for language’s nature and thought-laws but not simply the organs’ properties.
term_use.label: Herleitung
term_use.rule: Use derivation for the attested Herleitung here.

term_use.definition: Dominion or governance by language over the faculty forming it, explicitly denied in unconditional form.
term_use.label: Herrschaft
term_use.rule: Preserve unbedingte and the denial; do not erase the more qualified effects of language acknowledged elsewhere.

term_use.definition: Producing speech under the same inward laws operative in apprehension.
term_use.label: Hervorbringen
term_use.rule: Not merely retrieving an already finished sentence, nor only inventing a language from nothing.

term_use.definition: Production of sound to which thought's drive, feeling and social need each contribute.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use production for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Evocation of sound and indicated object, distinguished from the fuller articulated understanding that relates a word to language as a whole.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use evocation for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Hieroglyph used as analogy for sound’s enclosing the concept at one stage of the comparison with symbolism.
term_use.label: Hieroglyph used as analogy for sound’s enclosing the concept at one stage of the comparison with symbolism
term_use.rule: A comparison, not the final classification of all words or a modern account of Egyptian writing.

term_use.caution: Translator caution: do not assume a consciously performed inference, a historically deleted spoken word, or license to insert an overt word. These negatives are safeguards against added assumptions, not separately asserted historical facts.
term_use.definition: Mentally supplying what is required to complete an expression, here the verb be.
term_use.label: Hinzudenken
term_use.rule: Use supplying in thought for an intended grammatical relation not indicated in the sounds; distinguish operation, relation and overt expression.

term_use.definition: An express addition of the relational connection in the Spanish example, contrasted with merely thinking it.
term_use.label: Hinzufügung
term_use.rule: Keep explicit addition apart from Hinzudenken; not every supplementation remains unspoken.

term_use.caution: Preserve the historical label without certifying a modern ethnological rank.
term_use.definition: A historically charged human grouping among American stocks and families.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use horde for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Perceived hardness of sound, paired with softness.
term_use.label: Perceived hardness of sound, paired with softness
term_use.rule: Historical perceptual description, not a specified modern feature.

term_use.definition: A hearer whose active developing linguistic power responds to the speaker through a shared nature.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use hearer for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Hearer for whom a word’s apprehensional content functions as designation.
term_use.label: Hearer for whom a word’s apprehensional content functions as designation
term_use.rule: Do not presume passive reception of identical content.

term_use.definition: Mutual practical assistance, rejected as the predominant need from which language arose.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use assistance for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Resources needed to study and check individual languages, especially grammars, dictionaries and collected materials.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use resources for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Auxiliary resources recruited by the mind when language-form contributes fewer of its own.
term_use.label: Hülfsmittel
term_use.rule: Do not make all compensating resources intrinsic overt grammar.

term_use.definition: An auxiliary verb used to carry conjugation; adding be still leaves the same question about its verbal positing.
term_use.label: Hülfsverbum
term_use.rule: Do not treat the auxiliary as a solution to the infinite marking regress.

term_use.definition: Auxiliary words as one device accompanying verbs, contrasted with inflected verbs in proposed feature classification.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use auxiliary word for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Inherited verbal shell repeatedly enlivened through actual thinking and speech.
term_use.label: Inherited verbal shell repeatedly enlivened through actual thinking and speech
term_use.rule: Keep the explicit metaphor and actual-use contrast.

term_use.definition: The I distinguished from non-I and placed in a chosen reciprocal relation with a Thou.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Only indexical/theoretical I is terminological; ordinary authorial first-person uses remain ordinary.

term_use.definition: I as one pole of the reciprocal personal relation language adds.
term_use.label: Ich
term_use.rule: Use this technical nominal I only here; ordinary authorial Ich elsewhere is not this term.

term_use.definition: Pertaining to objects of thought as apprehended and connected through thought-units.
term_use.label: Pertaining to objects of thought as apprehended and connected through thought-units
term_use.rule: Not necessarily optimal or morally ideal.

term_use.definition: Ideal or conceptual as the viewpoint of relations considered before technical means and sounds.
term_use.label: ideal
term_use.rule: Not necessarily ideal as perfectly good or normatively best; preserve the three-level contrast.

term_use.definition: Ideal in the artist’s image of perfect form, used as an analogy for an inward linguistic pattern.
term_use.label: idealisch
term_use.rule: Do not simply identify the aesthetic ideal of perfection with ideale grammatische Ansicht.

term_use.definition: An idea that can meet sound in genuine synthesis not further derivable by analytic explanation.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Do not automatically replace Idee with Begriff; preserve the local idea/sound contrast.

term_use.definition: Ideal unity recognizable in a growing whole of phenomena and linguistic productions.
term_use.label: Ideal unity recognizable in a growing whole of phenomena and linguistic productions
term_use.rule: Do not equate every Idee mechanically with the lexeme Begriff.

term_use.definition: An idea invoked in the comparison for how speech-form adheres to content without being that material content.
term_use.label: Idee
term_use.rule: Keep the comparative wie; do not impose a Kantian or Platonic technical definition or a fixed boundary from Begriff/Gedanke.

term_use.definition: Pertaining to the world constituted in thought/language, placed in relation to the actual world.
term_use.label: Pertaining to the world constituted in thought/language, placed in relation to the actual world
term_use.rule: Distinct lexeme from ideal; not simply physically unreal in every sense.

term_use.definition: Designation of ideas considered in relation to mere sounding, as colour is to painting.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use designation of ideas for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: The author's own development of ideas through which he must supply the general conceptual framework lacking elsewhere.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use development of ideas for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Richness and depth of ideas achieved in words through active intellectual development.
term_use.label: Richness and depth of ideas achieved in words through active intellectual development
term_use.rule: Distinct from the number of word-sounds.

term_use.definition: Material of ideas imagined as an object of merely dividing and analyzing, contrasted with lively conceptual production.
term_use.label: Material of ideas imagined as an object of merely dividing and analyzing, contrasted with lively conceptual production
term_use.rule: Occurs in a rejected image of how rich conceptual content arises.

term_use.definition: Connection of ideas, here a practical/light mode in which a language’s orientation may keep thought.
term_use.label: Connection of ideas, here a practical/light mode in which a language’s orientation may keep thought
term_use.rule: Preserve the local evaluative qualification.

term_use.definition: Identity of thinking and speaking invoked to justify expressive adequacy and continuing development.
term_use.label: Identity of thinking and speaking invoked to justify expressive adequacy and continuing development
term_use.rule: Not a claim that all speakers have identical individual representations.

term_use.definition: Particular languages considered under general human language as species under a genus.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use idiom for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: A single-casting metaphor for the unified verbal form rather than an aggregate of separate feature-signs.
term_use.label: in Einem Guss
term_use.rule: Keep the unity of the verb, not a claim of mechanical fusion that abolishes all distinctions.

term_use.definition: The totality/range of sounds and their lawful possible transformations which a specific intellectual activity can produce.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use totality for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: The indicative as one pole of the author’s necessary mood opposition.
term_use.label: Indicativus
term_use.rule: Retain the author’s opposition without assigning all modern mood properties.

term_use.definition: The position that contrasting modes of grammatical designation deserve equal grammatical valuation simply because relations can be understood.
term_use.label: grammatischer Indifferentismus
term_use.rule: Keep this a position being tested and rejected, not a statement that grammar is unimportant.

term_use.definition: The language's singular identity said to be fully manifest only in its own sound rather than exhausted by classification.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Retain the emphatic sound claim and read it with §§49–50 rather than silently reducing or universalizing it.

term_use.definition: Strict individuality located only in the present speaker; a nation's language is individual only comparatively.
term_use.label: ultimate speaker individuality
term_use.rule: Keep the speaker as final bearer and national individuality relative.

term_use.definition: The full particular determination belonging to a word in actual individual thinking.
term_use.label: The full particular determination belonging to a word in actual individual thinking
term_use.rule: Distinguish from the generally individualizable form studied by the investigator.

term_use.definition: Human mental individuality whose central life is bound up with language, rather than just clarity and definiteness.
term_use.label: Individualität
term_use.rule: Identify the bearer; the same noun later describes a language’s living individuality, not a fixed language class.

term_use.definition: An individual whose whole present linguistic capacity determines each utterance; groupings can also count relatively as individuals.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use individual for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: A word as the complete individual unit of language, contrasted with syllable and letter as elements.
term_use.label: A word as the complete individual unit of language, contrasted with syllable and letter as elements
term_use.rule: Do not read as a biological organism.

term_use.definition: An individual human being confronted by language formed independently of that person.
term_use.label: Individuum
term_use.rule: Distinguish the individual bearer from Individualität as distinctiveness, and from a whole nation.

term_use.definition: Historical induction which may be incompletely performed and then mistaken for purely conceptual law.
term_use.label: Induction
term_use.rule: Use induction for the attested Induction here.

term_use.definition: The interlocking of the whole whose structure the chapter aims to show while details are only indicated.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use interlocking for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: The infinitive form named in the construction with the accusative.
term_use.label: Infinitiv
term_use.rule: Do not infer a full modern definition or universal inventory from the example.

term_use.definition: Expression of conceptual distinctions by changes of sound-elements without importing an additional material concept.
term_use.label: Expression of conceptual distinctions by changes of sound-elements without importing an additional material concept
term_use.rule: Keep distinct from agglutination and composition when later enumerated.

term_use.definition: Conceptual content of words, whose multiple meanings and relations must be considered.
term_use.label: Conceptual content of words, whose multiple meanings and relations must be considered
term_use.rule: Not a container of physically transferred material.

term_use.definition: Content in relation to which grammatical form is considered as an ordering idea.
term_use.label: Inhalt
term_use.rule: Keep content distinct from formal arrangement without asserting their actual separability.

term_use.definition: The intimate force attributed to native language and especially its inexplicable individual sound.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use intimacy for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: The instrumental case, contrasted with pure conceptual case deductions because it introduces the concept of an instrument.
term_use.label: Instrumentalis
term_use.rule: Retain the case label and the instrument-concept qualification; no modern distribution is asserted.

term_use.definition: Intellectuality toward which nations differ in inclination, particularly intellectuality through language.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Do not reduce it to measured intelligence or educational attainment.

term_use.definition: The intellectual character or purity of linguistic expression, affected by sound without being identical with it.
term_use.label: The intellectual character or purity of linguistic expression, affected by sound without being identical with it
term_use.rule: Avoid a psychometric intelligence reading.

term_use.definition: Pure intellectuality which Chinese appears to gain in compensation for relinquished grammatical richness.
term_use.label: Intellectualität
term_use.rule: Preserve scheint and the compensatory comparison; not a general proof of Chinese superiority or inferiority.

term_use.definition: Intellectual as characterizing the inward activity inseparable from language and its sound system.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use intellectual for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Pertaining to conceptual/intellectual powers distinguished from, yet combined with, affective powers.
term_use.label: Pertaining to conceptual/intellectual powers distinguished from, yet combined with, affective powers
term_use.rule: Not automatically a psychometric intelligence measure.

term_use.caution: No modern psychometric measure is specified.
term_use.definition: Intelligence of the person using language, conditioning the fullness of its effects on thought and feeling.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use intelligence for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Pitch variation of vowels that multiplies available sound varieties, contrasted with organizing accent.
term_use.label: Pitch variation of vowels that multiplies available sound varieties, contrasted with organizing accent
term_use.rule: Do not silently identify Humboldt’s account with a modern analysis of Chinese tones.

term_use.definition: Categories into which a sentence element is placed in tracing all the determinations and relations of the language.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use category for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: General classifications of objects and concepts aiding lexical comparison, with a particular language required at the individual-concept level.
term_use.label: General classifications of objects and concepts aiding lexical comparison, with a particular language required at the individual-concept level
term_use.rule: Not automatically a grammatical category or language-independent final inventory.

term_use.definition: A conceptual category serving as a ground of deduction, here relation as the source of the basic cases.
term_use.label: Kategorie
term_use.rule: Do not equate this conceptual category with a language class, a marker or an analyst’s untested label.

term_use.definition: The conceptual category from which the first four cases are said necessarily to follow.
term_use.label: Kategorie der Relation
term_use.rule: Not an audible case marker, nor a classification obtained by counting modern languages.

term_use.caution: Historical descriptive example, not independently checked phonetic analysis.
term_use.definition: A breathed guttural sound attributed to Florentines as an illustration of sound differences within one language.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use guttural sound for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Germ of further development in everything already contained in a language.
term_use.label: Germ of further development in everything already contained in a language
term_use.rule: Metaphor of continuing possibility, not biological descent.

term_use.definition: Recognizability of each part’s determination when analyzing a period’s organization.
term_use.label: Kenntlichkeit
term_use.rule: Keep recognition of function separate from the function itself.

term_use.definition: Knowledge of a language's individuality required to choose analyses appropriate to it, rather than impose one plan on all.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use knowledge for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: An overt distinguishing mark of grammatical parts of speech, whose absence does not eliminate the relations needed for understanding.
term_use.label: Kennzeichen
term_use.rule: Do not infer absence of thought-relations from absence of class marks.

term_use.definition: Historical chain whose inaccessible beginning limits inquiry into word sounds.
term_use.label: Historical chain whose inaccessible beginning limits inquiry into word sounds
term_use.rule: Do not infer a single common chain for all languages; the following text rejects that necessity.

term_use.definition: Child language in a developmental analogy explicitly rejected for monosyllabic languages.

term_use.rule: Use separation for the defined local use.

term_use.caution: OCR Wones corrected to Wortes.
term_use.definition: Analytic separation of the word as sound from the word as concept, explicitly denied as a separation in nature.
term_use.label: Analytic separation of the word as sound from the word as concept, explicitly denied as a separation in nature
term_use.rule: Keep methodological abstraction distinct from separable existence.

term_use.definition: Separation of concepts as one of logic’s operations, distinguished from their connection and derivation.
term_use.label: Trennung
term_use.rule: Identify the separated units; not deletion of words or necessarily a chronological breakup of language.

term_use.caution: This is Humboldt’s Agamemnon policy, not a verified technical headword of Grundzüge or a command to copy German syntax. Do not identify it without argument with Nord’s later ethical loyalty.
term_use.definition: The translation principle directed to the original’s true character rather than its accidental details at the cost of that character.
term_use.label: faithfulness to the original’s character
term_use.rule: Use faithfulness/fidelity in this translation-policy comparison; preserve its specified object, the original’s character.

term_use.definition: Sound as bearer of thoughts when shaped through articulation.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use bearer for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: The common pattern of the mental process of language, defined by the pure concept of language abstracting from individualizing circumstances.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Name the process bearer; not automatically a taxonomic language class or a single ancestral language.

term_use.definition: Pattern or model of the Sanskrit sound inventory said to spread across other languages.
term_use.label: Pattern or model of the Sanskrit sound inventory said to spread across other languages
term_use.rule: Not automatically an entire language’s typological class.

term_use.definition: An organizing pattern of construction from which characteristics of parts of speech are derived.
term_use.label: Typus
term_use.rule: Identify the bearer; not a taxonomic class of languages.

term_use.definition: Mere sounding considered alongside idea-designation, connecting the animal component to articulated language.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use sounding for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Coordination of thinking and speech organs which Humboldt treats as a basis of linguistic ability.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use accord for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Agreement in thoughts and feelings which also involves divergence because each speaker understands individually.
term_use.label: interpersonal agreement
term_use.rule: Retain the qualified agreement rather than identity of inner thought.

term_use.definition: Grammatical redundancy that can persist in a conventional expression.
term_use.label: grammatische Ueberflüssigkeit
term_use.rule: Use grammatical redundancy for the attested grammatische Ueberflüssigkeit here.

term_use.definition: Transition from demonstrative pronoun to article, illustrating why presence of a technical form may be difficult to decide.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use transition for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: A gradual historical transition in a word’s shift from substantive content to relational function.
term_use.label: Uebergang
term_use.rule: Do not describe the functional shift as an instantaneous loss inferred solely from etymology.

term_use.definition: Tradition as a possible source of knowledge of earlier states and wider historical connection.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use tradition for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Conviction strengthened through social communication, paired with its stimulation of thought.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use conviction for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Practice through which children's linguistic capacity grows, not mere repetition of memorized vocabulary.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use practice for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Practice of speaking through which the separation of words and expressions develops.
term_use.label: Uebung
term_use.rule: Not automatically institutional education or conscious grammatical drilling.

term_use.definition: Extent or scope; here one meaning’s reach, elsewhere the range/count of available sound or word forms.
term_use.label: Extent or scope; here one meaning’s reach, elsewhere the range/count of available sound or word forms
term_use.rule: State what has the extent; broad scope does not imply several meanings.

term_use.definition: Reshaping of sounds, distinguished from changes in subjective apprehension and broad meanings.
term_use.label: Reshaping of sounds, distinguished from changes in subjective apprehension and broad meanings
term_use.rule: Keep the historical change’s bearer explicit.

term_use.definition: Intercourse/common life that can produce dialects without influence from common descent.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use interaction for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Possible transformations of speech sounds governed by laws arising from intellectual activity and its sound system.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use transformation for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Sensory wrapping through which intellectual content is appropriated in language.
term_use.label: Sensory wrapping through which intellectual content is appropriated in language
term_use.rule: Retain the metaphor and distinguish it from a complete independent concept merely dressed afterward.

term_use.definition: The outer outline from which exposition begins after detailed study, before progressive individualization.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use outline for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Expression through several words rather than one word for the concept.
term_use.label: Expression through several words rather than one word for the concept
term_use.rule: The text allows equal communicative clarity while distinguishing broader intellectual effects.

term_use.definition: To give an existing word a new conceptual impress or determination, rather than assign a new word to a fully ready-made concept.
term_use.label: To give an existing word a new conceptual impress or determination, rather than assign a new word to a fully ready-made concept
term_use.rule: Keep the metaphor and direction of conceptual development.

term_use.caution: Authorial explanatory footnote citing Bopp; separate from the editor’s deletion note below.
term_use.definition: Giving a root the formal status of a word; an impression/metaphor of stamping.
term_use.label: Giving a root the formal status of a word; an impression/metaphor of stamping
term_use.rule: Preserve the distinction between root and formed word.

term_use.definition: Transformations of language’s subjective intellectual/affective orientation, potentially faster and stronger than sound change.
term_use.label: Transformations of language’s subjective intellectual/affective orientation, potentially faster and stronger than sound change
term_use.rule: The comparative frequency/speed claim is historical authorial assertion.

term_use.definition: Changes in national language through continuing common life, whose speed and character depend on interaction and depth of use.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use change for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Rule-governed alteration of existing word-sounds in productive lexical families.
term_use.label: Rule-governed alteration of existing word-sounds in productive lexical families
term_use.rule: Differentiate it from inventing entirely new unrelated sound forms.

term_use.definition: Independence of language in relation to individual producers, inseparable from its dependence on renewed subjective production.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use independence for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Indeterminacy of conceptual limits or included determinations in lexical designation.
term_use.label: Indeterminacy of conceptual limits or included determinations in lexical designation
term_use.rule: Distinct from the breadth of one determinate meaning.

term_use.definition: Unbounded continuation of conceptual creation contrasted with a limit to sound-stock creation.
term_use.label: Unbounded continuation of conceptual creation contrasted with a limit to sound-stock creation
term_use.rule: Not a quantified mathematical infinity proved in this passage.

term_use.definition: Mathematical quantities treated as individually negligible, used as an analogy for very small expressive sacrifices.
term_use.label: unendlich kleine Grössen
term_use.rule: Retain the analogy; no measurement or independent mathematical account of expressive losses is established.

term_use.definition: Infinity toward which thought strives beyond darkness and restriction, compared with the apparent unboundedness of air.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use infinity for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Indefinite/unbounded reach toward which linguistic thought strives beyond any single word.
term_use.label: Indefinite/unbounded reach toward which linguistic thought strives beyond any single word
term_use.rule: Not a numerical result about a formal grammar.

term_use.definition: Noncorporeal content contrasted with bodily things in the matter of thought.
term_use.label: Noncorporeal content contrasted with bodily things in the matter of thought
term_use.rule: Distinct from meaningless or merely abstract in every use.

term_use.definition: Air's apparent incorporeality, a sensory correspondence to mind in the argument for its suitability as speech material.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use incorporeality for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Irregular grammatical composition retained without component analysis in habitual expressions.
term_use.label: Unregelmässigkeit
term_use.rule: Use irregularity for the attested Unregelmässigkeit here.

term_use.definition: Nonsensory conceptual content designated through bodily metaphors.
term_use.label: Nonsensory conceptual content designated through bodily metaphors
term_use.rule: Not senseless or meaningless.

term_use.definition: Varied subtypes of a historically connected language formed through divergence and mixture.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use subtype for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: European subjugation as the temporal boundary to the opening's claimed absence of foreign influence.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use subjugation for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Proportioned subordination of concepts in the articulation of thought.
term_use.label: Unterordnung
term_use.rule: Do not automatically substitute a modern syntactic hierarchy or a social relation of subjection.

term_use.definition: The proposed distinction between procedure and constituents, expressly not to be drawn too rigidly.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use distinction for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Original imperfection in an arrested-development interpretation explicitly rejected for monosyllabic languages.
term_use.label: Original imperfection in an arrested-development interpretation explicitly rejected for monosyllabic languages
term_use.rule: Do not convert the rejected characterization into an endorsed description.

term_use.definition: Unlikeness among grammatical devices used as a basis of unsuccessful essential language classification.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use dissimilarity for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: A cause or motive of utterance, especially the need for conversational development of ideas and feelings.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use cause for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Cause with final and productive roles attributed to language in the ideal of pure linguistic form.
term_use.label: Ursach
term_use.rule: Preserve both End- and wirkende roles; do not make this an unqualified claim that language is the sole cause of thought in every context.

term_use.definition: Cause whose role alternates with effect in the account of word formation and apprehension.
term_use.label: Cause whose role alternates with effect in the account of word formation and apprehension
term_use.rule: Not an independently established physiological mechanism.

term_use.definition: An original language whose single or multiple existence Humboldt considers possible but not established or needed for explaining observed language phenomena.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Do not equate general human language or contact-connected unity with one original language.

term_use.definition: The origin of American peoples and languages, left unspecified while their later internal history motivates continental study.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use origin for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Historical origin of the language or its forms, whose remoteness limits direct investigation.
term_use.label: Historical origin of the language or its forms, whose remoteness limits direct investigation
term_use.rule: Do not turn inaccessible beginnings into established reconstruction.

term_use.definition: Relatively earlier or less transformed, expressly glossed here as retaining fewer traces of major upheaval.
term_use.label: Relatively earlier or less transformed, expressly glossed here as retaining fewer traces of major upheaval
term_use.rule: Do not make this mean directly attested primordial language.

term_use.definition: Originally or primordially given in the proposed natural order, rather than necessarily earliest historically attested.
term_use.label: ursprünglich
term_use.rule: Use originally for the attested ursprünglich here.

term_use.definition: Original or earlier in the semantic history of a word, potentially lost in its present relational use.
term_use.label: historically earlier meaning
term_use.rule: Do not make the original content necessarily active in present meaning or confuse historical earlier meaning with the primordial order of §129.

term_use.definition: The faculty of judgment supporting the pure-thinking aspect of language, alongside understanding.
term_use.label: Urtheilskraft
term_use.rule: Keep distinct from Verstand and from creative imagination.

term_use.definition: The fundamental I/Thou pattern of speaking expressed in second- versus third-person pronouns.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Do not render as proto-language or primordial language.

term_use.definition: The original pattern of a language’s period construction resting in the mind and becoming conscious through use.
term_use.label: Urtypus
term_use.rule: Not a reconstructed proto-language or a natural class of languages; preserve the mental pattern and its realization.

term_use.definition: A verbal ending named among group-final means of indicating grammatical relations.
term_use.label: Verbalendung
term_use.rule: Use verbal ending for the attested Verbalendung here.

term_use.definition: A verbal form as a grammatical realization, which itself would require existential designation if every relation demanded a separate sign.
term_use.label: Verbalform
term_use.rule: Keep realized form distinct from the category Verbum and from the principle of positing.

term_use.definition: A word’s verbal status or nature as established either by grammatical designation or by customary use.
term_use.label: Verbalnatur
term_use.rule: Do not equate conventional verb use with an overt morphological verb marker.

term_use.definition: The original verbal meaning of a word, potentially forgotten as it serves a relational function.
term_use.label: Verbalsinn
term_use.rule: Distinguish semantic content from Verbalnatur as current grammatical status.

term_use.definition: The necessary connection of intellectual activity with sound, through which thought becomes clear and representation becomes concept.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use connection for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Historical connection between peoples through which already formed speech and linguistic elements pass and change.
term_use.label: historical connection
term_use.rule: Identify the historical/contact relation rather than a logical relation or demonstrated pure descent.

term_use.definition: Combination of words in discourse, distinguished from formation of vocabulary.
term_use.label: Combination of words in discourse, distinguished from formation of vocabulary
term_use.rule: Name the bearer; conceptual combination and sound contact may also be discussed.

term_use.definition: Connection among words or concepts, distinguished from the connected items and from their designation; its exact level depends on the context.
term_use.label: Verbindung
term_use.rule: Do not collapse connected organization into lexical content or identify every connection with an overt marker.

term_use.definition: A means of connecting a Satz; here the verb’s grammatical function rather than its action meaning.
term_use.label: Verbindungsmittel
term_use.rule: Keep the grammatical operation distinct from a merely content-bearing concept.

term_use.definition: A connecting stroke used to show elements joined into the same word in the displayed notation.
term_use.label: Verbindungsstrich
term_use.rule: Use connecting stroke for the attested Verbindungsstrich here.

term_use.definition: The relation in which the separated words are joined, made recognizable by their treatment.
term_use.label: Verbindungsverhältniss
term_use.rule: Use relation of connection for the attested Verbindungsverhältniss here.

term_use.definition: Verb as a grammatical constituent; an inflected verb may perform the representation of a participle.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use verb for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Verb category, including forms that can be built lexically from a prior verb and a stem.
term_use.label: Verb category, including forms that can be built lexically from a prior verb and a stem
term_use.rule: Distinguish conceptual/lexical contribution from a category’s overt marking.

term_use.definition: The verb considered as naming an action, distinguished from its specifically grammatical connecting function.
term_use.label: verb as action designation
term_use.rule: When the action-designation view is discussed, do not assume that semantic action-content itself establishes grammatical verb status.

term_use.definition: The verb as the connecting means of the Satz, the specifically grammatical view.
term_use.label: verb as grammatical connector
term_use.rule: Preserve the distinction from action meaning; the author’s criterion is grammatical function.

term_use.definition: The verb be added to another verb, considered as a possible grammatical auxiliary rather than a final solution to existential positing.
term_use.label: Verbum seyn
term_use.rule: Keep the word be separate from the conceptual Seyn it is supposed to make explicit.

term_use.definition: Social association as the strongest means of approaching truth and measuring one's distance from it.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use association for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: The overall way a language uses and treats its means, distinguished non-rigidly from its constituents.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use procedure or way of operating for how language coordinates and applies its means; preserve the expressly non-rigid opposition to constituents.

term_use.definition: A choice of publication/expository procedure: present general conclusions before separate grammars and dictionaries.
term_use.label: expository procedure
term_use.rule: Do not turn an author's publication procedure into the language's internal activity.

term_use.definition: Procedure of inquiry, here comparing designating and designated concepts in both directions.
term_use.label: Procedure of inquiry, here comparing designating and designated concepts in both directions
term_use.rule: Distinguish the analyst’s procedure from the language’s own way of forming expressions.

term_use.definition: A manner of proceeding in analysis which can misrepresent a language if it conflates supplied and intrinsic grammar.
term_use.label: analytical procedure
term_use.rule: Distinguish the analyst’s method from a language’s own operation when the bearer changes.

term_use.definition: A language’s overall grammatical way of proceeding, contrasted with treatment of individual grammatical parts.
term_use.label: language’s grammatical procedure
term_use.rule: Not merely the analyst’s list of forms or a fixed typological class.

term_use.definition: A general manner of proceeding in grammatical designation, subject to many further determinations.
term_use.label: Verfahrungsart
term_use.rule: Not a complete language class defined by one procedure.

term_use.definition: A mode of proceeding that defines form operationally.
term_use.label: Verfahrungsweise
term_use.rule: Retain the manner of operating rather than an inventory of outputs.

term_use.definition: The forgetting of earlier substantive content in a grammatical word’s current relational use.
term_use.label: Vergessenheit
term_use.rule: Not an assertion of a conscious decision to erase meaning; the transition is historical and gradual.

term_use.definition: Comparative study of language whose grammatical basis depends on distinguishing grammar in language from grammar supplied by users.
term_use.label: vergleichendes Sprachstudium
term_use.rule: Not only genealogical comparison or a fixed typological classification.

term_use.definition: Comparison of language samples for their overall character, whose fruits still require detailed constituent analysis.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use comparison for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Comparison that must first establish internal word relations before direct cross-language comparison.
term_use.label: Comparison that must first establish internal word relations before direct cross-language comparison
term_use.rule: The same ordinary word is methodologically consequential here.

term_use.definition: The necessary comparison point supplied by a conceptually defined general pattern of language's mental process.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use point of comparison for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: A language's relation to others and place within the larger field, which a successful character description should reveal.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use relation for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Interrelation or relational determination of concepts/things, viewed through the understanding’s activity.
term_use.label: Interrelation or relational determination of concepts/things, viewed through the understanding’s activity
term_use.rule: Avoid treating it as only physical proportion.

term_use.definition: A relation connecting items; in §143 the spatial relation is extracted from a substantive concept, distinct from that content and its sign.
term_use.label: Verhältniss
term_use.rule: Distinguish a relation from the content concept, its word, and its audible designation.

term_use.definition: A relative concept, here the notion of base word within historically bounded inquiry.
term_use.label: A relative concept, here the notion of base word within historically bounded inquiry
term_use.rule: Preserve relativity of the analytic designation rather than infer an ultimate root.

term_use.definition: Concept of a relation between things or concepts, contrasted with concepts of properties.
term_use.label: concept of a relation
term_use.rule: Distinct from the relative epistemic concept of Stammwort on p412.

term_use.definition: A relational concept alone, as the operative contribution of a former content word whose substantive meaning has disappeared.
term_use.label: Verhältnissbegriff
term_use.rule: Keep the conceptual contribution distinct from the physical word and from its historical substantive meaning.

term_use.definition: Designation of a relation as relation, visibly distinct in the argument from designating a substantive concept.
term_use.label: Verhältnissbezeichnung
term_use.rule: Do not equate the relation, its designation and the sound that carries the designation.

term_use.definition: Relational word named in a suspended compound with Beziehungswörter.
term_use.label: Relational word named in a suspended compound with Beziehungswörter
term_use.rule: The relation can be viewed subjectively or objectively.

term_use.definition: A relation-word needed to connect a substantive concept with its principal word, even when the concept itself stands for a relation.
term_use.label: Verhältnisswort
term_use.rule: Distinguish the relational word from the Sachbegriff it relates; do not equate mental requirement with an audible word.

term_use.definition: Actual interaction of speakers through which similarities can be transmitted from already formed language.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Do not narrow automatically to commerce, transport or correspondence.

term_use.definition: Linking several words by sound alteration and contraction across their contact.
term_use.label: Linking several words by sound alteration and contraction across their contact
term_use.rule: Keep audible linking distinct from grammatical or conceptual unity.

term_use.definition: Chaining of words within which dependence on governing words can make a grammatical whole.
term_use.label: Verkettung
term_use.rule: Preserve the connected sequence without substituting a modern constituency theory.

term_use.definition: Connection of thoughts in discourse, for which general grammar examines necessary word forms.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use connection for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Connection of concepts whose unity may not straightforwardly coincide with audible separation.
term_use.label: Connection of concepts whose unity may not straightforwardly coincide with audible separation
term_use.rule: Not evidence that every sound break is a separate concept.

term_use.definition: Embodiment of an intellectual production which prompts a corresponding production in another.
term_use.label: Embodiment of an intellectual production which prompts a corresponding production in another
term_use.rule: Not transfer of the same physical or mental substance.

term_use.definition: Mixture of nations paired with separation as a cause of divergence among their languages.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use mixture for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Mediator between opposed natures, the role assigned here to imagination.
term_use.label: Mediator between opposed natures, the role assigned here to imagination
term_use.rule: Keep the explicit referent Einbildungskraft; not a separate faculty.

term_use.definition: Mediation by speech organs between mental striving and its outward acoustic material.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use mediation for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Mediation through sounds by which objects are made into thoughts.
term_use.label: Mediation through sounds by which objects are made into thoughts
term_use.rule: Do not equate medium and resulting conceptual content.

term_use.definition: Mediation by factual concepts, contrasted with what can be derived purely grammatically from concepts.
term_use.label: Vermittlung
term_use.rule: Not merely a communicative medium; the mediation here qualifies conceptual deduction.

term_use.definition: Capacity to turn heard material increasingly into understanding, paired with drive in the growth account.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use capacity here; distinguish it from the paired drive and from acquired material.

term_use.caution: The bearers and English renderings are conditional; this does not establish a strict universal Kraft/Vermögen taxonomy.
term_use.definition: Capacity or faculty: a mental power cooperating in word formation, and a language’s capacity to satisfy the need for expression.
term_use.label: Mental capacity/power whose relation and cooperation constitute the subjective form of a word
term_use.rule: Use faculties for the cooperating mental powers in§90 (p421), and capacity for a language’s ability to meet expressive need in§110 (p434). A capacity is not one actual act or its resulting content.

term_use.definition: The capacity in the mind that forms language, not unconditionally ruled by language arriving from outside.
term_use.label: Vermögen
term_use.rule: Retain the denial of language’s unconditional domination; do not reduce capacity to its current exercise.

term_use.definition: Hearing/perception of sound, analytically distinguished from the inward possibility of articulation.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use perception for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Reason shared with other humans, expressly distinguished from specifically linguistic ability in the account of deaf learners.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Keep reason and language ability distinct where the source does; do not infer a complete modern faculty system.

term_use.definition: Synthesizing reason producing philosophically rich expressions, distinguished from technical construction by Verstand.
term_use.label: Synthesizing reason producing philosophically rich expressions, distinguished from technical construction by Verstand
term_use.rule: The etymological example Vernunft on p422 is cited-example use, not a competing faculty definition.

term_use.definition: Language as an operation or performance rather than a ready-made material stock.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use operation for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: An operation or performance; speaking is expressly denied to be strictly a merely organic bodily operation.
term_use.label: Verrichtung
term_use.rule: Retain the denial that speaking is an organic operation in the strict bodily sense.

term_use.definition: Diversity of kinds allowed within natural bounds by human bodily and mental linguistic dispositions.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use diversity in kind for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: The small but pervasive difference between individual understandings of a word, recurring through each person's whole language.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use difference for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Diversity or difference of grammatical views and procedures among languages, beyond merely different sounds.
term_use.label: Verschiedenheit
term_use.rule: Identify what differs; do not reduce all diversity to sound, fixed classes or value ranking.

term_use.definition: Running together or slurring sounds in continuous discourse, checked at pauses required by understanding.
term_use.label: Running together or slurring sounds in continuous discourse, checked at pauses required by understanding
term_use.rule: Preserve the contrast between sound continuity and intellectual segmentation.

term_use.definition: Interweavings of thought whose course is marked by language and belongs to pure language-form’s domain.
term_use.label: Verschlingung
term_use.rule: Keep the metaphor of organized relations; not physical entanglement or proof of a modern recursive formalism.

term_use.definition: Fusion of sound and concept constituting the word’s peculiar position between human and world.
term_use.label: Fusion of sound and concept constituting the word’s peculiar position between human and world
term_use.rule: Not a physical mixing of independent conceptual substances.

term_use.definition: Reordering or transposition within word formation, paired with syllable repetition.
term_use.label: Reordering or transposition within word formation, paired with syllable repetition
term_use.rule: No specific modern metathesis rule is supplied.

term_use.definition: Giving thought sensible embodiment, one condition added by specifically linguistic form.
term_use.label: Versinnlichung
term_use.rule: Not an assertion that thought is merely sensory matter.

term_use.definition: Analysing understanding/intellect unable exhaustively to represent what becomes felt in language use.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use understanding/intellect for the analytical faculty. Use sense only when the construction concerns meaning or an interpretation, as in im strengsten Verstände; not every prepositional im Verstande phrase is idiomatic.

term_use.definition: Understanding as the faculty performing distinctions and logical constructions, including separating linguistic elements and constructing technical concepts.
term_use.label: Understanding as the faculty distinguishing and retaining the basic elements of language
term_use.rule: This occurrence does not mean the sense of a word or expression.

term_use.caution: A preposition alone does not decide the meaning; distinguish the separate meaning/interpretation idiom by syntax and context.
term_use.definition: Understanding as a faculty supporting pure thought, distinct from creative imagination’s embodiment in language.
term_use.label: Verstand
term_use.rule: Use understanding for this faculty. The possessed construction im Verstande des Redenden also names the speaker’s understanding, not the sense of an expression.

term_use.definition: Sense in the idiom im strengsten Verstände, qualifying one possible concept of an original language.
term_use.label: idiomatic sense
term_use.rule: Use sense here rather than the faculty understanding.

term_use.definition: Sense or meaning in which an expression is used, here restricting the label organic operation.
term_use.label: sense-of-expression idiom
