term_use.definition: Whole words regarded as units requiring their own audible unity.
term_use.label: Whole words regarded as units requiring their own audible unity
term_use.rule: Preserve the unity of each word rather than a loose collection of words.

term_use.definition: The word’s content, of which accompanying feeling had so far been considered one part.
term_use.label: The word’s content, of which accompanying feeling had so far been considered one part
term_use.rule: Includes more than referential content.

term_use.definition: A word group whose written sense can be understood before one is certain of its alphabetic composition, analogized with taking a word as an indivisible whole.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use word group for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: An internally closed grouping of words within a period, with restricted rearrangement.
term_use.label: Wortgruppe
term_use.rule: Use word group for the attested Wortgruppe here.

term_use.definition: The content of the word as designated by its motivating properties or, if opaque, its articulated sound.
term_use.label: The content of the word as designated by its motivating properties or, if opaque, its articulated sound
term_use.rule: Distinct from the sound’s physical occurrence.

term_use.definition: A word’s sounded form in families developed from one base sound.
term_use.label: A word’s sounded form in families developed from one base sound
term_use.rule: Not automatically a pitch value.

term_use.definition: Inherited audible word forms which can remain relatively stable while their meanings shift.
term_use.label: Inherited audible word forms which can remain relatively stable while their meanings shift
term_use.rule: Not only the exact wording of a written passage.

term_use.definition: Richness of vocabulary increased by productive word families as well as separate new expressions.
term_use.label: Richness of vocabulary increased by productive word families as well as separate new expressions
term_use.rule: Not only raw count of memorized words.

term_use.definition: Separation into words, distinguished from a merely audible separation of component syllables.
term_use.label: Separation into words, distinguished from a merely audible separation of component syllables
term_use.rule: The text marks difficulty deciding its conceptual counterpart.

term_use.definition: Word order considered as a possible grammatical indication only under a stringent fixedness and independent-anchor condition.
term_use.label: Wortstellung
term_use.rule: Retain all conditions, completed on printed 470: a fixed point must be recognizable independently of order.

term_use.definition: The intended determinate manner of connecting words, which can have its own non-substantive sign.
term_use.label: Wortverbindung
term_use.rule: Keep the intended connection apart from its sign and from newly introduced substantive content.

term_use.definition: Linking words through changes of speech elements, adding to Sanskrit’s complex sound system.
term_use.label: Linking words through changes of speech elements, adding to Sanskrit’s complex sound system
term_use.rule: Use the local sound operation contribution; preserve the stated contrast.

term_use.definition: Simple base reached by analysis of more complex words; analysis does not recover an absolute beginning.
term_use.label: Simple base reached by analysis of more complex words; analysis does not recover an absolute beginning
term_use.rule: Do not imply that all historical originals were demonstrably monosyllabic.

term_use.definition: Root word with both grammatical distribution and lexical derivational roles; not necessarily the universal origin of all other words.
term_use.label: Root word with both grammatical distribution and lexical derivational roles; not necessarily the universal origin of all other words
term_use.rule: Do not force every lexical item under assumed roots.

term_use.definition: A dictionary prepared under shared principles alongside grammars to supply material for continuing language research.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use dictionary for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: An individual's own lexical selection through preferring, avoiding and excluding particular sounds/words.
term_use.label: individual lexical selection
term_use.rule: Preserve the metaphor of an individual dictionary rather than an actual published book.

term_use.definition: Lexicographic work whose arrangement may wrongly present contextual meanings as an unordered plurality.
term_use.label: Lexicographic work whose arrangement may wrongly present contextual meanings as an unordered plurality
term_use.rule: Keep dictionary representation distinct from the language’s actual semantic structure.

term_use.definition: Knowledge of isolated words, insufficient by itself for a language’s distinctive intellectual character.
term_use.label: Knowledge of isolated words, insufficient by itself for a language’s distinctive intellectual character
term_use.rule: Use the local method contribution; preserve the stated contrast.

term_use.definition: Direct comparison of words, used when fuller structural evidence is unavailable but requiring investigation of each word’s origin.
term_use.label: Direct comparison of words, used when fuller structural evidence is unavailable but requiring investigation of each word’s origin
term_use.rule: Retain the methodological limitation rather than treating a lookup match as proof.

term_use.caution: OCR Wörten'orrath corrected from image.
term_use.definition: The vocabulary as available material of discourse and the accumulated material of a nation’s thought.
term_use.label: The vocabulary as available material of discourse and the accumulated material of a nation’s thought
term_use.rule: Not merely a list detached from use.

term_use.definition: Stock of words whose productive formation is distinguished from connecting words in discourse.
term_use.label: Stock of words whose productive formation is distinguished from connecting words in discourse
term_use.rule: Closely related to Wörtervorrath; retain the observed compound form.

term_use.definition: Translation of an expression’s elements separately, which may misrepresent the conventional whole.
term_use.label: wörtliche Uebersetzung
term_use.rule: Retain the warning about interpreting whole formulas through their elements.

term_use.definition: Number as a verbal determination, distinct from its sound designation or a separately added counting word.
term_use.label: Zahl
term_use.rule: Do not equate number, plural marking and an explicit numeral.

term_use.definition: A specified number receiving its own form in the dual, contrasted with general multiplicity.
term_use.label: specified quantity
term_use.rule: Keep a specified quantity distinct from the plural category and from the marker realizing it.

term_use.caution: The expanded headword indexes the printed coordinated expression; it is not a separate fully spelled occurrence.
term_use.definition: Designation of number among the verbal determinations, not the verbal whole itself.
term_use.label: Zahlbezeichnung
term_use.rule: Keep the determination and its designation separate. The coordinated shortened forms share the suffix bezeichnung in the print.

term_use.definition: Subtlety or delicacy of mental and expressive response, among qualities attributed to linguistic cultivation.
term_use.label: Zartheit
term_use.rule: Not physical fragility or merely sentimental softness.

term_use.definition: Signs or pictures used to express thoughts, distinguished in the historical deafness argument from understanding articulated language.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Do not equate the author's signs/pictures with a contemporary signed-language category.

term_use.definition: Written reminder of a speech sound.
term_use.label: written reminder-sign
term_use.rule: Differentiate this ordinary reminder-sign from the later argument about words as signs.

term_use.definition: A sign standing for what can exist independently of it; contrasted with a word whose concept receives completion through it.
term_use.label: sign with independently existing designated content
term_use.rule: A word may serve a sign’s purpose without being reducible to this relation.

term_use.caution: Empty is the source’s description in this polemic, not a claim that speakers cannot understand or that all signs lack contribution.
term_use.definition: A sign contrasted with substituting what is designated for it; the immediately parallel phrase contrasts putting a concept in place of form.
term_use.label: empty sign contrasted with designated content
term_use.rule: Preserve both parallels in§141. The formal reading is supported by this local opposition, not by importing§147’s strict criterion into the fragment.

term_use.definition: A word considered as a sign for concepts and objects from the dictionary standpoint used in the comparison.
term_use.label: lexical sign under dictionary abstraction
term_use.rule: Retain the analytic dictionary standpoint; this is not a blanket equation of every living word with a detachable label.

term_use.definition: Time in which an action occurs, invoked to motivate a verbal tense determination.
term_use.label: Zeit
term_use.rule: Do not collapse the time of an action, the concept of futurity and its grammatical designation.

term_use.caution: The expanded headword indexes the printed coordinated expression; it is not a separate fully spelled occurrence.
term_use.definition: Designation of time among the verbal determinations, not the verbal whole itself.
term_use.label: Zeitbezeichnung
term_use.rule: Keep the determination and its designation separate. The coordinated shortened forms share the suffix bezeichnung in the print.

term_use.definition: Chronological succession of languages, which must not be neglected but must not be assumed where origins are unknown.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use chronological sequence for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Syllabic temporal quantity, subsequently grounded in pronunciation rather than arbitrary assignment.
term_use.label: Syllabic temporal quantity, subsequently grounded in pronunciation rather than arbitrary assignment
term_use.rule: Keep distinct from accent and from calendar time.

term_use.definition: To decompose or analyze; here mechanically brooding over idea-material is rejected as the source of rich language.
term_use.label: To decompose or analyze; here mechanically brooding over idea-material is rejected as the source of rich language
term_use.rule: Distinct lexeme from Zergliederung; preserve whether the activity is endorsed or criticized.

term_use.definition: Analysis into parts necessary to convert felt individuality into knowledge but unable fully to preserve the living whole.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use analysis for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Analytic decomposition of complex words into simpler roots or constituents.
term_use.label: Analytic decomposition of complex words into simpler roots or constituents
term_use.rule: Analysis does not prove an absolute historical beginning.

term_use.definition: Analytical articulation of existing languages into their parts and relations.
term_use.label: Zergliederung
term_use.rule: Use analysis for the attested Zergliederung here.

term_use.definition: Separation of articulated sound into articulation and audible component, used in the historical deafness argument.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use separation for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Fragmentation of what is said about an individual language when divided across comparative topics, which the initial whole-sketch seeks to avoid.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use fragmentation for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Breaking the whole of speech into words for grammatical analysis.
term_use.label: Zerschlagung
term_use.rule: Retain the force of analysis from a whole, not physical destruction.

term_use.definition: Cutting sounds into separate syllables, invoked for a proposed effect on thought’s flow.
term_use.label: Cutting sounds into separate syllables, invoked for a proposed effect on thought’s flow
term_use.rule: Retain the evaluative claim as Humboldt’s, with its qualifications.

term_use.definition: Generative intellectual production embodied in a word and renewed in another speaker.
term_use.label: Generative intellectual production embodied in a word and renewed in another speaker
term_use.rule: Preserve the metaphor without biological literalization.

term_use.definition: Hissing noise named in the author’s account of accompanying sound.
term_use.label: Hissing noise named in the author’s account of accompanying sound
term_use.rule: Retain the evaluative account as the author’s, not present-day acoustic classification.

term_use.definition: Contingent rather than necessary by pure conceptual deduction; here a particular number receives its own form.
term_use.label: conceptually contingent
term_use.rule: Not random or uncaused; distinguish the argument’s level of necessity.

term_use.definition: External contingencies that combine with inward dispositions to modify an individual's linguistic use.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use contingency for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Futurity extracted from another expression and mentally supplied as a verbal determination.
term_use.label: Zukunft
term_use.rule: Keep the future concept apart from a future-tense exponent.

term_use.definition: Measuring out/apportioning words, a rejected model of children's learning contrasted with growth of capacity.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use apportioning for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Reflection back of a concept from another thinking power, completing its clarity and determinacy.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use reflection back for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Thinking several words together as though one, allowing habitual whole expressions.
term_use.label: Zusammendenken
term_use.rule: Use thinking together for the attested Zusammendenken here.

term_use.definition: Coincidence/coming together of sensory and nonsensory contribution, expressly different in word and symbol.
term_use.label: Coincidence/coming together of sensory and nonsensory contribution, expressly different in word and symbol
term_use.rule: Do not treat both relations as an identical fusion theory.

term_use.caution: The printed parallel uses a different mixing expression. Do not substitute it into this sentence or infer a revision chronology. The infinitive is an editorial lookup lemma; the attested form is zusammengeflossen.
term_use.definition: Different languages have come together within the same continent; the statement does not itself require the languages to have blended into one.
term_use.label: geographical convergence of different languages
term_use.rule: Use converge in§1; keep the geographical grouping distinct from an asserted mixing of the languages.

term_use.caution: Humboldt’s analysis and historical example are retained as source claims. The difference lies in the local relation, not in an invariant ban on translating this verb with a mixing-related expression.
term_use.definition: In the discussion of lexical richness, a language such as English is described as having flowed together from different languages, leaving expressions with different origins.
term_use.label: a language formed through confluence of others
term_use.rule: Here the language itself is the result of confluence; do not carry over§1’s merely geographical grouping as a universal sense.

term_use.definition: Combination of basic parts into wholes which tend to become parts of further wholes, common to mental form and articulation.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use combination for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Putting discourse together, another domain in which the same subjective linguistic orientation appears.
term_use.label: Putting discourse together, another domain in which the same subjective linguistic orientation appears
term_use.rule: Differentiate discourse combination from lexical formation.

term_use.definition: Composition or joining of speech from words, contrasted methodologically with analyzing a prior whole.
term_use.label: Zusammenfügung
term_use.rule: Use joining together for the attested Zusammenfügung here.

term_use.definition: Holding together/cohesion combined with separation as principles in gradual national formation.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use cohesion for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Historical connection among languages distinguished from likeness due merely to shared human capacities.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Keep historical connectedness distinct from a presumed single original language.

term_use.definition: The tight interconnection of parts within language and of language with nation, through which distinctive world-view arises.
term_use.label: internal interdependence
term_use.rule: Identify internal/reciprocal relations rather than automatically historical contact.

term_use.definition: Internal connection of words through formation and sound patterns, to be established before interlanguage comparison.
term_use.label: internal relation of a linguistic system
term_use.rule: Not simply surrounding text.

term_use.definition: Contextual connection of concepts that forces a more specific reading than a word’s simple lexical sense.
term_use.label: context determining interpretation
term_use.rule: Do not turn every context-induced reading into a new dictionary sense.

term_use.definition: Contextual connection contributing to comprehension alongside word order and particles.
term_use.label: contextual connection
term_use.rule: Keep contextual recovery distinct from specifically grammatical marking.

term_use.definition: The interconnection or coherence of a language’s organized whole, distinct from immediate semantic context.
term_use.label: systemic interconnection
term_use.rule: Do not force context as the English equivalent when the entire system is the bearer.

term_use.definition: Semantic connection arising from substantive meaning, able to replace grammatical form as an aid to comprehension.
term_use.label: Zusammenhang des Sinnes
term_use.rule: Do not equate recovery by semantic coherence with the full formal effect attributed to genuine grammar.

term_use.definition: Composition listed with derivation as a means of language and considered also in changes and ordering of words.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use composition for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Word formation joining several concepts into a new one or specifying a principal concept.
term_use.label: Word formation joining several concepts into a new one or specifying a principal concept
term_use.rule: Keep conceptual combination distinct from sound contact alone.

term_use.definition: The composition of a habitual expression from its words, no longer attended to in ordinary use.
term_use.label: Zusammensetzung
term_use.rule: Use composition for the attested Zusammensetzung here.

term_use.definition: Coordinated operation of the linguistic process as a whole, the object of the proposed broader analysis.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use coordinated operation for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Contraction accompanying sound alteration in the linking of words.
term_use.label: Contraction accompanying sound alteration in the linking of words
term_use.rule: Do not assume it produces one conceptual word.

term_use.definition: Contraction of concepts, a tendency Humboldt judges not always expedient in Sanskrit.
term_use.label: Zusammenziehung
term_use.rule: Keep the qualification not always expedient; do not invent a precise morphological operation.

term_use.definition: The configuration of grammatical parts so they fit into the period’s structure.
term_use.label: Zuschnitt
term_use.rule: Keep the fitting relation of parts to the whole, not merely their external shape.

term_use.definition: Reliability of evidence disclosing a word’s original motivation, limiting historical inference.
term_use.label: Reliability of evidence disclosing a word’s original motivation, limiting historical inference
term_use.rule: Ingenuity and imagination must not substitute for secure traces.

term_use.definition: Concession acknowledging that alleged sameness and radical difference disappear under deeper inquiry before retaining broad likeness.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Keep its paired concessive relation to aber rather than forcing an isolated word.

term_use.definition: Discourse as the purpose of language that grounds the division between its elements and their combination.
term_use.label: local sense
term_use.rule: Use purpose for the defined local use.

term_use.definition: Fitness to a logical purpose in choosing rule-governed formation and expressing related conceptual classes.
term_use.label: Fitness to a logical purpose in choosing rule-governed formation and expressing related conceptual classes
term_use.rule: Evaluative criterion, not empirical certification.

term_use.definition: Intermediate connecting sounds arising within whole speech on both sound-side and logical grounds.
term_use.label: Zwischenlaut
term_use.rule: Use intermediate sound for the attested Zwischenlaut here.
